desc:
A standard dagger with a straight blade. 

Though modest in reach and capacity for harm, this weapon is light enough to jab in rapid succession and delivers devastating critical hits.
location: Purchase: Twin Maiden Husks 1 sold by the Twin Maiden Husks at Roundtable Hold for 400 Runes. Loot: Lands Between / Realm of Shadow A base 4% chance to drop from drop dagger-wielding enemies (Highwaymen, Godrick Foot Soldiers, Raya Lucaria Foot Soldiers, Radahn Foot Soldiers, Leyndell Foot...
whatItIs: The plainest knife in the game and the one almost every new player finds first. It swings fast, weighs almost nothing, and asks for barely any Strength or Dexterity to hold.
whyItMatters: Its damage per swing is small, but its critical multiplier is among the highest in the game, so the payoff comes from backstabs and from ripostes after a parry rather than from trading blows. It is also cheap to upgrade and takes any affinity, which makes it a safe place to spend early smithing stones.
whenToUse: Carry it in your off hand from the first hour onward and draw it after a parry or from behind. Once you can hold something with real reach it stops being your main weapon, but the critical damage keeps it worth a slot for a long time.
name: Dagger

desc:
Dagger once belonging to one of the assassins who murdered Godwyn the Golden on the Night of the Black Knives.

A ritual performed on the oddly misshapen blade imbued it with the power of the stolen Rune of Death.
location: Received upon defeating the Black Knife Assassin in front of Sainted Hero's Grave located in Altus Plateau.
whatItIs: A dagger of 2 weight, Black Knife hits with slash and pierce attacks. Beat Black Knife Assassin in Altus Plateau to get it.
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 66 physical attack and 65 holy, scaling E in Strength, D in Dexterity, and D in Faith. Weapon skill: Blade of Death (25 FP). Its critical value is 110.
whenToUse: Black Knife needs 8 Strength, 12 Dexterity, and 18 Faith, cannot be infused, and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Pick it up when you meet the requirements.
name: Black Knife

desc:
A knife with curved handguards. Designed to parry, turning foes' attacks against them.

For masters of combat who anticipate every enemy strike and counter accordingly, this weapon is all they need.
location: 1 can be bought from Patches for 1,600 Runes in any of his locations (Murkwater Cave is the earliest).
whatItIs: Parrying Dagger belongs to the dagger class at 1.5 weight, and its attack type is slash and pierce. Patches sells it for 1,600 runes.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 75 physical, scaling E in Strength and C in Dexterity. The skill is Parry. Its critical value is 110.
whenToUse: Parrying Dagger needs 5 Strength and 14 Dexterity; it can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Parrying Dagger

desc:
Dagger favored by military physicians in white. The pointed blade is hard and sharp, making critical hits especially potent.

Medicine is mercy, and mercy upon the battlefield is ruthless. Beware the killers clothed as men of compassion.
location: Loot: Stormveil Castle (Limgrave) Looted off a corpse that's only accessible behind a fog wall that requires 1 Stonesword Key to open. The fog wall is near the roaming Grafted Scion inside Stormveil Castle and the elevator shortcut back up to the Rampart Tower Site of Grace.
whatItIs: Miséricorde belongs to the dagger class at 2 weight, and its attack type is slash and pierce. Corpse loot at Stormveil Castle.
whyItMatters: It starts at 92 physical attack and scales E in Strength and D in Dexterity. The skill on it is Quickstep at 3 FP. Its critical value is 140.
whenToUse: Miséricorde needs 7 Strength and 12 Dexterity, can take Ashes of War and affinity changes, and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Miséricorde

desc:
Jagged dagger with a distinctive curved blade. Used by the noble servants of the Lord of Blood.

This dagger rips the flesh as it enters, inflicting blood loss with sickening efficacy. A proud testament to the success of its vicious design, this weapon is perpetually coated in blood.
location: Guaranteed Drop: Limgrave Dropped by Bloody Finger Nerijus near Murkwater Cave after defeating him. Beware that progressing through the game can prevent this invasion from happening, more specifically by defeating all the major Limgrave bosses (Flying Dragon Agheel, Mad Pumpkin Head, Margit, the...
whatItIs: Reduvia belongs to the dagger class at 2.5 weight, and its attack type is slash and pierce. It drops from Bloody Finger Nerijus in Limgrave.
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 79 physical attack, scaling E in Strength, D in Dexterity, and D in Arcane. Hits carry blood loss (50) buildup. Weapon skill: Reduvia Blood Blade (6 FP). Its critical value is 110.
whenToUse: Reduvia needs 5 Strength, 13 Dexterity, and 13 Arcane, cannot be infused, and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Reduvia

desc:
A knife made by sharpening hard crystal. Signature weapon of glintstone miners. 

Used as tool to extract glintstone from broken rock, and as such a faint magic enwreathes the blade.
location: Found in a chest inside the Raya Lucaria Crystal Tunnel located in Liurnia of the Lakes. After taking the first elevator after the Site of Grace down and walking across a wooden beam it is inside the second room on the right, guarded by two distracted Marionette Soldiers.
whatItIs: Crystal Knife belongs to the dagger class at 2 weight, and its attack type is slash and pierce. Chest loot in Liurnia of the Lakes.
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 82 physical attack and 53 magic, scaling D in Strength, D in Dexterity, and D in Intelligence. The skill is Quickstep, 3 FP.
whenToUse: Crystal Knife needs 8 Strength, 12 Dexterity, and 9 Intelligence; it cannot be infused and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Crystal Knife

desc:
Sickle decorated with flowers and many-colored fabrics. Ceremonial tool used by dancers during the festivities of Dominula. Its attacks can slip through an enemy's guard.

Crafted from human bone. Grants trace amounts of runes on landing attacks.
location: Drop: Dominula, Windmill Village (Altus Plateau) 0.5% drop chance from the blue Dominula Dancers in Dominula, Windmill Village, located in the north of Altus Plateau. Two of them are found a bit east of the Windmill Village Site of Grace.
whatItIs: A dagger of 1.5 weight, Celebrant's Sickle hits with slash and pierce attacks. An enemy drop in Altus Plateau (a 0.5% chance).
whyItMatters: It starts at 79 physical attack and scales E in Strength and C in Dexterity. Weapon skill: Quickstep (3 FP).
whenToUse: It can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones, and Celebrant's Sickle needs 6 Strength and 11 Dexterity. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Celebrant's Sickle

desc:
Ritual blade once presented to Leyndell by the Academy of Raya Lucaria to celebrate their newfound peace. 

Though the weapon is embedded with precious glintstones and features Erdtree ornamentation, the undulating blade is symbolic of an ancient ritual.
location: Received if siding with Sorceress Sellen against Castellan Jerren in Academy of Raya Lucaria near the end of her questline.
whatItIs: Glintstone Kris is a dagger weighing 1.5 with slash and pierce attacks.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 57 physical plus 68 magic, scaling E in Strength, D in Dexterity, and D in Intelligence. The skill on it is Glintstone Dart at 10 FP. Its critical value is 110.
whenToUse: It cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones, and Glintstone Kris needs 5 Strength, 12 Dexterity, and 16 Intelligence. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Glintstone Kris

desc:
Dagger fashioned from a great scorpion's tail, glistening with scarlet rot.

A ceremonial tool used by heretics, crafted from the relic of a sealed outer god.
location: Loot: Lake of Rot (Ainsel River) Found inside a chest near the Grand Cloister Site of Grace, located in the Lake of Rot. It inside the small shrine to the west that is guarded by a large group of Kindred of Rot.
whatItIs: Scorpion's Stinger belongs to the dagger class at 2.5 weight, and its attack type is slash and pierce. A chest at Lake of Rot in Ainsel River holds it.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 79 physical, scaling D in Strength and C in Dexterity. Each hit builds up scarlet rot (50). Weapon skill: Repeating Thrust (7 FP). Its critical value is 110.
whenToUse: Scorpion's Stinger needs 6 Strength and 12 Dexterity, cannot be infused, and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Scorpion's Stinger

desc:
Large knife with a broad, curved blade.

This weapon is designed to slash and rend, inflicting blood loss upon the recipient.
location: Starting equipment for the Bandit class. 2% drop chance from Small Demi-Humans. The earliest farming spot is just inside Lakeside Crystal Cave, where one can be found hiding inside of a bush next to a regular Demi-Human. The most efficient farming spot is just north of the Craftsman's Shack Site...
whatItIs: Great Knife belongs to the dagger class at 1.5 weight, and its attack type is slash and pierce. The Bandit class starts with it.
whyItMatters: It starts at 75 physical attack and scales E in Strength and C in Dexterity. Each hit builds up blood loss (38). The skill is Quickstep, 3 FP. Its critical value is 110.
whenToUse: It can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones, and Great Knife needs 6 Strength and 12 Dexterity. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Great Knife

desc:
Short sword with a tempering pattern on the blade. A weapon unique to warriors of the Land of the Reeds. Afflicts targets with blood loss.

These swords are considered auxiliary weapons. Yet, one man is known to wield this weapon in his left hand while using a full-sized katana in his right. A demonic swordman known only as Okina.
location: Found on a corpse inside a locked cell in Gaol Cave, located in Caelid. The cave requires one Stonesword Key to access. From the lever that unlocks all the cages it can be found by taking a right then a left, and then it's one of three items in the second cage on the left.
whatItIs: Wakizashi is a dagger weighing 3 with slash and pierce attacks. Looted from a corpse in Caelid.
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 94 physical attack, scaling D in Strength and D in Dexterity. Hits carry blood loss (38) buildup. Its weapon skill is Quickstep, which costs 3 FP.
whenToUse: Wakizashi needs 9 Strength and 13 Dexterity; it can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Wakizashi

desc:
Short sword given to high ranking clergymen of Farum Azula. Raises potency of bestial incantations.

The design celebrates a beast's five fingers, symbolic of the intelligence once granted upon their kind.
location: Loot: Bestial Sanctum (Caelid) On a body very far down at the cliff west of the Bestial Sanctum, on the same level as the Dragoncrest Shield Talisman. The Tarnished must carefully descend the cliffs by jumping onto roots, the domes of the pillars, and outcrops on the walls and pillars. Rainbow...
whatItIs: A dagger of 3.5 weight, Cinquedea hits with slash and pierce attacks. Look for it at Bestial Sanctum in Caelid.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 98 physical, scaling D in Strength and E in Dexterity. Quickstep is its weapon skill, costing 3 FP per use.
whenToUse: It cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones, and Cinquedea needs 10 Strength and 10 Dexterity. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Cinquedea

desc:
Sickle fashioned from ivory. Weapon carried by aged Albinaurics.

These weapons are evidence of their dedication to the Haligtree, despite never having entered its presence.
location: Found near the Village of the Albinaurics Site of Grace in Liurnia of the Lakes.
whatItIs: Ivory Sickle belongs to the dagger class at 2 weight, and its attack type is slash and pierce. Found in Liurnia of the Lakes.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 60 physical plus 60 magic, scaling E in Strength, D in Dexterity, and D in Intelligence. Weapon skill: Quickstep (3 FP).
whenToUse: Ivory Sickle needs 6 Strength, 11 Dexterity, and 13 Intelligence; it cannot be infused and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Ivory Sickle

desc:
Dagger with a bloodstained blade. Afflicts targets with blood loss.

As blood darkened the dagger through repeated slashing and stabbing, its blade only grew sharper and harder.
location: 2% drop rate from Fierce Demi-Humans aka Demi-Human Chiefs. One can be found asleep next to the bridge west of the South of the Lookout Tower Site of Grace.
whatItIs: Bloodstained Dagger is a dagger weighing 2 with slash and pierce attacks. It is an enemy drop (a 2% chance).
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 81 physical attack, scaling C in Strength and E in Dexterity. It applies blood loss (38) buildup on hit. Weapon skill: Quickstep (3 FP). Its critical value is 110.
whenToUse: Bloodstained Dagger needs 9 Strength and 12 Dexterity, can take Ashes of War and affinity changes, and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Bloodstained Dagger

desc:
An erdsteel dagger with a grass crest engraved upon its blade. Carried by the Erdtree royalty for self-defense in times of peace.

Though forged to a high standard, the weapon is difficult to wield. Attack power also scales with faith.
location: Received from Kenneth Haight after helping him retake Fort Haight. Can be found in Leyndell, Royal Capital in the sewer area under the wing of Gransax near a fire-spitting Gargoyle Statue. From the Avenue Balcony Site of Grace, proceed northwest along the avenue and drop down in the pit to the...
whatItIs: Erdsteel Dagger is a dagger weighing 2 with slash and pierce attacks. Given by Kenneth Haight.
whyItMatters: It starts at 67 physical attack and scales D in Strength, D in Dexterity, and D in Faith. The skill is Quickstep, 3 FP. Its critical value is 110.
whenToUse: Erdsteel Dagger needs 7 Strength, 12 Dexterity, and 14 Faith, can take Ashes of War and affinity changes, and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Erdsteel Dagger

desc:
Dagger given to one who set out on a journey to fulfill her duty long ago. The power of its former owner, the kindling maiden, is still apparent.

The one who walks alongside flame, Shall one day meet the road of Destined Death.
location: Loot: Forbidden Lands (Mountaintops of the Giants) Hidden within a room that you can only reach during the elevator ride that leads down to the Forbidden Lands grace, alongside the Official's Attire. Jump from the southwestern part of the elevator to a doorway just above the bottom floor.
whatItIs: Blade of Calling belongs to the dagger class at 1.5 weight, and its attack type is slash and pierce. Look for it at Forbidden Lands in Mountaintops of the Giants.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 71 physical plus 43 holy, scaling D in Strength, D in Dexterity, and C in Faith. Weapon skill: Blade of Gold (17 FP). Its critical value is 110.
whenToUse: Blade of Calling needs 6 Strength, 13 Dexterity, and 15 Faith; it cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Blade of Calling

desc:
Dagger with a large hand guard.

Intended to be used in the left hand, thereby complementing a piercing sword or identical blade held in the right to enable a distinctive style of fighting.
location: Found inside of Shadow Keep. From the Main Gate Plaza Site of Grace, head up the western stairs and take a right after the first stair, then take a right again in the corridor to arrive in a small room with a Black Knight. The dagger can be found on a body in the left corner.
whatItIs: A dagger of 2 weight, Main-gauche hits with slash and pierce attacks. Found in Shadow Keep.
whyItMatters: It starts at 79 physical attack and scales D in Strength and C in Dexterity. The skill is Parry. Its critical value is 110.
whenToUse: It can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones, and Main-gauche needs 7 Strength and 15 Dexterity. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Main-gauche

desc:
Shortsword used by the Fire Knights. A slender blade that undulates like fire. 

Blessed with a flame incantation. Further flame imbuement will amplify the effect and greatly increase the armament's power.
location: Dropped by dual dagger-wielding Fire Knights with a 4% droprate.
whatItIs: Fire Knight's Shortsword belongs to the dagger class at 2 weight, and its attack type is slash and pierce. An enemy drop (a 4% chance).
whyItMatters: It starts at 75 physical attack with 22 fire on top and scales D in Strength, D in Dexterity, and D in Faith. Weapon skill: Quickstep (3 FP). Its critical value is 110.
whenToUse: It can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones, and Fire Knight's Shortsword needs 8 Strength, 13 Dexterity, and 12 Faith. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Fire Knight's Shortsword

desc:
A straight sword with a double-edged blade.

In addition to its reliable standard damage, this weapon also boasts powerful piercing attacks. A superbly balanced armament.
location: Starting armament of the Vagabond origin. Purchased from Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold for 1,000 Runes.
whatItIs: Longsword is a straight sword weighing 3.5 with standard and pierce attacks. You can buy it from Twin Maiden Husks in Roundtable Hold for 1,000 runes.
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 110 physical attack, scaling D in Strength and D in Dexterity. The skill is Square Off, 68 FP.
whenToUse: Longsword needs 10 Strength and 10 Dexterity; it can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Longsword

desc:
A short straight sword with a short blade. In addition to its reliable standard damage, this weapon also boasts powerful piercing attacks.

Lightweight amongst straight swords, this weapon is easy to wield, requiring only humble attributes.
location: Starting equipment for the Astrologer class. Nomadic Merchant east of Saintsbridge for 600 Runes (x1). 4% drop chance off short sword-wielding enemies (Highwaymen, Godrick Foot Soldiers, Raya Lucaria Foot Soldiers, Radahn Foot Soldiers, Leyndell Foot Soldiers, Haligtree Foot Soldiers, and...
whatItIs: Short Sword is a straight sword weighing 3 with standard and pierce attacks. Starting gear for the Astrologer.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 102 physical, scaling D in Strength and D in Dexterity. The skill on it is Kick.
whenToUse: Short Sword needs 8 Strength and 10 Dexterity; it can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Short Sword

desc:
A straight sword with a wide blade, suited to slashing attacks.

Horizontal swing boast wide attack range, making it easier to connect with foes.
location: Starting equipment for the Confessor class. Nomadic Merchant southeast of Coastal Cave, beneath the collapsed structure.
whatItIs: Broadsword belongs to the straight sword class at 4 weight, and its attack type is standard and pierce. It is Confessor starting gear.
whyItMatters: It starts at 117 physical attack and scales D in Strength and E in Dexterity. The skill on it is Square Off at 68 FP.
whenToUse: Broadsword needs 10 Strength and 10 Dexterity, can take Ashes of War and affinity changes, and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Broadsword

desc:
Well-crafted straight sword with an illustrious design, wielded by regulars of a lord's army.

Though blackened and damaged by years of use, it appears to have otherwise been kept in a serviceable condition, despite the soldiers having long since lost their minds.
location: Soldier enemies of every faction that wield this weapon have a 2% drop rate for it. This includes Godrick Soldiers, Raya Lucaria Soldiers, Radahn Soldiers, Leyndell Soldiers, Mausoleum Soldiers, and Haligtree Soldiers. Can be farmed from the very beginning of the game, at Gatefront Ruins, where...
whatItIs: A straight sword of 3.5 weight, Lordsworn's Straight Sword hits with standard and pierce attacks. Enemies in Leyndell, Royal Capital drop it (a 2% chance).
whyItMatters: Base attack is 115 physical, scaling D in Strength and D in Dexterity. Weapon skill: Square Off (68 FP). Its critical value is 110.
whenToUse: Lordsworn's Straight Sword needs 10 Strength and 10 Dexterity, can take Ashes of War and affinity changes, and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Lordsworn's Straight Sword

desc:
Straight sword with a rather short but wide blade. Simple to wield, it was known as the sword of the people.

Though the Erdtree styling is still visible, time has not been kind to this sword, now merely a shadow of its former self.
location: Dropped by Commoner enemies with a 4% drop rate. An easy spot to farm is the room with a Grafted Scion, where 3 Commoners are sitting next to a fireplace near the stairs to the second floor (an easy path there is taking the elevator next to the Rampart Tower Site of Grace).
whatItIs: Weathered Straight Sword is a straight sword weighing 3 with standard and pierce attacks. Commoner can drop it (a 4% chance).
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 103 physical attack, scaling D in Strength and D in Dexterity. Its weapon skill is Square Off, which costs 68 FP.
whenToUse: Weathered Straight Sword needs 7 Strength and 10 Dexterity, can take Ashes of War and affinity changes, and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Weathered Straight Sword

desc:
Slender straight sword patterned after an unique ornament. Superior swordsmen prefer to wield one in each hand.

After falling from grace, the dregs of the golden lineage sought power and purpose in the past.
location: Dropped by the Grafted Scion at the Chapel of Anticipation, either by beating it first try when starting the game or when visiting again through The Four Belfries in west Liurnia of the Lakes.
whatItIs: Ornamental Straight Sword belongs to the straight sword class at 3 weight, and its attack type is standard and pierce. Look for it as a drop from Grafted Scion in Liurnia of the Lakes.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 101 physical, scaling E in Strength and D in Dexterity. Golden Tempering is its weapon skill, costing 24 FP per use. Its critical value is 110.
whenToUse: Ornamental Straight Sword needs 10 Strength and 14 Dexterity; it cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Ornamental Straight Sword

desc:
A sword made to commemorate the death of Godwyn the Golden, first of the demigods to die.

Infused with the humble prayer of a young boy; "O brother, lord brother, please die a true death."
location: Found at the entrance of Auriza Hero's Grave. Requires a Stonesword Key to access and is guarded by a Basilisk.
whatItIs: Golden Epitaph is a straight sword weighing 3.5 with standard and pierce attacks. The location note is on its record.
whyItMatters: It starts at 85 physical attack with 85 holy on top and scales D in Strength, D in Dexterity, and D in Faith. Its weapon skill is Last Rites, which costs 25 FP.
whenToUse: Golden Epitaph needs 12 Strength, 10 Dexterity, and 14 Faith, cannot be infused, and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Golden Epitaph

desc:
A grim weapon wielded by swordsmen of the Eternal City, this shotel has a blade as fine as a needle.

Forged from the liquid metal of a Silver Tear, it is thoroughly tempered until hardened.
location: Guaranteed Drop: Sellia, Town of Sorcery (Caelid) Received upon defeating the Nox Swordstress & Nox Monk duo boss in Sellia, Town of Sorcery, just east of the Swamp of Aeonia in Caelid. Accessing the duo requires lighting the three braziers in the town to remove a seal.
whatItIs: Nox Flowing Sword is a curved sword weighing 3.5 with slash attacks. It comes from beating Nox Swordstress in Caelid.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 112 physical, scaling E in Strength and D in Dexterity. The skill on it is Flowing Form at 9 FP.
whenToUse: Nox Flowing Sword needs 8 Strength and 15 Dexterity, cannot be infused, and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Nox Flowing Sword

desc:
Sword forged by compounding silver and gold. A sacred weapon to hunt Those Who Live in Death. Deals holy damage.

The inseparable twins found solace in the Golden Order, the only institution not to revile them as accursed beings.
location: Guaranteed drop: Siofra Aqueduct (Siofra River) / Deeproot Depths Obtained after the death of D, Beholder of Death, meaning there are two ways to obtain this weapon. The first way is the regular one, which is slower and require that the questlines of both D's and also Fia, Deathbed Companion, is...
whatItIs: Inseparable Sword is a greatsword weighing 10 with standard and pierce attacks. It is an enemy drop.
whyItMatters: It starts at 98 physical attack with 98 holy on top and scales D in Strength, D in Dexterity, and C in Faith. Sacred Blade is its weapon skill, costing 19 FP per use.
whenToUse: It cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones, and Inseparable Sword needs 18 Strength, 18 Dexterity, and 20 Faith. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Inseparable Sword

desc:
Hidden sword once granted to the Tarnished of the Roundtable by the Two Fingers. A formless cipher comprises its blade, which deals holy damage no shield can repel.

Champions would gather at the Roundtable Hold in days long past, when the Two Fingers were masters of oration, their flesh yet full of vigor.
location: The Coded Sword can be found on the upper floor of the Fortified Manor in Leyndell, Royal Capital, in the room that mirrors the one that the Two Fingers of the Roundtable Hold can be found it. This weapon cannot be acquired once the Tarnished has defeated Maliketh.
whatItIs: Coded Sword belongs to the straight sword class at 2.5 weight, and its attack type is standard and pierce. Found in Leyndell, Royal Capital.
whyItMatters: Its base attack is 85 holy, with no physical component, scaling B in Faith. Its weapon skill is Unblockable Blade, which costs 18 FP.
whenToUse: Coded Sword needs 20 Faith, cannot be infused, and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Coded Sword

desc:
Storied sword and treasure of Caria Manor. One of the legendary armaments.

Astrologers, who preceded the sorcerers, established themselves in mountaintops that nearly touched the sky, and considered the Fire Giants their neighbors.
location: In a locked room at Caria Manor, Liurnia of the Lakes, which the Tarnished can jump into from above on the walkways where the Raya Lucaria Soldier puppets appear. More specifically, starting from the Manor Lower Level Site of Grace walk out onto the stone walkways and take a left when they path...
whatItIs: A straight sword of 4 weight, Sword of Night and Flame hits with standard and pierce attacks. The record places it in Liurnia of the Lakes.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 87 physical plus 56 magic and 56 fire, scaling E in Strength, E in Dexterity, D in Intelligence, and D in Faith. The skill on it is Night-and-Flame Stance at 2632 FP.
whenToUse: It cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones, and Sword of Night and Flame needs 12 Strength, 12 Dexterity, 24 Intelligence, and 24 Faith. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Sword of Night and Flame

desc:
Sword fashioned from pure crystal; a deed impossible for a human. Enwreathed with powerful magic, its attack scales with intelligence.

The inscrutable Crystalians have but one clear purpose, to safeguard their crystals unto the end. One theory posits that they yearn for the return of their creator who will carve for them new brethren.
location: Found after the bridge in the Village of the Albinaurics Site of Grace, located in Liurnia of the Lakes.
whatItIs: A straight sword of 4.5 weight, Crystal Sword hits with standard and pierce attacks. Found in Liurnia of the Lakes.
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 106 physical attack and 68 magic, scaling D in Strength, E in Dexterity, and D in Intelligence. The skill is Spinning Slash, 6 FP.
whenToUse: Crystal Sword needs 13 Strength, 10 Dexterity, and 15 Intelligence; it cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Crystal Sword

desc:
Straight sword embedded with a blue glintstone. Weapon of knights sworn to Carian royalty.

These knights' sword could serve as catalysts, letting them wield sorcerous battle skills. Despite numbering fewer than twenty, this power made them a match for even the champions of gold in battle.
location: Held by a Carriage located in the northwest region of Liurnia of the Lakes, between the Northern Liurnia Lake Shore and The Four Belfries Sites of Grace.
whatItIs: A straight sword of 4 weight, Carian Knight's Sword hits with standard and pierce attacks. Found in Liurnia of the Lakes.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 88 physical plus 88 magic, scaling D in Strength, D in Dexterity, and D in Intelligence. Its weapon skill is Carian Grandeur, which costs 26 FP.
whenToUse: It cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones, and Carian Knight's Sword needs 10 Strength, 10 Dexterity, and 18 Intelligence. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Carian Knight's Sword

desc:
Silver sword carried by clerics of St. Trina. Inflicts sleep ailment upon foes.

St. Trina is an enigmatic figure. Some say she is a comely young girl, others are sure he is a boy. The only certainty is that their appearance was as sudden as their disappearance.
location: Behind a Stonesword Key imp statue in the Forsaken Ruins, Caelid, visible directly below the ledge at the Rotview Balcony Site of Grace.
whatItIs: Sword of St. Trina is a straight sword weighing 3 with standard and pierce attacks. Located in Caelid.
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 107 physical attack and 32 magic, scaling D in Strength, D in Dexterity, and E in Intelligence. It applies sleep (66) buildup on hit. Its weapon skill is Mists of Slumber, which costs 20 FP.
whenToUse: Sword of St. Trina needs 10 Strength, 12 Dexterity, and 14 Intelligence; it cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Sword of St. Trina

desc:
Sword forged by the servants of Miquella of the Haligtree, with a design modeled after those carried by Carian Knights. Instead of glinstone however, amber of the Haligtree is embedded in the blade.

A sumptuous piece, yet it has never been offered to any knight - an ill-starred sword with no master.
location: Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree, near the Prayer Room Site of Grace. After exiting the Grace in it to continue forward there will be a parapet on the right that leads to a tower with a ladder on the other side. Climbing that ladder leads to the sword's location.
whatItIs: Miquellan Knight's Sword belongs to the straight sword class at 3.5 weight, and its attack type is standard and pierce.
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 105 physical attack and 68 holy, scaling D in Strength, D in Dexterity, and E in Faith. Its weapon skill is Sacred Blade, which costs 19 FP.
whenToUse: Miquellan Knight's Sword needs 11 Strength, 11 Dexterity, and 16 Faith, cannot be infused, and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Miquellan Knight's Sword

desc:
Beloved sword of an aged knight whose last quest was long behind him, repurposed into a walking stick. The tip is rather worn.

Though bent of back and without the brawn required even to raise the sword aloft, still he wished to meet his end with weapon in hand.
location: Found next to the stairs just south of the West Capital Rampart Site of Grace in Leyndell, Royal Capital. Can still be found in Leyndell, Ashen Capital.
whatItIs: Cane Sword belongs to the straight sword class at 2.5 weight, and its attack type is standard and pierce. Found at Leyndell, Ashen Capital in Leyndell, Royal Capital.
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 96 physical attack, scaling E in Strength and D in Dexterity. Weapon skill: Square Off (68 FP).
whenToUse: Cane Sword needs 8 Strength and 11 Dexterity; it can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Cane Sword

desc:
Treasured sword of Eochaid, a lesser, long-vanished domain. The copper coloration is not to be confused for rust, but is a conduit for its wielder to move it by their will alone.

Swords of Eochaid dance through the skies.
location: Loot: Gaol Cave (Caelid) Found on a ledge at the beach bordering Caelid and Limgrave, to the east of the Third Church of Marika. It can be reached through the Gaol Cave or by using Torrent to perform some tricky jumps to ascend the cliff face onto its ledge.
whatItIs: A straight sword of 5.5 weight, Regalia of Eochaid hits with standard and pierce attacks. Gaol Cave in Caelid is where it is found.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 89 physical plus 57 magic, scaling E in Strength, D in Dexterity, and D in Arcane. Its weapon skill is Eochaid's Dancing Blade, which costs 15 FP.
whenToUse: It cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones, and Regalia of Eochaid needs 12 Strength, 18 Dexterity, and 15 Arcane. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Regalia of Eochaid

desc:
Narrow blade carried by wandering nobles. Made to be easy to wield.

Daubed with gold from tip to tail, it should fetch a good sum.
location: Dropped by Wandering Nobles that wield it with a 0.5% drop rate. These specific nobles are distinguished by wearing the Aristocrat Garb (Altered) and Aristocrat Boots. Sword-and-torch-wielding nobles will not drop the sword. The Carriage on the road that runs north from the Agheel Lake South...
whatItIs: Noble's Slender Sword is a straight sword weighing 3.5 with standard and pierce attacks. Dropped by Wandering Nobles (a 0.5% chance).
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 101 physical attack, scaling E in Strength and C in Dexterity. Square Off is its weapon skill, costing 68 FP per use. Its critical value is 110.
whenToUse: Noble's Slender Sword needs 8 Strength and 11 Dexterity, can take Ashes of War and affinity changes, and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Noble's Slender Sword

desc:
Talon-swords are affixed to the legs of Stormveil's warhawks, but this one has been repurposed for human use.

The blade is thin and lightweight so as not to obstruct the hawk's mobility.
location: Drop: Stormveil Castle / Castle Sol (Mountaintops of the Giants) 2% drop chance from Warhawks. 4 of these birds can be found on the walls outside of the Rampart Tower Site of Grace.
whatItIs: A straight sword of 3 weight, Warhawk's Talon hits with standard and pierce attacks. It drops from Warhawks in Mountaintops of the Giants (a 2% chance).
whyItMatters: Base attack is 101 physical, scaling D in Strength and C in Dexterity. Its weapon skill is Spinning Slash, which costs 6 FP.
whenToUse: It can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones, and Warhawk's Talon needs 10 Strength and 16 Dexterity. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Warhawk's Talon

desc:
A sword with a glintstone in its handguards. Wielded by the scholars of the Lazuli Conspectus who seek to master Carian sorcery. Deals magic damage.

Apparently once used as a staff of sorcery, this sword is made out of wood.
location: Dropped by Lazuli Glintstone Sorcerers with a 2% drop rate. One can be easily reached just outside of the room with the Schoolhouse Classroom Site of Grace, just before the Red Wolf of Radagon in Academy of Raya Lucaria.
whatItIs: Lazuli Glintstone Sword is a straight sword weighing 3.5 with standard and pierce attacks. Look for it as a drop from Lazuli Glintstone Sorcerers (a 2% chance).
whyItMatters: It starts at 79 physical attack with 94 magic on top and scales D in Strength, E in Dexterity, and D in Intelligence. The skill on it is Glintstone Pebble at 8 FP.
whenToUse: Lazuli Glintstone Sword needs 8 Strength, 9 Dexterity, and 13 Intelligence; it cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Lazuli Glintstone Sword

desc:
Sword fashioned from pure crystal; a deed impossible for a human. It festers with scarlet rot.

Enwreathed with powerful magic, its attack scales with intelligence.
location: In a treasure chest guarded by three Crystalians in Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree, behind some large tree roots right after the Ephael Inner Wall grace.
whatItIs: Rotten Crystal Sword belongs to the straight sword class at 4.5 weight, and its attack type is standard and pierce. Chest loot.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 102 physical plus 66 magic, scaling D in Strength, E in Dexterity, and D in Intelligence. Hits carry scarlet rot (50) buildup. The skill on it is Spinning Slash at 6 FP.
whenToUse: Rotten Crystal Sword needs 13 Strength, 10 Dexterity, and 15 Intelligence; it cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Rotten Crystal Sword

desc:
Silver sword of St. Trina, now stained the color of velvet. Inflicts eternal sleep.

When St. Trina was abandoned, the faint, light-purple mists coalesced into an intoxicating deep-purple cloud.
location: From the Fissure Cross Site of Grace in Cerulean Coast, head north and drop down two stone platforms to a cliff lower down. Inside of a cave to the south that's full of slimes is also the sword, furthest in.
whatItIs: Velvet Sword of St. Trina belongs to the straight sword class at 2.5 weight, and its attack type is standard and pierce. An enemy drop in Cerulean Coast.
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 95 physical attack and 61 magic, scaling E in Strength, D in Dexterity, and E in Intelligence. Each hit builds up sleep (42). Its weapon skill is Mists of Eternal Sleep, which costs 23 FP.
whenToUse: It cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones, and Velvet Sword of St. Trina needs 10 Strength, 12 Dexterity, and 14 Intelligence. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Velvet Sword of St. Trina

desc:
Sword encrusted with a line of stars fashioned from small pieces of crude glintstone. Weapon of the demi-human swordsmen.

When bestowed with this weapon by their queen, the swordsmen swear to find the truth that lies at the end of the procession of stars.
location: Guaranteed Drop: Cerulean Coast Dropped by Demi-Human Queen Marigga.
whatItIs: Star-Lined Sword belongs to the katana class at 5 weight, and its attack type is slash and pierce. It drops from Demi-Human Queen Marigga in Cerulean Coast.
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 82 physical attack and 82 magic, scaling E in Strength, C in Dexterity, and D in Intelligence. It applies blood loss (45) buildup on hit. Onze's Line of Stars is its weapon skill, costing 10 FP per use.
whenToUse: Star-Lined Sword needs 10 Strength, 23 Dexterity, and 21 Intelligence; it cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Star-Lined Sword

desc:
One of the Carian royal family's glintstone swords. A small piercing sword with a slender blade.

Formerly used by the Carian knights of old before the full refinement of their sorcerous combat techniques, this armament functions as a catalyst for glintstone sorcery when executing strong attacks.
location: Loot: Castle Ensis (Gravesite Plain) This item can be found in a chest in northern Castle Ensis after dropping down from Scadu Altus. Starting from the Highroad Cross Site of Grace, head southwest into the river and jump of the southern edge of the western riverbank to get to a freestanding...
whatItIs: A thrusting sword of 2.5 weight, Carian Sorcery Sword hits with standard and pierce attacks. Found in a chest at Castle Ensis.
whyItMatters: It starts at 38 physical attack with 69 magic on top and scales E in Strength, D in Dexterity, and D in Intelligence. The skill on it is Impaling Thrust at 9 FP. Its critical value is 110.
whenToUse: Carian Sorcery Sword needs 10 Strength, 19 Dexterity, and 16 Intelligence, cannot be infused, and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Carian Sorcery Sword

desc:
A sword that none can pull from its scabbard of cracked stone.

Relic of a lost civilization from a time long past, said to have served a ritual purpose at altars of light and darkness.
location: Found at an altar in either Fog Rift Catacombs, Ruins of Unte, or Ancient Ruins of Rauh. Since the altar in Fog Rift Catacombs is the most complicated to reach, it's recommended that the sword is taken there so that the later interactions with altars are less time-consuming.
whatItIs: Stone-Sheathed Sword belongs to the straight sword class at 3.5 weight, and its attack type is strike. Fog Rift Catacombs in Ancient Ruins of Rauh is where it is found.
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 89 physical attack, scaling C in Strength and D in Dexterity. Weapon skill: Square Off (68 FP).
whenToUse: It cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones, and Stone-Sheathed Sword needs 16 Strength and 8 Dexterity. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Stone-Sheathed Sword

desc:
Sword of light, pulled from its stone scabbard at an altar. 

From the quick of the root, unswerving rays of light intersect and reflect to give the silver blade form.
location: Take the Stone-Sheathed Sword or Sword of Darkness to an altar at either Fog Rift Catacombs or Ancient Ruins of Rauh. WARNING: Once either the Sword of Darkness or Sword of Light has been acquired, though the two forms can be freely switched between by traveling to their assigned altars, the...
whatItIs: Sword of Light is a straight sword weighing 4 with standard and pierce attacks. The record places it in Ancient Ruins of Rauh.
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 93 physical attack and 93 holy, scaling D in Strength, E in Dexterity, and E in Faith. Weapon skill: Light (30 FP).
whenToUse: Sword of Light needs 14 Strength, 11 Dexterity, and 24 Faith; it cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Sword of Light

desc:
Sword of darkness, pulled from its stone scabbard at an altar. 

From the quick of the root, wandering coils of darkness coalesce and release, their eddies and vortices giving form to the dark blade.
location: Take the Stone-Sheathed Sword or Sword of Light to an altar at either Fog Rift Catacombs or Ruins of Unte. WARNING: Once either the Sword of Darkness or Sword of Light has been acquired, though the two forms can be freely switched between by traveling to their assigned altars, the Stone-Sheathed...
whatItIs: A straight sword of 4 weight, Sword of Darkness hits with standard and pierce attacks.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 93 physical plus 93 holy, scaling D in Strength, E in Dexterity, and E in Faith. The skill on it is Darkness at 30 FP.
whenToUse: Sword of Darkness needs 14 Strength, 11 Dexterity, and 24 Faith; it cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Sword of Darkness

desc:
A large sword with a straight blade. This heavy sword is usually wielded with two hands, but for those with enough strength, one is sufficient.

The hefty blade can be swung into multiple foes at once thanks to the broad, sweeping attack, making fending off crowds all the easier.
location: Purchase: Weeping Peninsula One is sold for 3,000 Runes by the Nomadic Merchant at the Castle Morne Rampart Site of Grace.
whatItIs: Bastard Sword is a greatsword weighing 9 with standard and pierce attacks. Sold by Nomadic Merchant for 3,000 runes.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 138 physical, scaling D in Strength and D in Dexterity. Stamp (Upward Cut) is its weapon skill, costing 5 FP per use.
whenToUse: Bastard Sword needs 16 Strength and 10 Dexterity; it can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Bastard Sword

desc:
Oddly shaped greatsword wielded by imps.

The gently undulating forked blade is known as an "imp's tongue" and causes blood loss.
location: Drop: Road's End Catacombs (Liurnia of the Lakes) / Minor Erdtree Catacombs & War-Dead Catacombs (Caelid) / Sainted Hero's Grave (Altus Plateau) / Wyndham Catacombs (Mt. Gelmir) / Auriza Side Tomb (Capital Outskirts) / Subterranean Shunning-Grounds (Leyndell, Royal Capital) / Giant-Conquering...
whatItIs: A greatsword of 9 weight, Forked Greatsword hits with standard and pierce attacks. An enemy drop in Liurnia of the Lakes.
whyItMatters: It starts at 124 physical attack and scales D in Strength and D in Dexterity. It applies blood loss (55) buildup on hit. The skill is Stamp (Upward Cut), 5 FP.
whenToUse: Forked Greatsword needs 14 Strength and 16 Dexterity; it can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Forked Greatsword

desc:
Greatsword with a blade of unusually thick steel. A coarse weapon to which polishing is a foreign concept.

Weighty even among others of its class, the impact of each strike is sure to be felt.
location: Drop: Leyndell, Royal Capital / Miquella's Haligtree 4% drop chance from Misbegotten Warriors. 2 Warriors can be found among the Misbegotten southeast the East Capital Rampart Site of Grace in Leyndell, before the elevator to the Forbidden Lands. One is among a group of Misbegotten just before...
whatItIs: A greatsword of 12 weight, Iron Greatsword hits with standard and pierce attacks. It drops from Misbegotten Warriors in Leyndell, Royal Capital (a 4% chance).
whyItMatters: It starts at 149 physical attack and scales C in Strength and E in Dexterity. The skill on it is Stamp (Upward Cut) at 5 FP.
whenToUse: Iron Greatsword needs 18 Strength and 10 Dexterity, can take Ashes of War and affinity changes, and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Iron Greatsword

desc:
Well-crafted straight sword with an illustrious design, wielded by regulars of a lord's army.

Though blackened and damaged by years of use, it appears to have otherwise been kept in a serviceable condition, despite the soldiers having long since lost their minds.
location: Loot: Gatefront Ruins (Limgrave) Found in the chest on a carriage just southeast of the Gatefront Site of Grace.
whatItIs: A greatsword of 9 weight, Lordsworn's Greatsword hits with standard and pierce attacks. Found in a chest at Gatefront Ruins.
whyItMatters: It starts at 136 physical attack and scales D in Strength and D in Dexterity. Its weapon skill is Stamp (Upward Cut), which costs 5 FP. Its critical value is 110.
whenToUse: Lordsworn's Greatsword needs 16 Strength and 10 Dexterity, can take Ashes of War and affinity changes, and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Lordsworn's Greatsword

desc:
Greatsword bestowed upon skilled swordsmen in the demigods' service, and yet had no rank or title.

Featuring a long grip enabling a dual-handed use, this weapon was designed to dispatch larger foes. Being charged with such a duty was undoubtedly a great honor.
location: Drop: Limgrave / Liurnia of the Lakes / Caelid / Mt. Gelmir / Altus Plateau / Deeproot Depths / Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree 4% drop chance from various sword-wielding knight enemies: Godrick Knights, Cuckoo Knights, Leyndell Knights and Mausoleum Knights. 2 sword-wielding Godrick Knights can...
whatItIs: Knight's Greatsword belongs to the greatsword class at 10 weight, and its attack type is standard and pierce. An enemy drop in Limgrave (a 4% chance).
whyItMatters: It starts at 141 physical attack and scales D in Strength and D in Dexterity. Weapon skill: Stamp (Upward Cut) (5 FP).
whenToUse: Knight's Greatsword needs 16 Strength and 12 Dexterity, can take Ashes of War and affinity changes, and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Knight's Greatsword

desc:
Greatsword featuring a flame-like undulation. Shred enemy flesh, inducing blood loss.

Scarlet rot is kept at bay with flame at Redmane Castle, and as such, this beloved sword of Jerren's eventually became the symbol of the castle itself.
location: Loot: Redmane Castle (Caelid) Found atop a tower to the right of the stairs up to the courtyard with the Misbegotten Warrior & Crucible Knight boss fight, guarded by a Mad Pumpkin Head. WARNING: This door is locked during the Radahn Festival, requiring the defeat of Starscourge Radahn and...
whatItIs: Flamberge belongs to the greatsword class at 10 weight, and its attack type is standard and pierce. Redmane Castle in Caelid is where it is found.
whyItMatters: It starts at 129 physical attack and scales D in Strength and C in Dexterity. Hits carry blood loss (55) buildup. Weapon skill: Stamp (Upward Cut) (5 FP).
whenToUse: Flamberge needs 15 Strength and 14 Dexterity; it can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Flamberge

desc:
Greatsword of Ordovis, one of the two honored as foremost among the Crucible Knights.

This sword is imbued with an ancient holy essence. Its red tint exemplifies the nature of primordial gold, said to be closer in nature to life itself.
location: Guaranteed drop: Auriza Hero's Grave (Altus Plateau) Ordovis's Greatsword is received upon defeating the Crucible Knight Ordovis and Crucible Knight duo boss at the bottom of the Auriza Hero's Grave.
whatItIs: A greatsword of 12 weight, Ordovis's Greatsword hits with standard and pierce attacks. Beat Crucible Knight Ordovis and Crucible Knight in Altus Plateau to get it.
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 107 physical attack and 69 holy, scaling C in Strength, E in Dexterity, and D in Faith. Ordovis's Vortex is its weapon skill, costing 15 FP per use.
whenToUse: Ordovis's Greatsword needs 25 Strength, 13 Dexterity, and 15 Faith; it cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Ordovis's Greatsword

desc:
Greatsword forged from a blue-white meteoric ore. The blade conceals gravity-manipulating magic.

A weapon unique to the Alabaster Lords, a race of ancients with skin of stone who were said to have risen to life when a meteor struck long ago.
location: Guaranteed drop: Lake of Rot / Yelough Anix Tunnel (Consecrated Snowfield) One each is dropped by respective the Alabaster Lord in the Lake of Rot and in Yelough Anix Tunnel. Note that the sword will not drop if the Lord is killed at the same time as the player.
whatItIs: Alabaster Lord's Sword belongs to the greatsword class at 8 weight, and its attack type is standard and pierce. An enemy drop in Consecrated Snowfield.
whyItMatters: It starts at 128 physical attack with 38 magic on top and scales D in Strength, E in Dexterity, and D in Intelligence. Weapon skill: Alabaster Lords' Pull (15 FP).
whenToUse: It cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones, and Alabaster Lord's Sword needs 16 Strength, 12 Dexterity, and 18 Intelligence. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Alabaster Lord's Sword

desc:
A finely-crafted greatsword intricately engraved with an ancient motif. Given to knights who, whether by misfortune or misdeed, were forced to abandon their homes.

Most of these knights were sent to the fringes, where they were forced to start anew with only despair for company.
location: Drop: Stormveil Castle / Cathedral of Dragon Communion (Caelid) / Castle Sol (Mountaintops of the Giants) 4% drop chance from sword-and-shield Banished Knights. A lone sword-and-shield Banished Knight can be found outside of the southwestern exit from Cathedral of Dragon Communion, patrolling...
whatItIs: Banished Knight's Greatsword is a greatsword weighing 10 with standard and pierce attacks. Enemies in Caelid drop it (a 4% chance).
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 142 physical attack, scaling D in Strength and D in Dexterity. Weapon skill: Stamp (Upward Cut) (5 FP).
whenToUse: It can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones, and Banished Knight's Greatsword needs 17 Strength and 9 Dexterity. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Banished Knight's Greatsword

desc:
A Moon Greatsword bestowed by a Carian queen upon her spouse to honor long-standing tradition. One of the legendary armaments.

Ranni's sigil is a full moon, cold and leaden, and this sword is but a beam of its light.
location: Quest reward: Cathedral of Manus Celes (Liurnia of the Lakes) Found at the end of Lunar Princess Ranni's questline, in the spot where she sat underneath the Cathedral of Manus Celes, after giving her the Dark Moon Ring.
whatItIs: A greatsword of 10 weight, Dark Moon Greatsword hits with standard and pierce attacks. Found in Liurnia of the Lakes.
whyItMatters: It starts at 82 physical attack with 98 magic on top and scales D in Strength, D in Dexterity, and C in Intelligence. Each hit builds up frostbite (55). Moonlight Greatsword is its weapon skill, costing 32 FP per use.
whenToUse: Dark Moon Greatsword needs 16 Strength, 11 Dexterity, and 38 Intelligence; it cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Dark Moon Greatsword

desc:
Sword wrought from the remains of a god who should have lived a life eternal.

Thoughts on what the weapon portends are many and varied. Some consider it the mark of a great sin, or a sign of a great devastation. Some think it as the end of an age, while others; the beginning.
location: Trade: Roundtable Hold Trade the Elden Remembrance, gained by defeating the Elden Beast, with Finger Reader Enia. Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).
whatItIs: Sacred Relic Sword belongs to the greatsword class at 11 weight, and its attack type is standard and pierce. Beat Elden Beast in Roundtable Hold to get it.
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 118 physical attack and 76 holy, scaling E in Strength, D in Dexterity, and D in Faith. The skill is Wave of Gold, 42 FP. Its critical value is 110.
whenToUse: Sacred Relic Sword needs 14 Strength, 24 Dexterity, and 22 Faith, cannot be infused, and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Sacred Relic Sword

desc:
Greatsword patterned after the black steeple of the Helphen, the lampwood which guides the dead of the spirit world.

The lamplight is similar to grace in appearance, only it is said that it can only be seen by those who met their death in battle.
location: Guaranteed drop: Mountaintops of the Giants Dropped by a Tibia Mariner in the Mountaintops, overlooking Castle Sol and not far from the Snow Valley Ruins Overlook Site of Grace and where you fight the Mountaintops' Death Rite Bird.
whatItIs: Helphen's Steeple is a greatsword weighing 11.5 with standard and pierce attacks. Dropped by Tibia Mariner.
whyItMatters: It starts at 101 physical attack with 101 magic on top and scales D in Strength, E in Dexterity, and D in Intelligence. Its weapon skill is Ruinous Ghostflame, which costs 20 FP.
whenToUse: Helphen's Steeple needs 19 Strength, 10 Dexterity, and 22 Intelligence, cannot be infused, and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Helphen's Steeple

desc:
Sacred sword of Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy. Remains of the countless heroes he has devoured writhe upon the surface of this blade.

Now they share the same blood, bound together as family. Some HP is restored upon defeating an enemy.
location: Trade: Roundtable Hold Trade the Remembrance of the Blasphemous, gained by defeating Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy, with Finger Reader Enia. Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums with a bell to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).
whatItIs: Blasphemous Blade is a greatsword weighing 13.5 with standard and pierce attacks. Trade in the Remembrance of the Blasphemous with Finger Reader Enia to get it.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 121 physical plus 78 fire, scaling D in Strength, D in Dexterity, and D in Faith. Its weapon skill is Taker's Flames, which costs 30 FP.
whenToUse: Blasphemous Blade needs 22 Strength, 15 Dexterity, and 21 Faith, cannot be infused, and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Blasphemous Blade

desc:
Storied sword of House Marais, the family of executioners who presided over the Shaded Castle. One of the legendary armaments.

Elemer of the Briar, the Bell Bearing Hunter, snatched the sword from the site of his looming execution, and furnished it with battle skills from his home of Eochaid.
location: Guaranteed drop: The Shaded Castle (Altus Plateau) Defeat Elemer of the Briar at the top of the castle.
whatItIs: A greatsword of 11.5 weight, Marais Executioner's Sword hits with standard and pierce attacks. Beat Elemer of the Briar for it.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 94 physical plus 61 magic, scaling C in Strength, E in Dexterity, and D in Arcane. The skill on it is Eochaid's Dancing Blade at 15 FP.
whenToUse: It cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones, and Marais Executioner's Sword needs 24 Strength, 14 Dexterity, and 23 Arcane. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Marais Executioner's Sword

desc:
Sinister greatsword fashioned from a giant's backbone. The spines along each side of the blade have been tapered to a fine point and mete out wounds like a lopsided saw-blade.

Milos was undersized for a giant, and was viewed as sullied and terribly grotesque.
location: Guaranteed drop: Capital Outskirts / Subterranean Shunning-Grounds Can be acquired in two different, mutually exclusive ways: Dropped by the Dung Eater when he invades in the southern end of the moat in Capital Outskirts, at the spot where Blackguard Big Boggart normally sits.
whatItIs: Sword of Milos is a greatsword weighing 10 with standard and pierce attacks. Dung Eater in Subterranean Shunning-Grounds can drop it.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 141 physical, scaling D in Strength and D in Dexterity. Each hit builds up blood loss (55). The skill on it is Shriek of Milos at 30 FP.
whenToUse: Sword of Milos needs 15 Strength and 19 Dexterity; it cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Sword of Milos

desc:
Greatsword made of light, modeled after the Elden Ring itself. Forged by the King Consort Radagon to proudly symbolize the tenets of the Golden Order. One of the legendary armaments.

Telltale signs betray that this was once the greatsword bequeathed to him by his first wife, Rennala.
location: Guaranteed drop: Cave of the Forlorn (Consecrated Snowfield) Received upon defeating the Misbegotten Crusader at the end of the Cave of the Forlorn, located in the Consecrated Snowfield.
whatItIs: A greatsword of 10 weight, Golden Order Greatsword hits with standard and pierce attacks. It comes from beating Misbegotten Crusader in Consecrated Snowfield.
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 86 physical attack and 103 holy, scaling E in Strength, D in Dexterity, and C in Faith. The skill on it is Establish Order at 20 FP.
whenToUse: It cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones, and Golden Order Greatsword needs 16 Strength, 21 Dexterity, and 28 Faith. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Golden Order Greatsword

desc:
A large sword with a long, straight blade. This heavy sword is usually wielded with two hands, but for those with enough strength, one is sufficient.

In addition to the heavy sweeping attacks, it can also make a heavy piercing thrust, making this a versatile weapon.
location: Loot: Castle Morne (Weeping Peninsula) Found in a chest in the castle. From the Castle Morne Lift Site of Grace and taking the elevator up, it's found in a building on the right, reached by climbing up the pile of bodies in the castle's courtyard.
whatItIs: Claymore is a greatsword weighing 9 with standard and pierce attacks. A chest at Castle Morne in Weeping Peninsula holds it.
whyItMatters: It starts at 138 physical attack and scales D in Strength and D in Dexterity. Weapon skill: Lion's Claw (20 FP).
whenToUse: It can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones, and Claymore needs 16 Strength and 13 Dexterity. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Claymore

desc:
Bronze greatsword wielded by Valiant Gargoyles.

Just like the wielder, the missing parts have been mended with corpse wax; a patchwork of champions.
location: Guaranteed drop: Siofra Aqueduct (Siofra River) Dropped by the Valiant Gargoyles duo boss, along with the Gargoyle's Twinblade.
whatItIs: Gargoyle's Greatsword belongs to the greatsword class at 11.5 weight, and its attack type is standard and pierce. It drops from Valiant Gargoyles in Siofra River.
whyItMatters: It starts at 133 physical attack and scales C in Strength and E in Dexterity. Weapon skill: Vacuum Slice (18 FP).
whenToUse: It can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones, and Gargoyle's Greatsword needs 18 Strength and 10 Dexterity. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Gargoyle's Greatsword

desc:
Barbed rod carried by Deathbirds.

The birds are graveyard fire keepers; it is said they rake out the ashen remains of the dead from their kilns.
location: Guaranteed drop: Caelid Dropped by the Death Rite Bird in Caelid, found southeast of the Southern Aeonia Swamp Bank Site of Grace at night. The high cliff to the east of the boss can be used to cheese it, as it's rather bad at scaling the rocks. Combined with anti-Those Who Live in Death...
whatItIs: Death's Poker belongs to the greatsword class at 8.5 weight, and its attack type is standard and pierce. Look for it as a drop from Death Rite Bird in Caelid.
whyItMatters: It starts at 123 physical attack with 36 magic on top and scales D in Strength, D in Dexterity, and E in Intelligence. Hits carry frostbite (65) buildup. Weapon skill: Ghostflame Ignition (15 FP).
whenToUse: It cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones, and Death's Poker needs 15 Strength, 17 Dexterity, and 11 Intelligence. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Death's Poker

desc:
Bronze greatsword wielded by Valiant Gargoyles, mended with blackened corpse wax. Deals holy damage.

Such is the mark of those who serve Maliketh, the Black Blade.
location: Guaranteed drop: Bestial Sanctum (Greyoll's Dragonbarrow) Dropped upon defeating the Black Blade Kindred outside of the Bestial Sanctum, along with the Gargoyle's Black Halberd.
whatItIs: Gargoyle's Blackblade belongs to the greatsword class at 11.5 weight, and its attack type is standard and pierce. Beat Black Blade Kindred in Greyoll's Dragonbarrow to get it.
whyItMatters: It starts at 102 physical attack with 122 holy on top and scales D in Strength, E in Dexterity, and D in Faith. The skill on it is Corpse Wax Cutter at 16 FP.
whenToUse: It cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones, and Gargoyle's Blackblade needs 18 Strength, 10 Dexterity, and 22 Faith. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Gargoyle's Blackblade

desc:
Weapon once wielded by Commander Gaius. A combination of greatsword and lance.

Weighty and capable of being brought to bear with great force, this armament shows its true potential when used astride a mount. Gaius himself was never without his boar.
location: Trade: Finger Reader Enia Can be obtained after trading Remembrance of the Wild Boar Rider with Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold. Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).
whatItIs: Sword Lance belongs to the heavy thrusting sword class at 9 weight, and its attack type is standard and pierce. The Remembrance of the Wild Boar Rider buys it.
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 132 physical attack, scaling C in Strength and E in Dexterity. Weapon skill: Impaling Thrust (9 FP).
whenToUse: Sword Lance needs 21 Strength and 11 Dexterity, can take Ashes of War and affinity changes, and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Sword Lance

desc:
Golden greatsword that once pierced the body of Midra, master of the manse. Used by hornsent in the execution of a damnation like no other.

The barbs that pierce the victim from within wind gently around the blade.
location: Trade: Finger Reader Enia Trade the Remembrance of the Lord of Frenzied Flame, gained by defeating Midra, Lord of Frenzied Flame, with Finger Reader Enia. Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).
whatItIs: A greatsword of 8 weight, Greatsword of Damnation hits with standard and pierce attacks. It is traded for the Remembrance of the Lord of Frenzied Flame at Roundtable Hold.
whyItMatters: It starts at 123 physical attack with 79 holy on top and scales D in Strength, E in Dexterity, and D in Faith. Weapon skill: Golden Crux (21 FP).
whenToUse: Greatsword of Damnation needs 20 Strength, 15 Dexterity, and 20 Faith, cannot be infused, and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Greatsword of Damnation

desc:
A peculiar weapon carried by Imps. Greatsword smithed in the shape of a fork-tongued lizard.

Strong attacks allow the wielder to fire the forked tongue from the blade.
location: Drop: Fog Rift Catacombs (Fog Rift Catacombs) / Scorpion River Catacombs (Rauh Base) 2% drop chance from Greatsword-wielding, Lion-Headed Imps found in Shadow of the Erdtree.
whatItIs: A greatsword of 9.5 weight, Lizard Greatsword hits with strike and pierce attacks. Dropped by Greatsword-wielding, Lion-Headed Imps (a 2% chance).
whyItMatters: It starts at 140 physical attack and scales D in Strength and D in Dexterity. Weapon skill: Stamp (Upward Cut) (5 FP).
whenToUse: Lizard Greatsword needs 12 Strength and 14 Dexterity, can take Ashes of War and affinity changes, and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Lizard Greatsword

desc:
Steel greatsword wielded by the Knights of the Solitary Gaol.

Through a secret rite, they relinquished their hearts for heightened battle prowess. Next, they engraved their blades with two crests: one depicting the light of birth, and the other, solitude.
location: Guaranteed drop: Western Nameless Mausoleum (Gravesite Plain) Dropped by the Knight of the Solitary Gaol found inside of the Western Nameless Mausoleum.
whatItIs: Greatsword of Solitude is a greatsword weighing 15.5 with standard and pierce attacks. Knight of the Solitary Gaol in Gravesite Plain can drop it.
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 120 physical attack, scaling B in Strength and E in Dexterity. Solitary Moon Slash is its weapon skill, costing 12 FP per use.
whenToUse: Greatsword of Solitude needs 27 Strength and 13 Dexterity; it cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Greatsword of Solitude

desc:
The knight Leontiel's favored weapon - a greatsword whose blade is wrapped in leather at the base.

Said to have been wielded by a proud order of orthodox knights long ago, weapons of this ilk demand high dexterity.
location: Received after defeating Knight Leontiel after she invades in the Wailing Dunes. Starscourge Radahn must be defeated prior, she will invade near the entrance to War-Dead Catacombs in the northern part of the area.
whatItIs: Leontiel's Greatsword is a greatsword weighing 9.5 with standard and pierce attacks. Knight Leontiel has to fall first before you get this weapon.
whyItMatters: It starts at 130 physical attack and scales E in Strength and C in Dexterity. Weapon skill: Muleta (1013 FP).
whenToUse: It cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones, and Leontiel's Greatsword needs 13 Strength and 26 Dexterity. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Leontiel's Greatsword

desc:
A coarse iron lump of an ultra greatsword. Mows down foes by utilizing its incredible weight. 

Though handling it likely requires the wielder to have surpassed the realm of the merely human, it is precisely for this reason the weapon is used to slaughter even inhuman foes.
location: Loot: Caelid The found in a chest on the backside of a Carriage beside the road heading northwest from Caelem Ruins. The location is southwest of the Minor Erdtree in Caelid and the Minor Erdtree Catacombs.
whatItIs: A colossal sword of 23 weight, Greatsword hits with standard attacks. Chest loot in Caelid.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 164 physical, scaling C in Strength and E in Dexterity. Weapon skill: Stamp (Upward Cut) (5 FP).
whenToUse: It can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones, and Greatsword needs 31 Strength and 12 Dexterity. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Greatsword

desc:
Stone greatsword wielded by Erdtree Burial Watchdogs.

Though decorated with the watchman's eye, the pupil was taken by graverobbers and is now hollow, leaving this sword a mere lump of stone.
location: Drop: Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave (Mountaintops of the Giants) / Giants' Mountaintop Catacombs (Mountaintops of the Giants) / Consecrated Snowfield Catacombs (Consecrated Snowfield) 8% drop chance from the non-boss variant of Erdtree Burial Watchdog. Most easily farmed in the Giant-Conquering...
whatItIs: Watchdog's Greatsword is a colossal sword weighing 22 with standard attacks. Enemies in Mountaintops of the Giants drop it (a 8% chance).
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 142 physical attack, scaling C in Strength and E in Dexterity. Weapon skill: Stamp (Upward Cut) (5 FP).
whenToUse: It can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones, and Watchdog's Greatsword needs 30 Strength and 10 Dexterity. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Watchdog's Greatsword

desc:
Maliketh's black blade which once harbored the power of the Rune of Death. A sad shadow of its former glory.

After a fragment of Death was stolen on that fateful night, Maliketh bound the blade within his own flesh, such that none might ever rob Death again.
location: Trade: Roundtable Hold Trade the Remembrance of the Black Blade, gained by defeating the Maliketh, the Black Blade, with Finger Reader Enia. Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).
whatItIs: Maliketh's Black Blade is a colossal sword weighing 22 with standard attacks. Trade in the Remembrance of the Black Blade with Finger Reader Enia to get it.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 127 physical plus 82 holy, scaling C in Strength, E in Dexterity, and D in Faith. Weapon skill: Destined Death (40 FP).
whenToUse: It cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones, and Maliketh's Black Blade needs 34 Strength, 12 Dexterity, and 20 Faith. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Maliketh's Black Blade

desc:
Sword given to the lesser giants who fought for the Erdtree during the War against the Giants long ago.

Though the giants have lost their minds, they stay inseparable from their swords that are in sad shape—such that the gold plating had flaked away.
location: Loot: Altus Plateau Found in a chest in the back of a Carriage in a Leyndell Soldier camp in-between the Erdtree-Gazing Hill and Altus Highway Junction Sites of Graces.
whatItIs: Troll's Golden Sword belongs to the colossal sword class at 19 weight, and its attack type is standard. Chest loot in Altus Plateau.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 155 physical, scaling D in Strength and D in Dexterity. Troll's Roar is its weapon skill, costing 22 FP per use.
whenToUse: It can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones, and Troll's Golden Sword needs 29 Strength and 10 Dexterity. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Troll's Golden Sword

desc:
Just about the largest sword a mere man is capable of swinging. True to its name, it is designed to be wielded in both hands, but those of merely ordinary strength will still struggle to do so.

The long blade is heavy and sharp, sending foes reeling back with its broader strokes, while also capable of a devastating piercing thrust.
location: Purchase: Weeping Peninsula One is sold for 3,500 Runes by the Isolated Merchant at the Isolated Merchant's Shack at the westernmost point of the Peninsula.
whatItIs: Zweihander belongs to the colossal sword class at 15.5 weight, and its attack type is standard and pierce. Isolated Merchant sells it for 3,500 runes in Weeping Peninsula.
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 141 physical attack, scaling D in Strength and D in Dexterity. Weapon skill: Stamp (Upward Cut) (5 FP).
whenToUse: It can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones, and Zweihander needs 19 Strength and 11 Dexterity. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Zweihander

desc:
Curved greatswords of black steel wielded by General Radahn. A pair of weapons decorated with a lion mane motif.

Radahn earned considerable renown as the Starscourge in his youth, and it is said that it was during this time he engraved the gravity crest upon these blades.
location: Trade: Roundtable Hold Trade the Remembrance of the Starscourge, gained by defeating the Starscourge Radahn, with Finger Reader Enia. Alternatively, use one of the belled Wandering Mausoleums to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).
whatItIs: Starscourge Greatsword belongs to the colossal sword class at 20 weight, and its attack type is standard. Trade in the Remembrance of the Starscourge with Finger Reader Enia to get it.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 129 physical plus 83 magic, scaling D in Strength, D in Dexterity, and E in Intelligence. The skill on it is Starcaller Cry at 20 FP.
whenToUse: Starscourge Greatsword needs 38 Strength, 12 Dexterity, and 15 Intelligence; it cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Starscourge Greatsword

desc:
Greatsword decorated in royal Carian Style. Favored weapon of Blaidd the Half-Wolf.

In defiance of the fate he was born to, Blaidd swore to serve no master but Ranni. As proof. the sword was imbued with a cold magic at the moment oath was sworn.
location: Guaranteed drop: Ranni's Rise (Three Sisters) Dropped by Blaidd, along with his armor set (except the Black Wolf Mask), when encountered at Ranni's Rise after Ranni the Witch's storyline has been completed. Killing him prior to this will award no items.
whatItIs: Royal Greatsword belongs to the colossal sword class at 20 weight, and its attack type is standard. Blaidd can drop it.
whyItMatters: It starts at 112 physical attack with 134 magic on top and scales D in Strength, E in Dexterity, and D in Intelligence. Wolf's Assault is its weapon skill, costing 20 FP per use.
whenToUse: Royal Greatsword needs 26 Strength, 18 Dexterity, and 22 Intelligence, cannot be infused, and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Royal Greatsword

desc:
Sacred sword of the Gloam-Eyed Queen who controlled the Godskin Apostles before her defeat at the hands of Maliketh.

The black flames wielded by the apostles are channeled from this sword.
location: Loot: Divine Tower of Caelid (Caelid) Found in a treasure chest at the end of the Divine Tower of Caelid, behind the Godskin Apostle boss.
whatItIs: Godslayer's Greatsword is a colossal sword weighing 17.5 with standard attacks. Chest loot at Divine Tower of Caelid in Caelid.
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 119 physical attack and 77 fire, scaling D in Strength, D in Dexterity, and D in Faith. Its weapon skill is The Queen's Black Flame, which costs 15 FP.
whenToUse: Godslayer's Greatsword needs 20 Strength, 22 Dexterity, and 20 Faith, cannot be infused, and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Godslayer's Greatsword

desc:
Originally rubble from a ruin which fell from the sky, this surviving fragment was honed into a weapon. One of the legendary armaments.

The ruin it came from crumbled when struck by a meteorite, as such this weapon harbors its destructive power.
location: Drop: Redmane Castle (Caelid) Obtained upon defeating the optional Misbegotten Warrior and Crucible Knight duo boss at the Redmane Castle plaza. Do note that this fight is only available whenever the Radahn festival isn't active. If it's currently active it can be deactivated by defeating...
whatItIs: Ruins Greatsword is a colossal sword weighing 23 with standard attacks. It is an enemy drop.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 124 physical plus 37 magic, scaling B in Strength and E in Intelligence. The skill is Wave of Destruction, 25 FP.
whenToUse: Ruins Greatsword needs 50 Strength and 16 Intelligence; it cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Ruins Greatsword

desc:
The storied sword of Castle Morne. A revenger's weapon, it is burdened with oceans of anger and regret. One of the legendary armaments.

A lone surviving champion from a country now vanished was so determined to continue fighting that he claimed the swords of an entire clan of warriors.
location: Guaranteed Drop: Castle Morne (Weeping Peninsula) Defeat the Leonine Misbegotten at the end of the castle.
whatItIs: A colossal sword of 21 weight, Grafted Blade Greatsword hits with standard attacks. Leonine Misbegotten has to fall first in Weeping Peninsula before you get this weapon.
whyItMatters: It starts at 162 physical attack and scales C in Strength and E in Dexterity. Weapon skill: Oath of Vengeance (20 FP).
whenToUse: Grafted Blade Greatsword needs 40 Strength and 14 Dexterity; it cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Grafted Blade Greatsword

desc:
Greatsword embedded with a blue glintstone. Weapon of the trolls in service to the royal family of Caria. 

Called into service when the Queen invoked an oath they swore, the trolls are treated as true knights of Caria, and fight arm in arm with their human comrades.
location: Guaranteed drop: Caria Manor (Liurnia of the Lakes) Guaranteed drop from the Troll Knight in Carian Manor, just before Royal Knight Loretta, the first time it's killed. Drop: Caria Manor / Converted Fringe Tower / The Four Belfries (Liurnia of the Lakes) 4% drop chance from all Troll Knights.
whatItIs: Troll Knight's Sword belongs to the colossal sword class at 18 weight, and its attack type is standard. Troll Knight in Liurnia of the Lakes can drop it (a 4% chance).
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 124 physical attack and 80 magic, scaling D in Strength, D in Dexterity, and D in Intelligence. Its weapon skill is Troll's Roar, which costs 22 FP.
