whenToUse: Troll Knight's Sword needs 20 Strength, 14 Dexterity, and 18 Intelligence, cannot be infused, and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Troll Knight's Sword

desc:
One of the treasures of the ruined forges. Greatsword of ancient meteoric ore, ending in a sharp point.

Fashioned from an excavated shard of an arrowhead that once was a part of the old gods' arsenal. A capable piercing weapon that excels at thrusting attacks.
location: Loot: Ruined Forge Starfall Past (Scadu Altus) Obtained upon examining the altar of the dungeon. The altar is found on the second level of the dungeon. To reach it, you must pull the lever to make the iron door rise, and use it as a platform to jump across to the second level where the altar is.
whatItIs: Ancient Meteoric Ore Greatsword belongs to the colossal sword class at 22 weight, and its attack type is standard and pierce. Ruined Forge Starfall Past in Scadu Altus is where it is found.
whyItMatters: It starts at 154 physical attack with 46 magic on top and scales D in Strength, E in Dexterity, and D in Arcane. The skill is White Light Charge, 10 FP.
whenToUse: Ancient Meteoric Ore Greatsword needs 35 Strength, 10 Dexterity, and 19 Arcane; it cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Ancient Meteoric Ore Greatsword

desc:
Greatsword of the Fire Knights. A long, slender blade that undulates like fire.

Blessed with a flame incantation. Further flame imbuement will amplify the effect and greatly increase the armament's power.
location: Drop: Shadow Keep, Church District / Specimen Storehouse (Shadow Keep) 4% drop chance from greatsword-wielding Fire Knights. One such knight can be found just before the elevator leading up to the Storehouse, First Floor Site of Grace. If the elevator is taken from the Grace the knight will...
whatItIs: A colossal sword of 16 weight, Fire Knight's Greatsword hits with standard and pierce attacks. An enemy drop in Shadow Keep (a 4% chance).
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 147 physical attack and 44 fire, scaling D in Strength, D in Dexterity, and D in Faith. Weapon skill: Stamp (Upward Cut) (5 FP).
whenToUse: Fire Knight's Greatsword needs 22 Strength, 18 Dexterity, and 12 Faith, can take Ashes of War and affinity changes, and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Fire Knight's Greatsword

desc:
Greatswords of black steel wielded by Radahn in his youth. A pair of weapons decorated with a lion mane motif.

These were in his possession immediately before his triumph over the stars - the swords of a lord who does not rely on physical strength and gravity alone.
location: Trade: Roundtable Hold Trade the Remembrance of a God and a Lord, gained by defeating the Promised Consort Radahn, with Finger Reader Enia. Alternatively, use one of the belled Wandering Mausoleums to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).
whatItIs: Greatsword of Radahn (Lord) belongs to the colossal sword class at 19 weight, and its attack type is standard and pierce. It comes from beating Promised Consort Radahn in Roundtable Hold.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 127 physical plus 82 magic, scaling D in Strength, D in Dexterity, and E in Intelligence. Promised Consort is its weapon skill, costing 20 FP per use.
whenToUse: Greatsword of Radahn (Lord) needs 32 Strength, 24 Dexterity, and 15 Intelligence; it cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Greatsword of Radahn (Lord)

desc:
Greatsword embedded with a blue glintstone. The favored weapon of the steadfast Carian knight, Moonrithyll.

Moonrithyll was the Twin Moon Knight's chamberlain. She was also a friend to the trolls, who served the royal family, and proudly wielded their weapons as she fought arm in arm with her gargantuan comrades.
location: Guaranteed drop: Castle Ensis Moonrithyll's Knight Sword can be obtained after defeating the NPC Moonrithyll, Carian Knight. She's found outside of the chapel halfway on the path between the Castle Ensis Checkpoint and Castle-Lord's Chamber Sites of Grace.
whatItIs: Moonrithyll's Knight Sword is a colossal sword weighing 18 with standard and pierce attacks. NPC Moonrithyll, Carian Knight has to fall first before you get this weapon.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 124 physical plus 80 magic, scaling D in Strength, D in Dexterity, and D in Intelligence. Weapon skill: Tremendous Phalanx (16 FP).
whenToUse: It cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones, and Moonrithyll's Knight Sword needs 20 Strength, 14 Dexterity, and 18 Intelligence. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Moonrithyll's Knight Sword

desc:
Greatswords of black steel wielded by Radahn in his youth. A pair of weapons decorated with a lion mane motif.

These were in his possession immediately before his triumph over the stars - the swords of a lord who does not rely on physical strength and gravity alone.
location: Trade: Roundtable Hold Trade the Remembrance of a God and a Lord, gained by defeating the Promised Consort Radahn, with Finger Reader Enia. Alternatively, use one of the belled Wandering Mausoleums to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).
whatItIs: Greatsword of Radahn (Light) is a colossal sword weighing 19 with standard and pierce attacks. Beat Promised Consort Radahn in Roundtable Hold to get it.
whyItMatters: It starts at 127 physical attack with 82 magic on top and scales D in Strength, D in Dexterity, and E in Intelligence. Lightspeed Slash is its weapon skill, costing 26 FP per use.
whenToUse: It cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones, and Greatsword of Radahn (Light) needs 32 Strength, 24 Dexterity, and 15 Intelligence. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Greatsword of Radahn (Light)

desc:
Large piercing sword with a long, hard bladed edge which is also capable of slashing attacks.

For its large size, it can be wielded rather nimbly, leaving little opportunity for the enemy to counter.
location: Starting equipment: The Prisoner origin starts with an Estoc. Purchase: Murkwater Cave (Limgrave) / Liurnia of the Lakes / Volcano Manor (Mt. Gelmir) One is sold for 3,000 Runes by the Nomadic Merchant in southern Liurnia of the Lakes, next to the Liurnia Lake Shore Site of Grace.
whatItIs: Estoc is a thrusting sword weighing 4.5 with standard and pierce attacks. You have it from the start of the game.
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 107 physical attack, scaling E in Strength and C in Dexterity. Impaling Thrust is its weapon skill, costing 9 FP per use.
whenToUse: It can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones, and Estoc needs 11 Strength and 13 Dexterity. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Estoc

desc:
Piercing sword of the Cleanrot Knights who fought alongside Malenia, Blade of Miquella.

Mainly used as a backup weapon, in combination with a long-handled armament.
location: Drop: Caelid / The Shaded Castle (Altus Plateau) / Consecrated Snowfield Catacombs (Consecrated Snowfield) / Miquella's Haligtree All Cleanrot Knights have a 4% drop chance for this weapon. The Swamp of Aeonia in Caelid is quite notably littered with Cleanrot Knights who will rise up when...
whatItIs: A thrusting sword of 4 weight, Cleanrot Knight's Sword hits with standard and pierce attacks. An enemy drop in Caelid (a 4% chance).
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 109 physical attack, scaling D in Strength and D in Dexterity. The skill is Impaling Thrust, 9 FP.
whenToUse: It can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones, and Cleanrot Knight's Sword needs 11 Strength and 13 Dexterity. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Cleanrot Knight's Sword

desc:
A piercing sword with a sharp, slender blade. In addition to this weapon's thrusting attack prowess, it also boasts the ability to be used while guarding with a shield.

As one of the smaller piercing swords, quick successive thrusts are easy to perform, but without a cutting edge, it cannot be used for slashing attacks.
location: Purchase: Roundtable Hold One is sold for 1,000 Runes by the Twin Maiden Husks.
whatItIs: Rapier is a thrusting sword weighing 2.5 with standard and pierce attacks. Twin Maiden Husks sells it for 1,000 runes in Roundtable Hold.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 96 physical, scaling E in Strength and C in Dexterity. The skill is Impaling Thrust, 9 FP. Its critical value is 130.
whenToUse: It can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones, and Rapier needs 7 Strength and 12 Dexterity. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Rapier

desc:
Piercing sword of superior quality, featuring intricate ornamentation. Signature weapon of the sorcerer Rogier.

High dexterity is required to wield the blade to its full potential, but mastery is a sight to behold, characterized by a flowing style which excels in successive attacks.
location: Quest reward: Roundtable Hold Given at +8 by Sorcerer Rogier after defeating Godrick the Grafted. It comes with Ash of War: Glintblade Phalanx pre-equipped on acquisition; however, its underlying base skill is Repeating Thrust.
whatItIs: Rogier's Rapier is a thrusting sword weighing 3.5 with standard and pierce attacks. It comes from beating Godrick the Grafted in Roundtable Hold.
whyItMatters: It starts at 93 physical attack and scales E in Strength and C in Dexterity. The skill on it is Repeating Thrust at 7 FP. Its critical value is 110.
whenToUse: Rogier's Rapier needs 8 Strength and 17 Dexterity, can take Ashes of War and affinity changes, and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Rogier's Rapier

desc:
Spur of a giant ant which has been fashioned into a rapier. The blade drips with scarlet rot.

Scarlet rot is an old legend, of which Maleigh Marais of the Shaded Castle was a private believer. And indeed, he eventually found his own personal goddess.
location: Guaranteed drop: The Shaded Castle (Altus Plateau) Dropped by Maleigh Marais, Shaded Castle Castellan, found just to the west of The Shaded Castle, together with a Guardian Golem.
whatItIs: Antspur Rapier is a thrusting sword weighing 3 with standard and pierce attacks. It drops from Maleigh Marais, Shaded Castle Castellan in Altus Plateau.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 98 physical, scaling D in Strength and D in Dexterity. Each hit builds up scarlet rot (55). Weapon skill: Impaling Thrust (9 FP).
whenToUse: Antspur Rapier needs 10 Strength and 20 Dexterity, can take Ashes of War and affinity changes, and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Antspur Rapier

desc:
A razor-thin piercing blade of ice. Forged by Iji, the Carian Royal Blacksmith.

Can inflict frost upon enemies, and launch its blade with a strong attack. The blade immediately regenerates.
location: Loot: Kingsrealm Ruins (Liurnia of the Lakes) Found inside a chest after beating the Royal Revenant boss inside the Kingsrealm Ruins.
whatItIs: Frozen Needle is a thrusting sword weighing 2.5 with standard and pierce attacks. Chest loot at Kingsrealm Ruins in Liurnia of the Lakes.
whyItMatters: It starts at 99 physical attack and scales E in Strength and D in Dexterity. It applies frostbite (60) buildup on hit. The skill is Impaling Thrust, 9 FP.
whenToUse: It cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones, and Frozen Needle needs 11 Strength and 18 Dexterity. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Frozen Needle

desc:
Estoc carried by wandering nobles. Made to be easy to wield.

Daubed with gold from tip to tail, it should fetch a good sum.
location: Drop: Limgrave / Liurnia of the Lakes / Altus Plateau / Mountaintops of the Giants / Consecrated Snowfield Low (0.5%) drop chance from those Wandering Noble enemies that wield it, specifically the ones wearing the Aristocrat Hat and Aristocrat Coat. There are two immediately to the north of the...
whatItIs: Noble's Estoc is a thrusting sword weighing 3.5 with standard and pierce attacks. An enemy drop in Limgrave.
whyItMatters: It starts at 104 physical attack and scales D in Strength and D in Dexterity. Weapon skill: Impaling Thrust (9 FP).
whenToUse: Noble's Estoc needs 9 Strength and 10 Dexterity; it can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Noble's Estoc

desc:
Ominous piercing sword with a winding blade. Carried by the noble servants of the Lord of Blood.

Designed to bore into flesh, causing severe blood loss at the wound. The extracted blood trickles gracefully down the length of the blade.
location: Guaranteed drop: Writheblood Ruins (Altus Plateau) Found in the cellar of the Writheblood Ruins, in a chest behind the Sanguine Noble boss. The Ruins are found just north of the Second Church of Marika.
whatItIs: Bloody Helice belongs to the heavy thrusting sword class at 8 weight, and its attack type is standard and pierce. A chest at Writheblood Ruins in Altus Plateau holds it.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 121 physical, scaling E in Strength, D in Dexterity, and D in Arcane. Hits carry blood loss (55) buildup. The skill is Dynast's Finesse, 5 FP.
whenToUse: Bloody Helice needs 16 Strength, 19 Dexterity, and 17 Arcane, cannot be infused, and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Bloody Helice

desc:
Elegant piercing sword with a celadon colored blade wielded by Godskin Nobles.

The nobles possess skill with the sword unmatched by any lowborn. Despite its size, successive attacks from this weapon are swifter than the eye can follow.
location: Guaranteed drop: Volcano Manor (Mt. Gelmir) Received upon defeating the Godskin Noble boss found in Volcano Manor.
whatItIs: Godskin Stitcher is a heavy thrusting sword weighing 7 with standard and pierce attacks. Beat Godskin Noble for it.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 127 physical, scaling D in Strength and D in Dexterity. The skill is Impaling Thrust, 9 FP.
whenToUse: It can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones, and Godskin Stitcher needs 14 Strength and 17 Dexterity. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Godskin Stitcher

desc:
Large rapier featuring a thin, sharp blade. Commonly used in life or death duels.

Like its smaller counterparts, it is made for thrusting attacks, and can be used while guarding with a shield.
location: Loot: Limgrave Acquired from a treasure chest by a tent in a Campsite by some Fallen Ruins east of the Agheel Lake South Site of Grace. It is guarded by two Kaiden Mercenaries and a particularly eagle-eyed Noble Sorcerer. ER Item Location Great Épée.png|Item acquired
whatItIs: Great Épée is a heavy thrusting sword weighing 6.5 with standard and pierce attacks. Found in a chest in Limgrave.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 124 physical, scaling D in Strength and D in Dexterity. The skill is Impaling Thrust, 9 FP.
whenToUse: Great Épée needs 15 Strength and 16 Dexterity, can take Ashes of War and affinity changes, and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Great Épée

desc:
Piercing Gravel Stone sword containing primeval lightning. A portion of the Dragonlord's power, gained from a remembrance.

This weapon commands great power over the paltry, mortal dragons of today.
location: Trade: Roundtable Hold Trade the Remembrance of the Dragonlord, gained by defeating Dragonlord Placidusax, with Finger Reader Enia. Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).
whatItIs: A heavy thrusting sword of 8 weight, Dragon King's Cragblade hits with standard and pierce attacks. It is traded for the Remembrance of the Dragonlord at Roundtable Hold.
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 92 physical attack and 59 lightning, scaling E in Strength and D in Dexterity. Thundercloud Form is its weapon skill, costing 28 FP per use.
whenToUse: It cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones, and Dragon King's Cragblade needs 18 Strength and 37 Dexterity. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Dragon King's Cragblade

desc:
Greatsword of the Fire Knight Queelign. A weighty piercing sword with a blade that undulates like fire.

Queelign devoted his all to the crusade, and remade his sword in the shape of the lance wielded by his liege—aspiring to become a second impaler.
location: Quest reward: Shadow Keep, Church District This weapon can be obtained in the Shadow Keep after giving Fire Knight Queelign the Iris of Occultation. That makes this weapon mutually exclusive with the Fire Knight Queelign Spirit Ash, requiring a second Journey to get both on the same character.
whatItIs: Queelign's Greatsword belongs to the heavy thrusting sword class at 7.5 weight, and its attack type is standard and pierce. Its location note points to Shadow Keep.
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 122 physical attack and 36 fire, scaling D in Strength, D in Dexterity, and D in Faith. Weapon skill: Impaling Thrust (9 FP).
whenToUse: It can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones, and Queelign's Greatsword needs 14 Strength, 18 Dexterity, and 12 Faith. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Queelign's Greatsword

desc:
A curved sword with a single-sided blade. Delivers slashing attacks with its sharp blade, but is ineffective against thick armor and hides covered in tough scales.

Wielders of the weapon employ a unique style that enhances attacks with spinning motions.
location: Drop: Limgrave / Coastal Cave (Limgrave) / Demi-Human Forest Ruins (Weeping Peninsula) / Lakeside Crystal Cave (Liurnia of the Lakes) / Lux Ruins (Altus Plateau) / Volcano Cave (Mt. Gelmir) / Mountaintops of the Giants / Cerulean Coast 2% drop chance from Demi-Humans wielding falchions,...
whatItIs: Falchion belongs to the curved sword class at 3.5 weight, and its attack type is slash. Look for it as a drop from Demi-Humans (a 2% chance) in Limgrave.
whyItMatters: It starts at 109 physical attack and scales D in Strength and D in Dexterity. Weapon skill: Spinning Slash (6 FP).
whenToUse: Falchion needs 9 Strength and 13 Dexterity; it can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Falchion

desc:
Curved sword forged of dull iron wielded by the beastmen of Farum Azula.

The blade is heavy but well-balanced. Comparatively easy to wield for the damage it delivers.
location: Drop: Crumbling Farum Azula 2% drop chance from the Curved Sword-wielding Azula Beastmen enemies, also including the variants with red lightning and with shields. 7 of them can be found just east of/before the Crumbling Beast Grave Site of Grace, 2 in the first room and 5 in the second.
whatItIs: Beastman's Curved Sword belongs to the curved sword class at 4 weight, and its attack type is slash. It drops from Curved Sword-wielding Azula Beastmen in Crumbling Farum Azula (a 2% chance).
whyItMatters: It starts at 113 physical attack and scales C in Strength and E in Dexterity. The skill is Spinning Slash, 6 FP.
whenToUse: It can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones, and Beastman's Curved Sword needs 13 Strength and 11 Dexterity. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Beastman's Curved Sword

desc:
Curved sword with a severely hooked blade. Its attacks can slip through an enemy's guard.

Made to hunt down humans, this weapon requires high dexterity to wield effectively.
location: Purchase: Siofra River 1 is sold for 2500 Runes by the Abandoned Merchant in lower Siofra River. The Merchant is atop a structure west of the Worshippers' Woods Site of Grace.
whatItIs: Shotel is a curved sword weighing 2 with slash attacks. Sold by Abandoned Merchant for 2,500 runes.
whyItMatters: It starts at 96 physical attack and scales E in Strength and D in Dexterity. Spinning Slash is its weapon skill, costing 6 FP per use.
whenToUse: Shotel needs 9 Strength and 19 Dexterity; it can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Shotel

desc:
Curved sword with a thin blade of ample length. Light of weight despite its larger size, its slicing attacks come in rapid succession.

A devastating powerful weapon in the hands of a skilled swordsman.
location: Loot: Highroad Cave (Limgrave) Found on a corpse on the biggest pillar in the body of water inside of Highroad Cave, guarded by two Giant Bats.
whatItIs: Shamshir is a curved sword weighing 3.5 with slash attacks. A corpse at Highroad Cave in Limgrave carries it.
whyItMatters: It starts at 108 physical attack and scales D in Strength and D in Dexterity. Weapon skill: Spinning Slash (6 FP).
whenToUse: Shamshir needs 7 Strength and 13 Dexterity; it can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Shamshir

desc:
Curved sword with a light, crescent-shaped blade. Used by the bandits who ran rampant in the wake of the Shattering.

Most of the blade is now darkened and covered in rust, but with enough dexterity this weapon may still stand up to some use.
location: Drop: Tombsward Ruins (Weeping Peninsula) / Church of the Plague (Caelid) / Sage's Cave (Altus Plateau) / Wyndham Ruins (Altus Plateau) / Capital Outskirts / Crumbling Farum Azula / Cerulean Coast / Charo's Hidden Grave 3% drop chance from the armored "Bandit" Skeletons and Bestial Skeletons...
whatItIs: A curved sword of 5 weight, Bandit's Curved Sword hits with slash attacks. Enemies in Weeping Peninsula drop it (a 3% chance).
whyItMatters: Base attack is 118 physical, scaling D in Strength and D in Dexterity. Weapon skill: Spinning Slash (6 FP).
whenToUse: Bandit's Curved Sword needs 11 Strength and 13 Dexterity, can take Ashes of War and affinity changes, and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Bandit's Curved Sword

desc:
Curved sword with a blade fashioned from the lava of Mt. Gelmir. An armament of the man-serpents, impossible for a human to have made.

Deals fire damage.
location: Drop: Volcano Manor 1% drop chance from the Man-Serpents wielding flaming swords. There are two Man-Serpents that drop this weapon, both of which can be found on the same path: from the Temple of Eiglay Site of Grace, head up the elevator back into the Manor and the first Magma Blade-wielding...
whatItIs: Magma Blade is a curved sword weighing 4 with slash attacks. It drops from Man-Serpents (a 1% chance).
whyItMatters: It starts at 96 physical attack with 62 fire on top and scales D in Strength, D in Dexterity, and D in Faith. Weapon skill: Magma Shower (12 FP).
whenToUse: Magma Blade needs 9 Strength, 15 Dexterity, and 16 Faith, cannot be infused, and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Magma Blade

desc:
Legends speak of a master of the sword garbed in blue, and his curved blade that was patterned after flowing water.

Strong attack unleashes a series of strikes akin to a dance, offering a glimpse into the legend.
location: Loot: Consecrated Snowfield Found in a chest in the back of a Great Coffin in the middle of the Consecrated Snowfield, starting just southwest of the Inner Consecrated Snowfield Site of Grace. At night the Coffin is guarded by two Night's Cavalry, making approaching it during daytime a much...
whatItIs: Flowing Curved Sword belongs to the curved sword class at 3.5 weight, and its attack type is slash. A chest in Consecrated Snowfield holds it.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 109 physical, scaling D in Strength and D in Dexterity. Weapon skill: Spinning Slash (6 FP).
whenToUse: Flowing Curved Sword needs 9 Strength and 17 Dexterity; it can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Flowing Curved Sword

desc:
Sword fashioned from a delicate wing, suffused with the magic of the stars. Strong attack unleashes a wave of enchanted light.

Crafted from a relic of the Naturalborn of the Void who is said to have assailed the Eternal City.
location: Loot: Uhl Palace Ruins Found inside a chest in Uhl Palace Ruins above a Malformed Star, located in Ainsel River and only reachable from Ainsel River Main. More specifically, start from Ainsel River Main Site of Grace and head down the tunnel. Take the left split in the road, guarded by a...
whatItIs: Wing of Astel is a curved sword weighing 2.5 with slash attacks. A chest at Uhl Palace Ruins in Ainsel River holds it.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 65 physical plus 78 magic, scaling E in Strength, D in Dexterity, and D in Intelligence. Weapon skill: Nebula (20 FP).
whenToUse: Wing of Astel needs 7 Strength, 17 Dexterity, and 20 Intelligence, cannot be infused, and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Wing of Astel

desc:
Unique curved sword, notched like shark's teeth. Weapon carried by corpse pillagers who prowl the sites of old battles.

The blade is tacky with blood and covered in hefty nicks, making it totally uneven. Life can be sinister indeed.
location: Loot: Mt. Gelmir After the stone bridge a bit west of the First Mt. Gelmir Campsite Site of Grace, the sword can be found on a corpse in a wagon next to the ladder leading upwards, right next to where the Grafted Scion lands.
whatItIs: A curved sword of 3.5 weight, Scavenger's Curved Sword hits with slash attacks. Looted from a corpse in Mt. Gelmir.
whyItMatters: It starts at 105 physical attack and scales D in Strength and D in Dexterity. Hits carry blood loss (45) buildup. Weapon skill: Spinning Slash (6 FP).
whenToUse: Scavenger's Curved Sword needs 9 Strength and 14 Dexterity; it can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Scavenger's Curved Sword

desc:
Storied sword and treasure of Castle Sol that depicts an eclipsed sun drained of color. One of the legendary armaments.

In Sol, the sight of an eclipse inspires a dreadful awe, preventing an onlooker from averting his gaze.
location: Loot: Castle Sol (Mountaintops of the Giants) The Eclipse Shotel is in front of the altar inside the Church of the Eclipse.
whatItIs: A curved sword of 3 weight, Eclipse Shotel hits with slash attacks. Look for it at Castle Sol in Mountaintops of the Giants.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 77 physical plus 77 holy, scaling E in Strength, D in Dexterity, and D in Faith. Weapon skill: Death Flare (16 FP).
whenToUse: Eclipse Shotel needs 10 Strength, 25 Dexterity, and 30 Faith, cannot be infused, and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Eclipse Shotel

desc:
Curved sword fashioned in the image of an ancient serpent deity and tool of a forgotten religion practiced on Mt. Gelmir.

Formerly used to offer up sacrifices, this sword restores HP upon slaying an enemy.
location: Loot: Ruin-Strewn Precipice (Liurnia of the Lakes) Found near a giant Land Octopus on an overhang reached by a ladder to the side just before reaching the ladder to the Ruin-Strewn Precipice Overlook Site of Grace. More specifically, on the same floor-level where the final ladder to the Site of...
whatItIs: Serpent-God's Curved Sword is a curved sword weighing 4 with slash attacks. Ruin-Strewn Precipice in Liurnia of the Lakes is where it is found.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 113 physical, scaling D in Strength and E in Dexterity. Weapon skill: Spinning Slash (6 FP).
whenToUse: Serpent-God's Curved Sword needs 13 Strength and 9 Dexterity; it can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Serpent-God's Curved Sword

desc:
A curved sword with a blade at both ends wielded by the Cemetery Shades, the insect-ridden grave keepers.

The blade is thin and sharp, and strong attack unleashes a far-reaching slash.
location: Guaranteed Drop: Gelmir Hero's Grave (Mt. Gelmir) Dropped by a Cemetery Shade found in a nook in Gelmir Hero's Grave, just before the final stretch of lava leading to the room with the Boss. Only dropped the first time it's killed. As the Chariot moves on this path, it will follow the Tarnished...
whatItIs: Mantis Blade is a curved sword weighing 4 with slash attacks. Cemetery Shade in Mt. Gelmir can drop it.
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 112 physical attack, scaling D in Strength and D in Dexterity. Weapon skill: Spinning Slash (6 FP).
whenToUse: Mantis Blade needs 10 Strength and 12 Dexterity; it can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Mantis Blade

desc:
A curved sword with a single-sided blade. Delivers slashing attacks with its sharp blade, but is ineffective against armor and hides covered in tough scales.

Smaller in size than most curved swords, it carves into enemies with quick, sharp cuts.
location: Starting Equipment: 2 are part of the starting equipment for the Warrior Origin. Purchase: Roundtable Hold 1 is sold for 600 Runes by the Twin Maiden Husks. Drop: Deathtouched Catacombs (Limgrave) / Tombsward Catacombs (Weeping Peninsula) / Black Knife Catacombs (Liurnia of the Lakes) / Auriza...
whatItIs: A curved sword of 3 weight, Scimitar hits with slash attacks. In practice, it is in your inventory from the very beginning.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 106 physical, scaling D in Strength and D in Dexterity. Weapon skill: Spinning Slash (6 FP).
whenToUse: Scimitar needs 7 Strength and 13 Dexterity; it can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Scimitar

desc:
Curved sword boasting a large blade. This weapon is designed to make use of its weight in combination with its sharp cutting edge.

A thoroughly reliable choice of weapon for those who can master its particulars.
location: Drop: Tombsward Catacombs (Weeping Peninsula) / Black Knife Catacombs (Liurnia of the Lakes) / Caelid Catacombs (Caelid) / Auriza Hero's Grave (Altus Plateau) / Gelmir Hero's Grave (Mt. Gelmir) / Stone Coffin Fissure 2% drop chance from the Skeleton enemies that wield it. They will solely be...
whatItIs: Grossmesser is a curved sword weighing 4.5 with slash attacks. Skeleton in Weeping Peninsula can drop it (a 2% chance).
whyItMatters: It starts at 115 physical attack and scales D in Strength and D in Dexterity. The skill is Spinning Slash, 6 FP.
whenToUse: It can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones, and Grossmesser needs 14 Strength and 12 Dexterity. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Grossmesser

desc:
Sharp blade sculpted into a twisted shape. A sword that has seen many years of use in the gravesite.

Said to serve as a medium for communion with spirits.
location: Loot: Cerulean Coast This weapon can be found in a triangular ravine behind the stranded coffin boat just northeast of the Cerulean Coast West Site of Grace. It's in the far right corner, near some gravestones and Demi-Humans.
whatItIs: A curved sword of 2.5 weight, Spirit Sword hits with slash attacks. Look for it in Cerulean Coast.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 92 physical plus 59 magic, scaling E in Strength, D in Dexterity, and D in Intelligence. Rancor Slash is its weapon skill, costing 12 FP per use.
whenToUse: Spirit Sword needs 8 Strength, 16 Dexterity, and 16 Intelligence; it cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Spirit Sword

desc:
Curved swords with long sickle-like blades. A pair of weapons made to be wielded in both hands

Forged by a hornsent in the name of revenge. "In vengeance for the flames, my blade I wield..."
location: Guaranteed drop: Shadow Keep / Ancient Ruins of Rauh / Enir-Ilim The Falx is a guaranteed drop depending on how the player interacts with Hornsent after Miquella's Great Rune breaks. If the player summons Hornsent to help defeat Messmer the Impaler, he will invade as a hostile NPC near the Rauh...
whatItIs: Falx is a curved sword weighing 4 with slash attacks. Messmer the Impaler has to fall first in Shadow Keep before you get this weapon.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 107 physical, scaling D in Strength and D in Dexterity. Hits carry blood loss (55) buildup. Its weapon skill is Revenger's Blade, which costs 15 FP.
whenToUse: It cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones, and Falx needs 12 Strength and 15 Dexterity. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Falx

desc:
Decorative swords ablaze with impassioned red. A pair of weapons made to be wielded in both hands.

Used by the dancers of Ranah. Strike enemies with a dancing assault when executing a strong attack.
location: Guaranteed Drop: Southern Nameless Mausoleum (Cerulean Coast) Dropped by the Dancer of Ranah, found inside of the Southern Nameless Mausoleum.
whatItIs: A curved sword of 3.5 weight, Dancing Blade of Ranah hits with slash attacks. It drops from Dancer of Ranah in Cerulean Coast.
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 88 physical attack, scaling B in Dexterity. The skill is Unending Dance, 2 FP.
whenToUse: Dancing Blade of Ranah needs 9 Strength and 20 Dexterity, cannot be infused, and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Dancing Blade of Ranah

desc:
Curved sword of the horned warriors, keepers of the tower.

The ornamental tangled horns allow the blade to serve as a medium for horn-calling.
location: Drop: Belurat, Tower Settlement / Rauh Base / Midra's Manse / Ancient Ruins of Rauh 4% drop rate from dual-wielding Horned Warriors. One can be found in the Belurat Tower Settlement Swamp. An easy one to farm is located just up the stairs from the Small Private Altar Site of Grace in Belurat,...
whatItIs: Horned Warrior's Sword belongs to the curved sword class at 5 weight, and its attack type is slash. An enemy drop in Ancient Ruins of Rauh (a 4% chance).
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 108 physical attack, scaling D in Strength, D in Dexterity, and E in Faith. The skill on it is Horn Calling at 17 FP.
whenToUse: It cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones, and Horned Warrior's Sword needs 11 Strength, 14 Dexterity, and 14 Faith. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Horned Warrior's Sword

desc:
Greatsword forged from golden-hued meteoric ore. The blade conceals gravity-manipulating magic.

A weapon unique to the Onyx Lords, a race of ancients with skin of stone who were said to have risen to life when a meteor struck long ago.
location: Guaranteed drop: Sealed Tunnel (Capital Outskirts) Dropped by the Onyx Lord boss at the end of the Sealed Tunnel in Capital Outskirts.
whatItIs: Onyx Lord's Greatsword belongs to the curved greatsword class at 11.5 weight, and its attack type is slash. It drops from Onyx Lord.
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 118 physical attack and 76 magic, scaling D in Strength, E in Dexterity, and D in Intelligence. Weapon skill: Onyx Lord's Repulsion (27 FP).
whenToUse: It cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones, and Onyx Lord's Greatsword needs 20 Strength, 16 Dexterity, and 16 Intelligence. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Onyx Lord's Greatsword

desc:
This curved greatsword wielded by the brawny sellswords of Kaiden combines the blades of a scimitar with the heft of a hatchet.

A difficult to handle weapon that demands much of the wielder's strength and dexterity, but with practice and ability, it can serve as a versatile weapon even on horseback.
location: Drop: Limgrave / Weeping Peninsula / Mountaintops of the Giants 4% drop chance from Kaiden Sellswords. Two Sellswords can be found apart on the path between Stormhill Shack and Warmaster's Shack in Limgrave. Four Sellswords can be found at an unmarked camp northeast of the Agheel Lake North Site...
whatItIs: Dismounter belongs to the curved greatsword class at 10 weight, and its attack type is slash. Dropped by Kaiden Sellswords (a 4% chance).
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 138 physical attack, scaling D in Strength and D in Dexterity. The skill is Spinning Slash, 6 FP.
whenToUse: Dismounter needs 19 Strength and 16 Dexterity, can take Ashes of War and affinity changes, and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Dismounter

desc:
Curved greatsword with a gently undulating blade wielded by Bloodhound Knights.

A fearsome blade capable of brutal airborne attacks.
location: Guaranteed drop: Forlorn Hound Evergaol (Limgrave) Dropped by Bloodhound Knight Darriwil in the Forlorn Hound Evergaol in southern Limgrave. Blaidd the Half-Wolf will direct the Tarnished here as part of his questline, and will be available for summoning in the Evergaol before awakening Darriwil...
whatItIs: Bloodhound's Fang belongs to the curved greatsword class at 11.5 weight, and its attack type is slash. Bloodhound Knight Darriwil in Limgrave can drop it.
whyItMatters: It starts at 141 physical attack and scales D in Strength and C in Dexterity. Each hit builds up blood loss (55). Its weapon skill is Bloodhound's Finesse, which costs 8 FP.
whenToUse: It cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones, and Bloodhound's Fang needs 18 Strength and 17 Dexterity. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Bloodhound's Fang

desc:
Curved greatsword wielded by Magma Wyrms. The shape resembles a dragon's jaw and is covered in hard scales.

It's said these land-bound dragons were once human heroes who partook in dragon communion, a grave transgression for which they were cursed to crawl the earth upon their bellies, shadows of their former selves.
location: Guaranteed Drop: Ruin-Strewn Precipice (Liurnia of the Lakes) Received upon defeating Magma Wyrm Makar at the end of the dungeon.
whatItIs: Magma Wyrm's Scalesword is a curved greatsword weighing 15 with slash attacks. Beat Magma Wyrm Makar in Liurnia of the Lakes to get it.
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 114 physical attack and 74 fire, scaling C in Strength, D in Dexterity, and D in Faith. Its weapon skill is Magma Guillotine, which costs 20 FP.
whenToUse: It cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones, and Magma Wyrm's Scalesword needs 24 Strength, 15 Dexterity, and 18 Faith. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Magma Wyrm's Scalesword

desc:
Weapon wielded by the knights of Zamor who earned great renown during the War against the Giants.

In apparent devotion to winter, the curved blade is styled after an icy wind and imbued with a powerful frost effect.
location: Guaranteed drop: Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave (Mountaintops of the Giants) Dropped by the Ancient Hero of Zamor boss at the end of the Hero's Grave.
whatItIs: Zamor Curved Sword is a curved greatsword weighing 9 with slash attacks. Ancient Hero of Zamor in Mountaintops of the Giants can drop it.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 130 physical, scaling D in Strength and D in Dexterity. Each hit builds up frostbite (65). Its weapon skill is Zamor Ice Storm, which costs 15 FP.
whenToUse: Zamor Curved Sword needs 16 Strength and 18 Dexterity, cannot be infused, and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Zamor Curved Sword

desc:
Heavy-bladed curved sword of colossal size awarded to Omen as a tool of war. This weapon is made to take advantage of brute strength.

The pattern etched upon the blade is the remnant of a deteriorative malediction. Indeed, when bestowing a weapon, preparations must be made for taking it away.
location: Drop: Stormveil Castle / Cliffbottom Catacombs (Liurnia of the Lakes / Altus Plateau / Subterranean Shunning-Grounds 4% drop chance from sword-wielding Omens. One can be found just outside of hte Liftside Chamber Site of Grace in Stormveil Castle, sitting beside a Stray (a Beast-Repellent Torch...
whatItIs: Omen Cleaver is a curved greatsword weighing 11.5 with slash attacks. It is an enemy drop (a 4% chance).
whyItMatters: It starts at 142 physical attack and scales D in Strength and D in Dexterity. Weapon skill: Spinning Slash (6 FP).
whenToUse: It can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones, and Omen Cleaver needs 19 Strength and 16 Dexterity. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Omen Cleaver

desc:
Curved sword with a flickering flame motif. Wielded by the Fire Monks who came out from the Mountaintops of the Giants.

The monks came to the land of Liurnia in pursuit of a fugitive who stole their fire.
location: Drop: Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave (Mountaintops of the Giants) 4% chance to drop from Fire Monk enemies that wield it within the Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave. Note that it does NOT drop from any Blackflame Monks that wield it. From the Site of Grace at the entrance, head further down the...
whatItIs: Monk's Flameblade is a curved greatsword weighing 9 with slash attacks. It drops from Fire Monk in Mountaintops of the Giants (a 4% chance).
whyItMatters: Base attack is 134 physical, scaling D in Strength and D in Dexterity. The skill is Spinning Slash, 6 FP.
whenToUse: Monk's Flameblade needs 18 Strength and 18 Dexterity; it can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Monk's Flameblade

desc:
Curved greatsword of colossal size forged of dull iron and wielded by the beastmen of Farum Azula.

The blade is incredibly heavy, but well-balanced. Comparatively easy to wield for the damage it delivers. It's clear the beastmen possess knowledge beyond human ken.
location: Drop: The Four Belfries (Liurnia of the Lakes) / Crumbling Farum Azula 2% drop chance from Cleaver-wielding Beastmen. It can be found at the earliest by taking the "Crumbling Lands" Waygate at The Four Belfries, alongside a throwing knife-wielding one. These will be scaled for Farum Azula rather...
whatItIs: Beastman's Cleaver belongs to the curved greatsword class at 16.5 weight, and its attack type is slash. Cleaver-wielding Beastmen in Liurnia of the Lakes can drop it (a 2% chance).
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 143 physical attack, scaling C in Strength. Weapon skill: Spinning Slash (6 FP).
whenToUse: It can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones, and Beastman's Cleaver needs 25 Strength and 14 Dexterity. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Beastman's Cleaver

desc:
Warped blade of shifting hue used by Morgott, the Omen King.

The accursed blood that Morgott recanted and sealed away reformed into this blade.
location: Trade: Roundtable Hold Trade the Remembrance of the Omen King, gained by defeating the Morgott, the Omen King, with Finger Reader Enia. Alternatively, use one of the belled Wandering Mausoleums to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).
whatItIs: Morgott's Cursed Sword belongs to the curved greatsword class at 7.5 weight, and its attack type is slash. The Remembrance of the Omen King buys it.
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 120 physical attack, scaling E in Strength, C in Dexterity, and D in Arcane. Each hit builds up blood loss (60). Cursed-Blood Slice is its weapon skill, costing 20 FP per use. Its critical value is 110.
whenToUse: It cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones, and Morgott's Cursed Sword needs 14 Strength, 35 Dexterity, and 17 Arcane. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Morgott's Cursed Sword

desc:
Weapon wielded by the Putrescent Knight. A great cleaver of hardened putrescence affixed to an arch fashioned from human bones.

Gains power from the wielder's arcane attribute.
location: Trade: Remembrance of Putrescence Trade the Remembrance of Putrescence with Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold. Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).
whatItIs: Putrescence Cleaver belongs to the greataxe class at 13.5 weight, and its attack type is slash. Trade in the Remembrance of Putrescence with Finger Reader Enia to get it.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 141 physical plus 42 magic, scaling D in Strength, E in Dexterity, and D in Arcane. It applies frostbite (55) buildup on hit. The skill is Spinning Guillotine, 12 FP.
whenToUse: Putrescence Cleaver needs 28 Strength, 10 Dexterity, and 15 Arcane, cannot be infused, and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Putrescence Cleaver

desc:
Weapon of Freyja, a Redmane. Greatsword decorated with a mane, much like the weapons used by her liege.

The spirit of Freyja's training lingers in this sword, enhancing the power of Redmane battle skills.
location: Drop: Specimen Storehouse (Shadow Keep) / Enir-Ilim This weapon can be obtained wherever Redmane Freyja dies. If you gave her Freyja's Letter, you can find Freyja's Greatsword on her body after defeating her during the boss against Needle Knight Leda and her allies.
whatItIs: Freyja's Greatsword is a curved greatsword weighing 14 with slash attacks. It is an enemy drop.
whyItMatters: It starts at 146 physical attack and scales C in Strength and E in Dexterity. The skill is Spinning Slash, 6 FP.
whenToUse: Freyja's Greatsword needs 25 Strength and 14 Dexterity; it can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Freyja's Greatsword

desc:
Curved greatsword of the horned warriors, keepers of the tower. A heavy weapon made to bring the deft strength of the warriors to bear.

The ornamental tangled horns allow the blade to serve as a medium for horn-calling.
location: Guaranteed Drop: Enir-Ilim (Land of the Tower) Obtained from the Wind-aspected Divine Beast Warrior found towards the end of Enir-Ilim on the bridge to the Cleansing Chamber Anteroom Site of Grace.
whatItIs: Horned Warrior's Greatsword belongs to the curved greatsword class at 13 weight, and its attack type is slash. It comes from Wind-aspected Divine Beast Warrior in Enir-Ilim.
whyItMatters: It starts at 130 physical attack and scales D in Strength, D in Dexterity, and D in Faith. The skill is Horn Calling: Storm, 20 FP.
whenToUse: Horned Warrior's Greatsword needs 19 Strength, 16 Dexterity, and 13 Faith; it cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Horned Warrior's Greatsword

desc:
A curved blade of considerable size whose keen edge is only made more deadly by its imposing weight.

This curved greatsword demands both strength and dexterity of its wielder, rewarding those capable of mastering it with great, sweeping slashes that mow through multiple foes at once.
location: Starting Weapon: Heavy Knight The Hefty Scimitar is the starting weapon for the Heavy Knight. Purchase: Limgrave The Hefty Scimitar is purchased from the Nomadic Merchant in eastern Limgrave for 2,400 Runes.
whatItIs: A curved greatsword of 9.5 weight, Hefty Scimitar hits with slash attacks. Nomadic Merchant sells it for 2,400 runes in Limgrave.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 135 physical, scaling D in Strength and D in Dexterity. Weapon skill: Spinning Slash (6 FP).
whenToUse: It can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones, and Hefty Scimitar needs 13 Strength and 11 Dexterity. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Hefty Scimitar

desc:
A katana with a long single-edged curved blade. A unique weapon wielded by the samurai from the Land of Reeds.

The blade, with its undulating design, boasts extraordinary sharpness, and its slash attacks cause blood loss.
location: Starting equipment: 1 is part of the starting equipment for the Samurai Origin. Loot: Deathtouched Catacombs (Limgrave) 1 is found in the Deathtouched Catacombs on the hidden platform with a Skeleton Archer, just before the lever. This spot is reached by going through an Illusory Wall on the...
whatItIs: A curved single-edged katana that the Samurai class starts with. It cuts quickly, reaches further than a straight sword, and every hit adds blood loss buildup to whatever it touches.
whyItMatters: Blood loss triggers a burst of damage based on the target's own maximum health, which is why a modest-looking katana can out-damage far heavier weapons against big bosses. It scales mostly with Dexterity, accepts an Ash of War, and is available at the very start of the game, so a build can commit to it immediately without hunting for a drop.
whenToUse: Pick it up in the first minutes as a Samurai, or buy it early if you rolled anything else and want a bleed build. It stays viable to the end of the base game; swap off it only when you want a weapon art that its moveset cannot deliver.
name: Uchigatana

desc:
Katana with a ferociously long blade. Signature weapon of Yura, hunter of Bloody Fingers.

Reminiscent of a reinforced spear, its imposing length can be put to good use with powerful thrusting attacks.
location: Loot: Limgrave / Liurnia of the Lakes / Altus Plateau / Mountaintops of the Giants The Nagakiba is either dropped by Bloody Finger Hunter Yura at the end of his questline at the Second Church of Marika or after being killed by the player. If the player visits the Three Fingers and inherits the...
whatItIs: Nagakiba is a katana weighing 7 with slash and pierce attacks. Look for it as a drop from Bloody Finger Hunter Yura in Limgrave.
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 115 physical attack, scaling D in Strength and C in Dexterity. Hits carry blood loss (45) buildup. The skill is Unsheathe, 1015 FP.
whenToUse: Nagakiba needs 18 Strength and 22 Dexterity, can take Ashes of War and affinity changes, and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Nagakiba

desc:
Blade built into Malenia's prosthetic arm. Through consecration it is resistant to rot.

Malenia's war prosthesis symbolized her victories. 

Some claim to have seen wings when the weapon was raised aloft; wings of fierce determination that have never known defeat.
location: Trade: Finger Reader Enia Trade the Remembrance of the Rot Goddess, gained by defeating Malenia, Blade of Miquella, with Finger Reader Enia. Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums with a bell to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).
whatItIs: A katana of 7 weight, Hand of Malenia hits with slash and pierce attacks. Trade in the Remembrance of the Rot Goddess with Finger Reader Enia to get it.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 117 physical, scaling E in Strength and C in Dexterity. It applies blood loss (50) buildup on hit. The skill is Waterfowl Dance, 12 FP.
whenToUse: Hand of Malenia needs 16 Strength and 48 Dexterity; it cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Hand of Malenia

desc:
Katana forged from meteoric ore to dispatch lifeforms born of falling stars. Deals magic damage.

The blade is weighty known to deliver slashes of such ferocity that the impact is said to resemble the crash of a falling meteor.
location: Loot: Caelid Waypoint Ruins (Caelid) Found in the underground chambers in the northwest section of the Caelid Waypoint Ruins. It is inside of a chest behind a door in the far corner of the room.
whatItIs: Meteoric Ore Blade is a katana weighing 7.5 with slash and pierce attacks. Chest loot at Caelid Waypoint Ruins in Caelid.
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 112 physical attack and 72 magic, scaling D in Strength, E in Dexterity, and D in Intelligence. Hits carry blood loss (50) buildup. Weapon skill: Gravitas (13 FP).
whenToUse: Meteoric Ore Blade needs 15 Strength, 14 Dexterity, and 18 Intelligence, cannot be infused, and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Meteoric Ore Blade

desc:
Weapon of Okina, swordsman from the Land of Reeds. A cursed weapon that has felled countless men.

When Mohg, the Lord of Blood, first felt Okina's sword, and madness, upon his flesh, he had a proposal, to offer Okina the life of a demon, whose thirst would never go unsated.
location: Guaranteed Drop: Mountaintops of the Giants Defeat Okina at the Church of Repose.
whatItIs: A katana of 6.5 weight, Rivers of Blood hits with slash and pierce attacks. It comes from beating Okina in Mountaintops of the Giants.
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 76 physical attack and 76 fire, scaling E in Strength, D in Dexterity, and D in Arcane. Each hit builds up blood loss (50). Weapon skill: Corpse Piler (17 FP).
whenToUse: Rivers of Blood needs 12 Strength, 18 Dexterity, and 20 Arcane, cannot be infused, and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Rivers of Blood

desc:
Katana forged of glintstone. Masterpiece of a Sellian swordsmith.

Light enwreathes the blade when sheathed, explaining its Moonveil moniker.
location: Guaranteed Drop: Gael Tunnel (Caelid) Dropped by the Magma Wyrm in Gael Tunnel.
whatItIs: A katana of 6.5 weight, Moonveil hits with slash and pierce attacks. Magma Wyrm in Caelid can drop it.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 73 physical plus 87 magic, scaling E in Strength, D in Dexterity, and C in Intelligence. Hits carry blood loss (50) buildup. The skill on it is Transient Moonlight at 1520 FP.
whenToUse: Moonveil needs 12 Strength, 18 Dexterity, and 23 Intelligence; it cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Moonveil

desc:
A weapon made by sharpening a Gravel Stone scale, thought to be the source of ancient dragon immortality, into an unclouded blade.

Alas, the Dragonkin Soldiers never attained immortality, and perished as decrepit, pale imitations of their skyborn kin.
location: Guaranteed Drop: Lake of Rot (Ainsel River) Dropped by the Dragonkin Soldier boss in the Lake of Rot. A platform can be raised by buttons in the immediate area, making it slightly easier to fight the boss without constantly being afflicted with Scarlet Rot.
whatItIs: Dragonscale Blade is a katana weighing 5.5 with slash and pierce attacks. Dropped by Dragonkin Soldier.
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 110 physical attack, scaling D in Strength and C in Dexterity. Its weapon skill is Ice Lightning Sword, which costs 28 FP.
whenToUse: Dragonscale Blade needs 12 Strength and 20 Dexterity, cannot be infused, and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Dragonscale Blade

desc:
Sinister katana modeled after a serpent bone.

The densely packed row of spines that jut away from the cutting edge are coated in a lethal poison.
location: Quest reward: Volcano Manor Obtained from Tanith, Volcano Manor Proprietress after defeating Rileigh the Idle. This reward can still be received after defeating the Lord of Blasphemy as long as the second Letter from Volcano Manor was obtained beforehand. In this case the Serpentbone Blade...
whatItIs: Serpentbone Blade belongs to the katana class at 6 weight, and its attack type is slash and pierce. It comes from Tanith, Volcano Manor Proprietress.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 120 physical, scaling E in Strength and C in Dexterity. It applies poison (66) buildup on hit. Weapon skill: Double Slash (6 FP).
whenToUse: It cannot be infused and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones, and Serpentbone Blade needs 11 Strength and 22 Dexterity. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Serpentbone Blade

desc: Sword of an all-consuming, bottomless black that devours even the light that shines upon it. Wielded by Jolán, Swordhand of Night. The blade of the sword is only semicorporeal, and thus cannot be guarded against completely.
location: Quest Reward: Cathedral of Manus Metyr (Scadu Altus) Defeat Metyr, Mother of Fingers by following Count Ymir's questline and then defeat both him and Jolán, Swordhand of Night. Reload the area, and the player will find Jolán sitting on the ground against the pillar when she usually stands. Give...
whatItIs: A katana of 6.5 weight, Sword of Night hits with slash and pierce attacks. Beat Metyr, Mother of Fingers in Scadu Altus to get it.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 110 physical plus 33 magic, scaling C in Dexterity. Hits carry blood loss (45) buildup. The skill on it is Witching Hour Slash at 21 FP.
whenToUse: Sword of Night needs 11 Strength and 20 Dexterity; it cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Sword of Night

desc:
A sword with blades on both sides of the hilt. This weapon is difficult to wield and demands high dexterity.

Can be wielded with a single hand, but its true strength is unlocked with dual-handed spinning attacks.
location: Loot: Dragon-Burnt Ruins (Limgrave) Found in a chest in the southeastern basement room of the Ruins, the one without the Rats, that is reached by using Torrent to jump over a crumbled wall into an enclosure.
whatItIs: A twinblade of 7 weight, Twinblade hits with standard and pierce attacks. A chest at Dragon-Burnt Ruins in Limgrave holds it.
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 119 physical attack, scaling D in Strength and D in Dexterity. The skill is Spinning Slash, 6 FP.
whenToUse: Twinblade needs 10 Strength and 18 Dexterity, can take Ashes of War and affinity changes, and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Twinblade

desc:
Unique twinblade wielded by Godskin Apostles characterized by its disturbing design. One end features a sickle for slicing attacks while the other boasts a winding spike for boring into flesh.

Much skill is required to wield this weapon due to its asymmetric nature.
location: Guaranteed Drop: Dominula, Windmill Village (Altus Plateau) Dropped by the Godskin Apostle at the end of Dominula, Windmill Village.
whatItIs: A twinblade of 8 weight, Godskin Peeler hits with standard and pierce attacks. Godskin Apostle in Altus Plateau can drop it.
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 121 physical attack, scaling E in Strength and C in Dexterity. The skill on it is Black Flame Tornado at 30 FP.
whenToUse: Godskin Peeler needs 17 Strength and 22 Dexterity, can take Ashes of War and affinity changes, and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Godskin Peeler

desc:
An attractive twinblade of fine make that prizes the chivalric way.

Can be wielded with a single hand, but its true strength is unlocked with dual-handed spinning attacks.
location: Loot: East Windmill Pasture (Altus Plateau) Found on a corpse just northwest of the East Windmill Pasture.
whatItIs: Twinned Knight Swords is a twinblade weighing 8 with standard and pierce attacks. Corpse loot at East Windmill Pasture.
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 122 physical attack, scaling D in Strength and E in Dexterity. Weapon skill: Spinning Slash (6 FP).
whenToUse: Twinned Knight Swords needs 16 Strength and 18 Dexterity, can take Ashes of War and affinity changes, and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Twinned Knight Swords

desc:
Twinned naginata forged in the Land of Reeds. Chosen weapon of Eleonora, Violet Bloody Finger.

Her mastery of the sword was such that her onslaught was likened to a whirlwind, but now her legacy is stained by accursed blood.
location: Guaranteed Drop: Altus Plateau Dropped by the invader Eleonora, Violet Bloody Finger at the Second Church of Marika. Eleonora spawns at the Church regardless if the Tarnished is doing Yura's questline or not.
whatItIs: Eleonora's Poleblade is a twinblade weighing 6 with standard and pierce attacks. An enemy drop in Altus Plateau.
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 72 physical attack and 72 fire, scaling E in Strength, D in Dexterity, and D in Arcane. Each hit builds up blood loss (55). Bloodblade Dance is its weapon skill, costing 11 FP per use.
whenToUse: Eleonora's Poleblade needs 12 Strength, 21 Dexterity, and 19 Arcane, cannot be infused, and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Eleonora's Poleblade

desc:
Bronze twinblade wielded by Valiant Gargoyles.

Just like the wielder, the missing parts have been mended with corpse wax; a patchwork of champions.
location: Guaranteed Drop: Siofra River Dropped by the Valiant Gargoyle duo boss, along with the Gargoyle's Greatsword.
whatItIs: Gargoyle's Twinblade belongs to the twinblade class at 8.5 weight, and its attack type is standard and pierce. Look for it as a drop from Valiant Gargoyle in Siofra River.
whyItMatters: It starts at 123 physical attack and scales C in Strength and E in Dexterity. Weapon skill: Spinning Slash (6 FP).
whenToUse: Gargoyle's Twinblade needs 18 Strength and 15 Dexterity, can take Ashes of War and affinity changes, and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Gargoyle's Twinblade

desc:
Bronze twinblade wielded by Valiant Gargoyles, mended with blackened corpse wax. Deals holy damage.

Such is the mark of those who serve Maliketh, the Black Blade.
location: Guaranteed drop: Grand Lift of Rold (Forbidden Lands) Received upon defeating Black Blade Kindred before the Grand Lift of Rold, along with the Gargoyle's Black Axe.
whatItIs: Gargoyle's Black Blades is a twinblade weighing 8.5 with standard and pierce attacks. Black Blade Kindred has to fall first before you get this weapon.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 81 physical plus 97 holy, scaling C in Strength, E in Dexterity, and D in Faith. Weapon skill: Spinning Slash (6 FP).
whenToUse: Gargoyle's Black Blades needs 18 Strength, 15 Dexterity, and 22 Faith; it cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Gargoyle's Black Blades

desc:
Twinblade symbolizing abundance. The secret treasure of the tower.

Though the blades, fashioned from golden shoots, are largely wilted and darkened, their luster can be restored by dealing damage to foes. However, damage dealt to Those Who Live in Death will have no such effect.
location: Loot: Enir-Ilim This armament is technically found in Belurat, Tower Settlement, however, reaching it can only be done through Enir-Ilim. On the stairs past the lightning-aspected Divine Beast Warrior, jump off the path onto a lower staircase and then follow the ledges down until you reach a...
whatItIs: Euporia belongs to the twinblade class at 8.5 weight, and its attack type is standard and pierce. Enir-Ilim is where it is found.
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 84 physical attack and 100 holy, scaling D in Strength, D in Dexterity, and D in Faith. Euporia Vortex is its weapon skill, costing 28 FP per use.
whenToUse: Euporia needs 16 Strength, 16 Dexterity, and 24 Faith, cannot be infused, and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Euporia

desc:
Weapon of the Black Knights, servants of Messmer the Impaler. Twinblade of black steel with decorative embellishments in gold.

Blessed with an Erdtree incantation. Further holy imbuement will amplify the effect and greatly increase the armament's power.
location: Guaranteed Drop: Scadu Altus Guaranteed drop from the Black Knight at the top of the western hill camp off to the side of the encampment in front of the Shadow Keep, or northeast of Church of the Crusade.
whatItIs: Black Steel Twinblade belongs to the twinblade class at 8 weight, and its attack type is standard and pierce. It drops from Black Knight in Scadu Altus.
whyItMatters: It starts at 112 physical attack with 33 holy on top and scales D in Strength, D in Dexterity, and D in Faith. Weapon skill: Spinning Slash (6 FP).
whenToUse: Black Steel Twinblade needs 18 Strength, 15 Dexterity, and 13 Faith, can take Ashes of War and affinity changes, and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Black Steel Twinblade

desc:
An iron bludgeon with sharp protrusions.

Striking attacks have few drawbacks, potent as they are at breaking through guards and stances. Most suited to head on slugging matches.
location: Purchase: Roundtable Hold One is sold for 800 Runes by the Twin Maiden Husks.
whatItIs: Mace belongs to the hammer class at 4.5 weight, and its attack type is strike. It is for sale from Twin Maiden Husks for 800 runes in Roundtable Hold.
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 115 physical attack, scaling D in Strength and D in Dexterity. Its weapon skill is Kick.
whenToUse: Mace needs 12 Strength and 7 Dexterity, can take Ashes of War and affinity changes, and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Mace

desc:
A thick, solid lump of wood. Wielding this striking weapon requires no skill.

A simple, primitive weapon that requires only brute strength and persistence to hammer your foe into the ground.
location: Starting: Starting gear for the Wretch origin. Purchase: Limgrave Bought for 600 Runes from the Nomadic Merchant southeast of Coastal Cave, beneath the collapsed structure. Drop: Coastal Cave & Limgrave / Demi-Human Forest Ruins (Weeping Peninsula) / Lakeside Crystal Cave & Liurnia of the Lakes/...
whatItIs: Club belongs to the hammer class at 3.5 weight, and its attack type is strike. In practice, you have it from the start of the game.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 103 physical, scaling C in Strength. Its weapon skill is Barbaric Roar, which costs 16 FP.
whenToUse: Club needs 10 Strength, can take Ashes of War and affinity changes, and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Club

desc:
Hard, curved club, shaped like a crescent moon.

Wielded instead of a curved sword by Albinaurics lacking dexterity. The only point of similarity between the two is the shape.
location: Drop: Liurnia of the Lakes / Consecrated Snowfield / Mohgwyn Palace 2% drop chance from club-wielding Second-Generation Albinauric (their clubs are considerable larger than the actual weapon). 2 club-wielders can be found on a broken bridge east of Academy Gate Town's Site of Grace.
whatItIs: A hammer of 5 weight, Curved Club hits with strike attacks. An enemy drop in Liurnia of the Lakes (a 2% chance).
whyItMatters: Base attack is 114 physical, scaling C in Strength and E in Dexterity. The skill on it is Barbaric Roar at 16 FP.
whenToUse: Curved Club needs 11 Strength and 7 Dexterity; it can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Curved Club

desc:
Great hammer with a hard protruding beak. A pickaxe designed for combat, in essence.

A simple but highly effective weapon, the weighty piercing attack casually rips through metal armor.
location: Drop: Limgrave / Weeping Peninsula / Liurnia of the Lakes / Caelid / Altus Plateau / Deeproot Depths / Consecrated Snowfield / Miquella's Haligtree Soldier enemies of every faction that wield this weapon have a 2% drop rate for it. This includes Godrick Soldiers, Raya Lucaria Soldiers, Radahn...
whatItIs: Warpick is a hammer weighing 2.5 with pierce attacks. Enemies in Limgrave drop it (a 2% chance).
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 108 physical attack, scaling D in Strength and D in Dexterity. The skill is Kick.
whenToUse: It can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones, and Warpick needs 11 Strength and 9 Dexterity. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Warpick

desc:
Great hammer comprised of a globe attached to a handle. Though a bludgeon dealing strike damage, the appellative star is covered in spikes which cause blood loss.

Ironic given its graceful name, this weapon often reeks of blood.
location: Loot: Weeping Peninsula (Limgrave) Found in a broken down black carriage south of Bridge of Sacrifice and Irina in the Weeping Peninsula region.
whatItIs: Morning Star is a hammer weighing 5 with strike attacks. Weeping Peninsula is where it is found.
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 118 physical attack, scaling D in Strength and D in Dexterity. Hits carry blood loss (50) buildup. Weapon skill: Kick.
whenToUse: Morning Star needs 12 Strength and 8 Dexterity, can take Ashes of War and affinity changes, and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Morning Star

desc:
A steel mace resembling a charming bouquet of roses. Each petal has a sharpened edge, leaving the roses perpetually colored with blood.

This weapon reflects White Mask Varré's manner of speech rather well, enticing in its splendor, but full of deadly consequence.
location: Drop: Mohgwyn Palace (Siofra River) Progress White Mask Varré's questline and then touch his invasion sign located just before the Dynasty Mausoleum Midpoint Site of Grace. Defeat him in his world and then he'll be lying on the ground near where his invasion sign was. Talk to him and exhaust his...
whatItIs: Varré's Bouquet belongs to the hammer class at 2 weight, and its attack type is strike. An enemy drop in Mohgwyn Palace.
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 46 physical attack, scaling E in Strength, D in Dexterity, and C in Arcane. Hits carry blood loss (65) buildup. Its weapon skill is Blood Tax, which costs 14 FP.
whenToUse: It cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones, and Varré's Bouquet needs 8 Strength, 16 Dexterity, and 24 Arcane. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Varré's Bouquet

desc:
A club with beast fangs wrapped around the striking end. The uneven spread of fangs causes blood loss.

Given only to the toughest of demi-humans, this weapon is a badge of honor. Or so the demi-humans believe.
location: Drop: Limgrave / Weeping Peninsula / Mt. Gelmir 2% drop chance from slightly larger, club-wielding Demi-Humans. 1 large club-wielder can be found in the pit just past the entrance of Coastal Cave in Limgrave. 1 can be found just northeast of the Mistwood Outskirts Site of Grace in Limgrave.
whatItIs: Spiked Club belongs to the hammer class at 5 weight, and its attack type is strike. An enemy drop in Limgrave (a 2% chance).
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 114 physical attack, scaling D in Strength and D in Dexterity. Hits carry blood loss (50) buildup. Weapon skill: Barbaric Roar (16 FP).
whenToUse: Spiked Club needs 12 Strength and 7 Dexterity; it can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Spiked Club

desc:
Hammer comprised of a large stone affixed to a metal handle. Originally a blacksmith's tool.

The art of smithing is said to have originated among the giants. This weapon's striking attacks boast ample weight behind them.
location: Loot: Leyndell, Royal Capital (Altus Plateau) The Hammer is located on the upper floor of the Fortified Manor to the left of the entrance window, right next to the Sanctified Whetblade. This is the same spot where Smithing Master Hewg sits in Roundtable Hold.
whatItIs: A hammer of 6.5 weight, Hammer hits with strike attacks. Look for it in Leyndell, Royal Capital.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 124 physical, scaling C in Strength and D in Dexterity. The skill is Kick.
whenToUse: It can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones, and Hammer needs 14 Strength and 7 Dexterity. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Hammer

desc:
Great hammer made to resemble flickering flames. Signature weapon of the Fire Monks, who hail from the Mountaintops of the Giants.

The unique strong attack rouses fiery combative spirit.
location: Drop: Liurnia of the Lakes / Fort Laiedd (Mt. Gelmir) / Mountaintops of the Giants 4% drop chance from mace-wielding Fire Monks. Mace-wielding Blackflame Monks cannot drop this weapon. A camp with two Fire Monks can be found at a camp southwest of the Scenic Isle Site of Grace in southern Liurnia.
whatItIs: A hammer of 6 weight, Monk's Flamemace hits with strike attacks. An enemy drop in Liurnia of the Lakes (a 4% chance).
whyItMatters: It starts at 126 physical attack and scales E in Strength and C in Dexterity. Kick is its weapon skill.
whenToUse: It can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones, and Monk's Flamemace needs 13 Strength and 13 Dexterity. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Monk's Flamemace

desc:
Golden horn of the Oracle Envoys. Profoundly weighty, its blows are sure to be felt.

Originally an instrument, but one that cannot be sounded by a mere human. Or perhaps it is too early to sound the call.
location: Drop: Leyndell, Royal Capital / Miquella's Haligtree 2% drop chance from small Oracle Envoys. 5 small Envoys (and 1 medium one) can be found west of the East Capital Rampart Site of Grace, just at the entrance to Leyndell, Royal Capital. 3 small Envoys can be found just south of the West Capital...
whatItIs: Envoy's Horn is a hammer weighing 4 with strike attacks. An enemy drop in Leyndell, Royal Capital (a 2% chance).
whyItMatters: It starts at 96 physical attack with 62 holy on top and scales D in Strength, D in Dexterity, and D in Faith. The skill on it is Oracular Bubble at 6 FP.
whenToUse: Envoy's Horn needs 10 Strength, 12 Dexterity, and 16 Faith, cannot be infused, and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Envoy's Horn

desc:
Scepter in the form of a hand grasping a pearl. Signature weapon of Sir Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing.

The pearl stands for the world, the heavens, and an eye, representing the many forms of knowledge, never fully attainable. Even knowing that, the All-Knowing's hand grasps for it.
location: Guaranteed Drop: Leyndell, Ashen Capital Defeat Sir Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing.
whatItIs: A hammer of 4.5 weight, Scepter of the All-Knowing hits with strike and pierce attacks. Sir Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing has to fall first in Leyndell, Royal Capital before you get this weapon.
whyItMatters: It starts at 99 physical attack with 64 magic on top and scales E in Strength, D in Dexterity, and D in Intelligence. Its weapon skill is Knowledge Above All, which costs 35 FP.
whenToUse: Scepter of the All-Knowing needs 12 Strength, 18 Dexterity, and 21 Intelligence; it cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Scepter of the All-Knowing

desc:
Mace shaped like a suspended metal droplet wielded by monks of the Eternal City.

Forged from liquid metal from a Silver Tear, it is thoroughly tempered until hardened.
location: Loot: Nokron, Eternal City (Siofra River) Found on a corpse in Night's Sacred Ground, located in Nokron, Eternal City. It is found near the Mimic Tear Ashes. From the Ancestral Woods Site of Grace, head down into the Eternal City until you reach the room with a Giant Silver Tear. Head to the...
whatItIs: Nox Flowing Hammer belongs to the hammer class at 6.5 weight, and its attack type is strike. Corpse loot in Nokron, Eternal City.
whyItMatters: It starts at 122 physical attack and scales C in Strength and E in Dexterity. The skill is Flowing Form, 16 FP.
whenToUse: Nox Flowing Hammer needs 17 Strength and 7 Dexterity, cannot be infused, and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Nox Flowing Hammer

desc:
Bludgeon made of an enormous finger sheathed in several heavy rings. Thought to have been cut from an ancestor of the Fingercreeper.

Some life yet remains in this legacy of an ancient act of blasphemy, as evidenced by the barely perceptible warmth it still exudes.
location: Loot: Gelmir Hero's Grave (Mt. Gelmir) Found in a chest at the end of the initial lava-filled path in the Gelmir Hero's Grave, guarded by a Chariot. The first half or so of the path consist of running from cubbyhole to cubbyhole, but the second half is just lava that inflicts low damage slows...
whatItIs: Ringed Finger is a hammer weighing 4.5 with strike attacks. Found in a chest at Gelmir Hero's Grave.
whyItMatters: It starts at 121 physical attack and scales C in Strength and D in Dexterity. Weapon skill: Claw Flick (14 FP).
whenToUse: Ringed Finger needs 15 Strength and 9 Dexterity; it cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Ringed Finger

desc:
Signature weapon of battlemages, hewn from hard glintstone. This club is much heavier than its size suggest, but has no magic power.

So that they not lose sight of the true essence of combat, battlemages prefer to feel the impact of their blows, fighting their opponents hand to hand.
location: Drop: Academy Crystal Cave (Liurnia of the Lakes) / Sellia Hideaway (Caelid) / West Windmill Pasture (Altus Plateau) / Miquella's Haligtree Has a base 4% chance to drop from any Battlemage. A lone Battlemage can be found among the graves just outside of Sellia Hideaway.
whatItIs: A hammer of 7 weight, Stone Club hits with strike attacks. Enemies in Liurnia of the Lakes drop it (a 4% chance).
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 122 physical attack, scaling C in Strength and E in Dexterity. The skill is Kick.
whenToUse: It can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones, and Stone Club needs 16 Strength and 8 Dexterity. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Stone Club

desc:
Stone hammer made in the lands of the Numen, outside the Lands Between. The tool with which Queen Marika shattered the Elden Ring and Radagon attempted to repair it.

The hammer partially broke upon shattering the Ring, becoming splintered with rune fragments.
location: Trade: Roundtable Hold Trade the Elden Remembrance, gained by defeating the Elden Beast, with Finger Reader Enia. Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).
whatItIs: Marika's Hammer is a hammer weighing 6 with strike attacks. Beat Elden Beast for it.
whyItMatters: It starts at 101 physical attack with 65 holy on top and scales D in Strength, D in Dexterity, and D in Faith. The skill is Gold Breaker, 26 FP.
whenToUse: It cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones, and Marika's Hammer needs 20 Strength, 12 Dexterity, and 19 Faith. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Marika's Hammer

desc:
Weapon of the Dragon Communion priestess. A dragonstone hammer resembling an ancient flower.

The four petals and the flower's core are all sharp, ending in points, and are capable of dealing heavy damage to dragons.
location: Quest item: Grand Altar of Dragon Communion (Jagged Peak) The Flowerstone Gavel (and the Priestess Heart) will be where the Dragon Communion Priestess once stood at the Grand Altar of Dragon Communion after Bayle the Dread is defeated. WARNING: If the Dragon Communion Priestess is given...
whatItIs: Flowerstone Gavel is a hammer weighing 6 with pierce attacks. Located in Jagged Peak.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 121 physical, scaling D in Strength, D in Dexterity, and D in Arcane. Weapon skill: Flower Dragonbolt (18 FP).
whenToUse: Flowerstone Gavel needs 14 Strength, 8 Dexterity, and 15 Arcane; it cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Flowerstone Gavel

desc:
A thick, solid lump of wood. Wielding this striking weapon requires no skill.
A simple, primitive weapon that requires only brute strength to swing about.
location: Found on a corpse near a group of Demi-Human enemies south of the Forlorn Hound Evergaol, located in Limgrave.
whatItIs: Large Club is a great hammer weighing 8.5 with strike attacks. Corpse loot in Limgrave.
