whyItMatters: It starts at 131 physical attack and scales C in Strength. Weapon skill: Barbaric Roar (16 FP).
whenToUse: It can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones, and Large Club needs 22 Strength. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Large Club

desc:
Huge thick horn carved with tree ring-like markings adapted into a bludgeoning weapon. Wielded by ancestral follower warriors.
The ancient horn is imbued with the power of ancestral spirits. A small amount of HP is restored upon defeating an enemy.
location: Greathorn Hammer has a 2% chance to drop from Ancestral Follower Warriors who wield it.
whatItIs: A great hammer of 10 weight, Greathorn Hammer hits with strike attacks. Dropped by Ancestral Follower Warriors (a 2% chance).
whyItMatters: It starts at 134 physical attack and scales D in Strength and D in Dexterity. Weapon skill: Barbaric Roar (16 FP).
whenToUse: It can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones, and Greathorn Hammer needs 22 Strength and 10 Dexterity. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Greathorn Hammer

desc:
Large iron great hammer designed for gladiatorial combat. Used by duelists who were exiled from the colosseum.

Weighty enough to crush armor and its wearer alike.
location: Drop: Leyndell, Royal Capital 4% chance to drop from hammer-wielding Grave Warden Duelists when defeated. WARNING: These enemies will stop spawning once Maliketh is defeated.
whatItIs: Battle Hammer belongs to the great hammer class at 10 weight, and its attack type is strike. An enemy drop in Leyndell, Royal Capital (a 4% chance).
whyItMatters: Base attack is 131 physical, scaling C in Strength and E in Dexterity. Braggart's Roar is its weapon skill, costing 16 FP per use.
whenToUse: It can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones, and Battle Hammer needs 26 Strength and 8 Dexterity. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Battle Hammer

desc:
Huge bludgeon with sharp protrusions. An enlarged version of its smaller cousin.
Maintains all the advantages of smaller bludgeons, boasting few deficiencies while being very capable of breaking enemy guards and stances. A shrewd choice for simple slugging matches.
location: Found inside a chest around the trebuchets before the Grand Lift of Dectus in Liurnia of the Lakes. ru:Большая булава
whatItIs: Great Mace is a great hammer weighing 11.5 with strike attacks. A chest in Liurnia of the Lakes holds it.
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 134 physical attack, scaling C in Strength. Its weapon skill is Endure, which costs 9 FP.
whenToUse: Great Mace needs 28 Strength; it can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Great Mace

desc:
Large curved club of hard wood shaped like a crescent moon.
Wielded by Albinaurics lacking the dexterity demanded by a curved sword, and who prefer the added weight and destructive force.
location: Drop: Liurnia of the Lakes 4% drop from Second-Generation Albinaurics that wield it in Liurnia of the Lakes. ru:Изогнутая большая дубина
whatItIs: A great hammer of 10 weight, Curved Great Club hits with strike attacks. Second-Generation Albinaurics in Liurnia of the Lakes can drop it (a 4% chance).
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 145 physical attack, scaling D in Strength and D in Dexterity. Barbaric Roar is its weapon skill, costing 16 FP per use.
whenToUse: Curved Great Club needs 24 Strength and 10 Dexterity, can take Ashes of War and affinity changes, and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Curved Great Club

desc:
Large bludgeon decorated with flowers and many-decorated fabrics. Ceremonial tool used by dancers during the festivities of Dominula, Windmill Village.
The striking end is a skull too large in size to be human. Grants trace amount of runes on landing attacks.
location: From the Windmill Village site of grace, head northeast along a narrow ledge just below the village. Found on a corpse at the end of the path. ru:Праздничный череп
whatItIs: Celebrant's Skull is a great hammer weighing 8.5 with strike attacks. A corpse carries it.
whyItMatters: In practice, Before upgrades it has 138 physical attack, scaling D in Strength and D in Dexterity. Weapon skill: Barbaric Roar (16 FP).
whenToUse: Celebrant's Skull needs 18 Strength and 12 Dexterity, can take Ashes of War and affinity changes, and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Celebrant's Skull

desc:
Large pickaxe designed to crack thick bedrock. Tool of sturdy miners.

Not originally designed as a weapon, but very adept of piercing armor. "Little wretches, do you think your armor harder than stone?"
location: 2% drop chance from miners found in mining galleries throughout the Lands Between.
whatItIs: Pickaxe belongs to the great hammer class at 10 weight, and its attack type is pierce. Enemies drop it (a 2% chance).
whyItMatters: Base attack is 144 physical, scaling D in Strength and D in Dexterity. The skill on it is Endure at 9 FP.
whenToUse: Pickaxe needs 22 Strength and 10 Dexterity, can take Ashes of War and affinity changes, and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Pickaxe

desc:
Great hammer with a striking end modelled to resemble five beastly claws.
The black nails protruding from golden fur are said to represent Serosh, Lord of Beasts, who went on to become King Godfrey's Regent.
Unique Skill: Regal Beastclaw
Slam the hammer into the ground, rending the land asunder with the armament's five bestial claws.
location: Awarded by the Beast Clergyman for feeding him 7 Deathroot.
whatItIs: A great hammer of 9 weight, Beastclaw Greathammer hits with strike attacks.
whyItMatters: It starts at 116 physical attack with 75 holy on top and scales D in Strength, D in Dexterity, and D in Faith. The skill on it is Regal Beastclaw at 20 FP.
whenToUse: Beastclaw Greathammer needs 20 Strength, 10 Dexterity, and 18 Faith, cannot be infused, and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Beastclaw Greathammer

desc:
Long golden horn of the Oracle Envoys. Profoundly weighty, its blows are sure to be felt.
Originally an instrument, but one that cannot be sounded by a mere human. Or perhaps is it too early to sound the call.
Unique Skill : Bubble Shower
Blow on the horn to release a spume of magic bubbles. The bubbles float gently before raining down the target.
location: Drop: Leyndell, Royal Capital / Miquella's Haligtree Large Oracle Envoys have a 4% chance to drop this item. ru:Длинный рожок посланца
whatItIs: A great hammer of 9.5 weight, Envoy's Long Horn hits with strike attacks. Enemies in Leyndell, Royal Capital drop it (a 4% chance).
whyItMatters: Base attack is 120 physical plus 78 holy, scaling D in Strength, D in Dexterity, and C in Faith. The skill on it is Bubble Shower at 12 FP.
whenToUse: Envoy's Long Horn needs 23 Strength, 11 Dexterity, and 18 Faith, cannot be infused, and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Envoy's Long Horn

desc:
Candlestand used in worship of Birac, the most hallowed Monk Prelate of the Giants' Flame. 

Concerned over the lazy arrogance with which the monks treated the Flame, Birac severed his own head as a lesson to the others, intending it to be used as a candlestand. His faith yet smolders from within the cranial vessel.
location: Mountaintops of the Giants, Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave, behind the second imp statue in the dungeon. ru:Подсвечник из черепа
whatItIs: Cranial Vessel Candlestand belongs to the great hammer class at 12.5 weight, and its attack type is strike. Its location note points to Mountaintops of the Giants.
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 98 physical attack and 98 fire, scaling D in Strength, E in Dexterity, and D in Faith. Surge of Faith is its weapon skill, costing 15 FP per use.
whenToUse: Cranial Vessel Candlestand needs 26 Strength, 8 Dexterity, and 22 Faith, cannot be infused, and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Cranial Vessel Candlestand

desc:
Huge bludgeon with three stars at the striking end. Though primarily a striking weapon, the stars' spikes cause blood loss.
A blood-stained star is an ill omen, a fact not lost upon those against whom this weapon is brought to bear. Landing attacks slightly restore HP.
location: Found inside a wandering caravan near the Road of Iniquity Side Path grace located in Altus Plateau. As of patch 1.06, this weapon is also dropped by Magnus the Beast Claw upon defeat. ru:Большая звезда
whatItIs: Great Stars belongs to the great hammer class at 10 weight, and its attack type is strike. Dropped by Magnus the Beast Claw.
whyItMatters: It starts at 135 physical attack and scales D in Strength and D in Dexterity. Hits carry blood loss (55) buildup. Endure is its weapon skill, costing 9 FP per use.
whenToUse: Great Stars needs 22 Strength and 12 Dexterity; it can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Great Stars

desc:
Weapon made from an ordinary stone brick. Wielded by a laborer who lead a rebellion, and later become a champion himself.
Even among other bludgeons of its size, this weapon is especially weighty. The strength of a giant is required to wield it.
location: Found on a corpse in Stormveil Castle, near the area where you get trapped in a room with a Banished Knight. It is accessed by jumping across a gap.
whatItIs: A great hammer of 12.5 weight, Brick Hammer hits with strike attacks. Looted from a corpse at Stormveil Castle.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 122 physical, scaling B in Strength. Weapon skill: Barbaric Roar (16 FP).
whenToUse: It can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones, and Brick Hammer needs 31 Strength. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Brick Hammer

desc:
Scepter in the shape of a serpent devouring the world. This weapon will one day become the very symbol of the Lord of Blasphemy. One of the legendary armaments.
A vision of the future briefly seen by Rykard in his final moments before being devoured by the great serpent.
Unique Skill: Devourer of Worlds
Charge the scepter with magic and strike it against the ground to steal the HP of all nearby enemies.
location: Received upon killing Knight Bernahl. This can be either at the Warmaster Shack in Limgrave, or in during his invasion in Farum Azula. ru:Скипетр пожирателя
whatItIs: A great hammer of 11.5 weight, Devourer's Scepter hits with strike attacks. Knight Bernahl has to fall first in Limgrave before you get this weapon.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 112 physical plus 69 fire, scaling D in Strength, D in Dexterity, and D in Faith. The skill is Devourer of Worlds, 35 FP.
whenToUse: Devourer's Scepter needs 24 Strength, 20 Dexterity, and 25 Faith; it cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Devourer's Scepter

desc:
Large iron great hammer designed for gladiatorial combat, now festering with scarlet rot.

Weighty enough to crush armor and its wearer alike.
location: Guaranteed Drop: Consecrated Snowfield Dropped by a Rotten Duelist enemy located west of the Consecrated Snowfield grace.
whatItIs: Rotten Battle Hammer belongs to the great hammer class at 10 weight, and its attack type is strike. Rotten Duelist in Consecrated Snowfield can drop it.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 126 physical, scaling C in Strength and E in Dexterity. Each hit builds up scarlet rot (65). Its weapon skill is Braggart's Roar, which costs 16 FP.
whenToUse: Rotten Battle Hammer needs 26 Strength and 8 Dexterity; it can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Rotten Battle Hammer

desc:
Greathammer engraved with a smithscript. A throwing weapon created through the smithing arts.
Execute a strong attack or dashing strong attack to spin and fling the greathammer.
location: The weapon can be found at Taylew's Ruined Forge.
whatItIs: Smithscript Greathammer belongs to the great hammer class at 9 weight, and its attack type is strike. Look for it at Taylew's Ruined Forge.
whyItMatters: It starts at 141 physical attack and scales D in Strength, E in Dexterity, E in Intelligence, and E in Faith. The skill is Endure, 9 FP.
whenToUse: Smithscript Greathammer needs 20 Strength, 10 Dexterity, 11 Intelligence, and 11 Faith, can take Ashes of War and affinity changes, and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Smithscript Greathammer

desc:
One of the treasures of the ruined forges. A tremendous hammer that incorporates as its head the red-hot anvil of the forge.

It is said that the anvil's shape is inspired by that of an altar, and that long ago, it was indeed used as such in rite and ritual.
location: This weapon can be found and obtained at Ruined Forge Lava Intake.
whatItIs: Anvil Hammer is a colossal weapon weighing 22 with strike attacks. Found at Ruined Forge Lava Intake.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 131 physical plus 85 fire, scaling C in Strength, E in Dexterity, E in Intelligence, and D in Faith. The skill on it is Smithing Art Spears at 18 FP.
whenToUse: Anvil Hammer needs 39 Strength, 10 Dexterity, 11 Intelligence, and 20 Faith; it cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Anvil Hammer

desc:
Weapon of the Black Knights, servants of Messmer the Impaler. Greathammer of black steel with decorative embellishments in gold.

Blessed with an Erdtree incantation. Further holy imbuement will amplify the effect and greatly increase the armament's power. Guard Counters cause a burst of power.
location: Guaranteed Drop: Church of Consolation (Gravesite Plain) A guaranteed drop from the Black Knight found at the Church of Consolation.
whatItIs: A great hammer of 12 weight, Black Steel Greathammer hits with strike attacks. Look for it as a drop from Black Knight in Gravesite Plain.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 140 physical plus 42 holy, scaling C in Strength, E in Dexterity, and D in Faith. Weapon skill: Endure (9 FP).
whenToUse: Black Steel Greathammer needs 25 Strength, 11 Dexterity, and 17 Faith; it can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Black Steel Greathammer

desc:
Weapon used by the bloodfiends. An arm pulled from the corpse of one of their kin, and wielded as a makeshift weapon.

Having been sanctified by a blood ritual, this armament is capable of spraying blood stored within when executing a strong attack.
location: Drops from one of a group of Bloodfiends in Prospect Town, Gravesite Plain.
whatItIs: Bloodfiend's Arm is a colossal weapon weighing 20 with strike attacks. Enemies in Gravesite Plain drop it.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 147 physical, scaling D in Strength, E in Dexterity, and D in Arcane. The skill is Endure, 9 FP.
whenToUse: Bloodfiend's Arm needs 28 Strength, 11 Dexterity, and 16 Arcane; it can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Bloodfiend's Arm

desc:
A flail with two additional bludgeoning heads. Weapon of the Night's Cavalry who ride funeral steeds.

The large spikes make it highly effective at inducing blood loss, but also demand higher dexterity to wield.
location: Guaranteed Drop: Weeping Peninsula Drop from the Night's Cavalry located in the Weeping Peninsula, found near the Castle Morne Rampart Site of Grace at night.
whatItIs: Nightrider Flail is a flail weighing 6 with strike attacks. Dropped by Night's Cavalry.
whyItMatters: It starts at 115 physical attack and scales E in Strength and C in Dexterity. Hits carry blood loss (50) buildup. The skill on it is Spinning Chain at 8 FP.
whenToUse: Nightrider Flail needs 10 Strength and 24 Dexterity; it can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Nightrider Flail

desc:
Weapon consisting of a bludgeoning head attached to a handle by a chain. The iron ball is spiked and induces blood loss.

Blows from this weapon cannot be parried. The charge attack whirls the iron ball around for increased force before striking.
location: Loot: Limgrave Found near Gatefront Ruins, located in the black carriage furthest east from Gatefront's marker. Drop: Brother Corhyn Dropped by Brother Corhyn at any point during his questline depending on the player's actions. It can also be obtained by killing him.
whatItIs: Flail is a flail weighing 8 with strike attacks. Dropped by Brother Corhyn.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 112 physical, scaling D in Strength and D in Dexterity. Hits carry blood loss (50) buildup. The skill is Spinning Chain, 8 FP.
whenToUse: Flail needs 10 Strength and 18 Dexterity; it can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Flail

desc:
Three bludgeoning copper heads attached to a handle by chains. Signature weapon of Necromancer Garris, the heretical sage.

The heads were made to resemble those of his wife and two children.
location: Guaranteed Drop: Sage's Cave (Altus Plateau) Received upon defeating Necromancer Garris, who is found behind an illusory wall inside the Sage's Cave.
whatItIs: Family Heads is a flail weighing 5.5 with strike attacks. Beat Necromancer Garris for it.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 90 physical plus 58 magic, scaling E in Strength, C in Dexterity, and E in Intelligence. The skill on it is Familial Rancor at 25 FP.
whenToUse: Family Heads needs 8 Strength, 18 Dexterity, and 16 Intelligence; it cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Family Heads

desc:
Flail which deals magic damage, having been imbued with power by the remembrance of Astel.

Formed of the same many-colored star debris that comprised the form of the Naturalborn of the Void.
location: Trade: Roundtable Hold Trade the Remembrance of the Naturalborn, dropped by Astel, Naturalborn of the Void, with Finger Reader Enia. Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums to duplicate a remembrance (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).
whatItIs: Bastard's Stars belongs to the flail class at 5.5 weight, and its attack type is strike. Trade in the Remembrance of the Naturalborn with Finger Reader Enia to get it.
whyItMatters: It starts at 68 physical attack with 81 magic on top and scales E in Strength, D in Dexterity, and C in Intelligence. Weapon skill: Nebula (25 FP).
whenToUse: It cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones, and Bastard's Stars needs 8 Strength, 22 Dexterity, and 22 Intelligence. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Bastard's Stars

desc:
A spiked iron tube attached by a chain wielded by Mad Pumpkin Heads.

Especially large for a flail, wielding it requires more strength than it does dexterity.
location: Drop: Limgrave / Liurnia of the Lakes / Altus Plateau 4% drop chance from the Mad Pumpkin Head enemies that wield it.
whatItIs: A flail of 8 weight, Chainlink Flail hits with strike attacks. Dropped by Mad Pumpkin (a 4% chance).
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 112 physical attack, scaling C in Strength and E in Dexterity. Each hit builds up blood loss (50). The skill is Spinning Chain, 8 FP.
whenToUse: Chainlink Flail needs 18 Strength and 12 Dexterity, can take Ashes of War and affinity changes, and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Chainlink Flail

desc:
A flail with coiled snakes for bludgeoning heads. Fire roars within the snakes' bodies, inflicting horrible burns.

Some of Messmer's army used these flails to burn hornsent—to brand them with agony and fear.
location: Loot: Fog Rift Fort (Gravesite Plain) This weapon can be found inside a chest within Fog Rift Fort.
whatItIs: Serpent Flail belongs to the flail class at 6 weight, and its attack type is strike. Found in a chest at Fog Rift Fort.
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 77 physical attack and 92 fire, scaling E in Strength, D in Dexterity, and D in Faith. The skill on it is Flare, O Serpent at 8 FP.
whenToUse: Serpent Flail needs 10 Strength, 24 Dexterity, and 21 Faith, cannot be infused, and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Serpent Flail

desc:
A flail with three golden rings for striking heads, the sacred signature weapon of the esteemed Broken Mask.

The golden bands are modelled upon the Elden Ring itself, half-corporeal and half formed of light, all in the process of shattering.
location: Loot: Leyndell, Royal Capital Obtained after defeating The Noble Broken Mask invader in Leyndell, Royal Capital who appears after using Law of Regression on the Radagon statue. Category:weapon
whatItIs: Golden Order Flail is a flail weighing 5 with strike attacks. Beat Noble Broken Mask in Leyndell, Royal Capital to get it.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 75 physical plus 92 holy, scaling E in Strength, E in Dexterity, and C in Faith. Weapon skill: Causality's Wrath.
whenToUse: Golden Order Flail needs 9 Strength, 16 Dexterity, and 26 Faith, cannot be infused, and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Golden Order Flail

desc:
A thick, heavy blade attached to a handle. A versatile, standard weapon

Capable of powerful attacks thanks to the weighty blade, these weapons are also regarded for their powerful charge attacks.
location: Starting Equipment: 1 is part of the starting equipment of the Hero origin. Purchase: Roundtable Hold 1 is sold for 800 Runes by the Twin Maiden Husks in Roundtable Hold.
whatItIs: Battle Axe is a axe weighing 4.5 with standard attacks. For a new player, it is in your inventory from the very beginning.
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 128 physical attack, scaling D in Strength and D in Dexterity. The skill is Wild Strikes, 2 FP.
whenToUse: Battle Axe needs 12 Strength and 8 Dexterity, can take Ashes of War and affinity changes, and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Battle Axe

desc:
Peculiar hatched wielded by imps.

The gently undulating forked blade is known as an "imp's tongue" and causes blood loss.
location: Drop: Fringefolk Hero's Grave & Stormfoot Catacombs & Murkwater Catacombs (Limgrave) / Impaler's Catacombs (Weeping Peninsula) / Road's End Catacombs & Cliffbottom Catacombs (Liurnia of the Lakes) / Wyndham Catacombs & Sainted Hero's Grave (Altus Plateau) / Minor Erdtree Catacombs & War-Dead...
whatItIs: Forked Hatchet is a axe weighing 2.5 with standard attacks. An enemy drop in Limgrave.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 113 physical, scaling D in Strength and C in Dexterity. Hits carry blood loss (50) buildup. Weapon skill: Quickstep (3 FP).
whenToUse: Forked Hatchet needs 9 Strength and 14 Dexterity; it can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Forked Hatchet

desc:
Commonly known as a hatchet, this smaller variety of axe is an everyday work tool.

Despite its short reach, it is easy to handle, exceling in successive attacks.
location: Purchase: Limgrave 1 is sold for 600 Runes by the Nomadic Merchant located in eastern Limgrave in the Mistwood, south of the Minor Erdtree there.
whatItIs: Hand Axe belongs to the axe class at 3.5 weight, and its attack type is standard. It is for sale from Nomadic Merchant for 600 runes in Limgrave.
whyItMatters: It starts at 117 physical attack and scales D in Strength and D in Dexterity. Weapon skill: Quickstep (3 FP).
whenToUse: Hand Axe needs 9 Strength and 8 Dexterity; it can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Hand Axe

desc:
Axe made from a herbivore's skull. Weapon of the ancestral followers who disdain metal.

This axe is more of a bludgeon; it forgoes a bladed edge, instead using the beast's molar teeth to buffet foes, dealing strike damage.
location: Drop: Siofra River / Uld Palace Ruins (Liurnia of the Lakes) / Ainsel River 2% drop chance from axe-wielding Ancestral Follower Warriors, including the bow-wielding ones. 3 can be found just northwest of the Worshippers' Woods in Lower Siofra River. Several can be found by the Ruined Labyrinth...
whatItIs: Jawbone Axe belongs to the axe class at 5.5 weight, and its attack type is strike. An enemy drop in Siofra River (a 2% chance).
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 130 physical attack, scaling C in Strength and E in Dexterity. The skill is Wild Strikes, 2 FP.
whenToUse: It can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones, and Jawbone Axe needs 14 Strength and 8 Dexterity. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Jawbone Axe

desc:
Fairly large iron cleaver, commonly used by the maltreated Misbegotten.

Steeped in resentment, these weapons are swung wildly and relentlessly, often after rushing up to foes.
location: Drop: Morne Tunnel & Castle Morne (Weeping Peninsula) / Unsightly Catacombs & Leyndell, Royal Capital (Capital Outskirts) / Cave of the Forlorn & Miquella's Haligtree (Consecrated Snowfield) / Scadu Altus / Charo's Hidden Grave 2% drop chance from cleaver-wielding Misbegotten.
whatItIs: Iron Cleaver is a axe weighing 6 with standard attacks. Enemies in Weeping Peninsula drop it (a 2% chance).
whyItMatters: Base attack is 125 physical, scaling C in Strength and E in Dexterity. Its weapon skill is Wild Strikes, which costs 2 FP.
whenToUse: Iron Cleaver needs 15 Strength and 7 Dexterity, can take Ashes of War and affinity changes, and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Iron Cleaver

desc:
Unique weapon wielded by young Albinaurics, this sword is modelled after the ripples that are thought to be the origin of their species.

Its attack power is greatly enhanced with one's arcane attribute.
location: Purchase: Caria Manor (Liurnia of the Lakes) 1 is sold for 3500 Runes by Pidia, Carian Servant, in the hidden floor accessed from the back side of Caria Manor after defeating Royal Knight Loretta.
whatItIs: Ripple Blade belongs to the axe class at 4.5 weight, and its attack type is standard. You can buy it from Pidia, Carian Servant in Liurnia of the Lakes for 3,500 runes.
whyItMatters: It starts at 75 physical attack and scales A in Arcane. Weapon skill: Wild Strikes (2 FP).
whenToUse: It cannot be infused and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones, and Ripple Blade needs 11 Strength, 11 Dexterity, and 20 Arcane. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Ripple Blade

desc:
Cleaver decorated with many-colored fabrics. Ceremonial tool used by dancers during the festivities of Dominula, Windmill Village.

Crafted from human bone. Grants trace amounts of runes upon landing attacks.
location: Drop: Dominula, Windmill Village (Altus Plateau) 0.5% drop chance from cleaver-wielding Dominula Dancers in Dominula, Windmill Village, located in the north of Altus Plateau.
whatItIs: Celebrant's Cleaver is a axe weighing 4.5 with standard attacks. Enemies in Altus Plateau drop it (a 0.5% chance).
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 125 physical attack, scaling D in Strength and D in Dexterity. The skill is Wild Strikes, 2 FP.
whenToUse: Celebrant's Cleaver needs 12 Strength and 8 Dexterity; it can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Celebrant's Cleaver

desc:
A hatchet with a frost-coated blade. One of several gifts given by Castle Sol in the distant north.

Known as "freezing fog," the blade is thought to be a dragon's scale. Inflicts a powerful frost effect.
location: Loot: Temple Quarter (Liurnia of the Lakes) Found inside a chest in a small, broken tower in southern Temple Quarter, located south-west of Academy of Raya Lucaria. It's on a straight track southeast of the Temple Quarter Site of Grace, on the island just south of the Temple Quarter map icon.
whatItIs: Icerind Hatchet belongs to the axe class at 3 weight, and its attack type is standard. Chest loot at Temple Quarter in Liurnia of the Lakes.
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 115 physical attack, scaling E in Strength and C in Dexterity. Each hit builds up frostbite (65). The skill is Hoarfrost Stomp, 10 FP.
whenToUse: Icerind Hatchet needs 11 Strength and 16 Dexterity, cannot be infused, and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Icerind Hatchet

desc:
Single-sided axe used by the warriors of the highlands.

Brave combatants begin battle by crying out their names. Roars are enhanced by this weapon.
location: Loot: Stormveil Castle (Limgrave) Found in Stormveil Castle under a painting inside the room with a roaming Grafted Scion, across from the room with the elevator shortcut up to the Rampart Tower Site of Grace.
whatItIs: Highland Axe is a axe weighing 4.5 with standard attacks. Look for it at Stormveil Castle in Limgrave.
whyItMatters: It starts at 128 physical attack and scales D in Strength and D in Dexterity. Its weapon skill is War Cry, which costs 16 FP. Its critical value is 110.
whenToUse: Highland Axe needs 12 Strength and 9 Dexterity; it can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Highland Axe

desc:
Hatchet used in ancient sacrificial rite. A Deathbird is depicted as a malevolent deity.

The power of the rite yet lingers. A small amount of FP is restored upon slaying a foe.
location: Guaranteed Drop: Weeping Peninsula Received upon defeating the Deathbird in Weeping Peninsula. It will appear on south side of the wall north of Castle Morne at night, near where the wall meets the coast. If the (non-respawning) Archer Golem in the area is still alive, its arrows may help defeat...
whatItIs: Sacrificial Axe is a axe weighing 5.5 with standard attacks. Beat Deathbird in Weeping Peninsula to get it.
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 133 physical attack, scaling D in Strength and D in Dexterity. Weapon skill: Wild Strikes (2 FP).
whenToUse: It can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones, and Sacrificial Axe needs 16 Strength and 10 Dexterity. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Sacrificial Axe

desc:
Usher of Death, Rosus, who shows the path to the catacombs throughout the Land Between, is depicted on this ritual axe.

The dead easily lose their way, and have always been in sore need of a guiding hand.
location: Loot: Black Knife Catacombs (Liurnia of the Lakes) Found inside Black Knife Catacombs, located to the northeast in Liurnia of the Lakes. It requires one Stonesword Key to access.
whatItIs: Rosus' Axe belongs to the axe class at 5.5 weight, and its attack type is standard. Found at Black Knife Catacombs in Liurnia of the Lakes.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 112 physical plus 72 magic, scaling D in Strength, E in Dexterity, and D in Intelligence. The skill on it is Rosus's Summons at 15 FP.
whenToUse: Rosus' Axe needs 18 Strength, 10 Dexterity, and 18 Intelligence; it cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Rosus' Axe

desc:
Battle axe designed to resemble a hawk, with its wings comprising the blade. Signature weapon of warriors who strive to remain one with the storm, despite being so far from their place of birth.

Their hearts are proud, and thereby easily undone.
location: Loot: Leyndell, Royal Capital (Altus Plateau) / Castle Sol (Mountaintops of the Giants) One can be found in Leyndell, in the court outside of the fortified manor where the Abductor Virgin enemies are roaming. One can be found within Castle Sol, on a rooftop not far from where you find the painting.
whatItIs: Stormhawk Axe belongs to the axe class at 5.5 weight, and its attack type is standard. Found in Leyndell, Royal Capital.
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 136 physical attack, scaling D in Strength and D in Dexterity. Weapon skill: Thunderstorm (19 FP).
whenToUse: It cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones, and Stormhawk Axe needs 19 Strength and 15 Dexterity. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Stormhawk Axe

desc:
Axe engraved with a smithscript. A throwing weapon created through the smithing arts.

Execute a strong attack or jumping strong attack to throw the axe.
location: Loot: Taylew's Ruined Forge (Rauh Base) From the Site of Grace at Taylew's Ruined Forge, take the straight path through the dungeon until there's a gap in the path. Jump over the gap instead of dropping down, then take a left into a small room with a Golem Smith and the Smithscript Axe.
whatItIs: Smithscript Axe is a axe weighing 5 with standard attacks. An enemy drop in Ancient Ruins of Rauh.
whyItMatters: It starts at 131 physical attack and scales D in Strength, D in Dexterity, E in Intelligence, and E in Faith. Weapon skill: Wild Strikes (2 FP).
whenToUse: It can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones, and Smithscript Axe needs 13 Strength, 10 Dexterity, 11 Intelligence, and 11 Faith. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Smithscript Axe

desc:
Golden war axes of the Death Knight. A pair of weapons made to be wielded in both hands. Crackles with lightning, the power of the capital's ancient dragon cult.

The knight, once the personal guard of Godwyn, was also the protector of the Prince of Death's cadaver surrogate.
location: Guaranteed Drop: Fog Rift Catacombs (Gravesite Plain) Dropped by the dual-axe wielding Death Knight at then end of the dungeon.
whatItIs: Death Knight's Twin Axes is a axe weighing 5.5 with standard attacks. Enemies in Gravesite Plain drop it.
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 101 physical attack and 65 lightning, scaling D in Strength, D in Dexterity, and D in Faith. The skill on it is Blinkbolt: Twinaxe at 8 FP.
whenToUse: Death Knight's Twin Axes needs 14 Strength, 12 Dexterity, and 16 Faith, cannot be infused, and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Death Knight's Twin Axes

desc:
Weapon used by the soldiers who serve Messmer the Impaler. A steel axe, worn from use.

A favorite of those who lost themselves utterly in their lord's war. Capable of performing powerful charge attacks.
location: Drop: Gravesite Plain / Cerulean Coast / Charo's Hidden Grave / Scadu Altus / Rauh Base / Abyssal Woods / Ruins of Rauh 2% drop chance from any axe-wielding Messmer Soldiers. 2 axe-wielders (and 2 spear-wielders) can be found down a ladder from the Stake of Marika in Fog Rift Fort, reached by...
whatItIs: Messmer Soldier's Axe belongs to the axe class at 5.5 weight, and its attack type is standard. An enemy drop in Gravesite Plain (a 2% chance).
whyItMatters: Base attack is 133 physical, scaling D in Strength and D in Dexterity. War Cry is its weapon skill, costing 16 FP per use.
whenToUse: Messmer Soldier's Axe needs 14 Strength and 10 Dexterity, can take Ashes of War and affinity changes, and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Messmer Soldier's Axe

desc:
A peculiar weapon wielded by imps. Hatchet smithed in the shape of a fork-tongued dragon.

The gently undulating forked blade is known as an "imp's tongue" and causes blood loss.
location: Drop: Fog Rift Catacombs (Gravesite Plain) / Darklight Catacombs (Scadu Altus) / Scorpion River Catacombs (Rauh Base) 2% drop chance from hatchet-wielding Fanged Imps in the Realm of Shadow. The earliest farming spot is in Darklight Catacombs by using the Stake of Marika found just after the...
whatItIs: Forked-Tongue Hatchet belongs to the axe class at 4 weight, and its attack type is standard and pierce. Enemies in Gravesite Plain drop it (a 2% chance).
whyItMatters: Base attack is 125 physical, scaling D in Strength and D in Dexterity. Hits carry blood loss (50) buildup. Its weapon skill is Dragonform Flame, which costs 14 FP.
whenToUse: Forked-Tongue Hatchet needs 10 Strength and 13 Dexterity; it cannot be infused and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Forked-Tongue Hatchet

desc:
Greataxe akin to a huge lump of iron. Recognized as the weapon of choice of badland chieftains.

Too heavy to be wielded by those of merely ordinary strength, blows from this axe will flatten enemies, and the force of its charged attack is a sight to be behold.
location: Loot: Limgrave Found inside a carriage hauled by two Trolls that is heading south on the road west of the Waypoint Ruins in Limgrave. The carriage must be stopped before the chest can be opened, requiring at least one troll be either killed or incapacitated. These trolls will not pursue the...
whatItIs: Greataxe belongs to the greataxe class at 13 weight, and its attack type is standard. A chest in Limgrave holds it.
whyItMatters: It starts at 151 physical attack and scales D in Strength and D in Dexterity. Weapon skill: Barbaric Roar (16 FP).
whenToUse: Greataxe needs 30 Strength and 8 Dexterity, can take Ashes of War and affinity changes, and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Greataxe

desc:
Oversized double-headed axe with a bizarre, almost melted appearance.

Brute strength is the only thing required to wield this weapon, which appears to have taken quite the beating itself.
location: Drop: Cliffbottom Catacombs (Liurnia of the Lakes) / Altus Plateau / Subterranean Shunning-Grounds (Altus Plateau) 4% chance to drop from axe-wielding Omens. The earliest spots is in Cliffbottom Catacombs, though the two axe-wielding Omen in there are pretty far in. The first one is found by...
whatItIs: Warped Axe belongs to the axe class at 7.5 weight, and its attack type is standard. In practice, it is an enemy drop (a 4% chance).
whyItMatters: It starts at 124 physical attack and scales C in Strength. The skill on it is War Cry at 16 FP.
whenToUse: Warped Axe needs 24 Strength and 8 Dexterity; it can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Warped Axe

desc:
The blade of this huge, loathsome cleaver comprises a row of amputated Omen horns. Weapon of slaughter wielded by Omenkillers.

The hideous horns cause blood loss, adding vibrant colors to the ongoing mayhem.
location: Guaranteed drop: Perfumer's Grotto (Altus Plateau) / Volcano Manor (Mt. Gelmir) Received upon defeating the Omenkiller & Miranda the Blighted Bloom duo boss inside the Perfumer's Grotto in Altus Plateau. Dropped once by an Omenkiller in Volcano Manor, found by a bonfire behind a gate just before...
whatItIs: Great Omenkiller Cleaver belongs to the greataxe class at 11 weight, and its attack type is standard. Omenkiller has to fall first in Altus Plateau before you get this weapon.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 142 physical, scaling D in Strength and D in Dexterity. Hits carry blood loss (55) buildup. Weapon skill: Wild Strikes (2 FP).
whenToUse: It can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones, and Great Omenkiller Cleaver needs 23 Strength and 12 Dexterity. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Great Omenkiller Cleaver

desc:
Greataxe with a large, arcing blade and long handle. The "Crescent Moon" of its name is said to have been spurred by nostalgia.

Specializes in sweeping through foes by making use of its long handle.
location: Drop: Stormveil Castle (Limgrave) / Castle Sol (Mountaintops of the Giants) 4% drop chance from the large Exile Soldiers that wield them. 2 can be found in the Stonesword Key-locked cellar with the Iron Whetblade in Stormveil Castle. The quickest way there being to drop down on the roof just...
whatItIs: A greataxe of 12.5 weight, Crescent Moon Axe hits with standard attacks. Enemies in Limgrave drop it (a 4% chance).
whyItMatters: Base attack is 146 physical, scaling D in Strength and D in Dexterity. Weapon skill: War Cry (16 FP).
whenToUse: Crescent Moon Axe needs 25 Strength and 15 Dexterity, can take Ashes of War and affinity changes, and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Crescent Moon Axe

desc:
Greataxe wielded by Godrick the Grafted. This golden battleaxe is emblazoned with the figure of a beast, representing the strength of Godfrey, First Elden Lord and patriarch of the golden lineage.

"I command thee kneel! For I am the lord of all that is golden!"
location: Trade: Roundtable Hold Trade the Remembrance of the Grafted, gained by defeating Godrick the Grafted, with Finger Reader Enia. Alternatively, use one of the belled Wandering Mausoleums to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).
whatItIs: A greataxe of 11 weight, Axe of Godrick hits with standard attacks. Trade in the Remembrance of the Grafted with Finger Reader Enia to get it.
whyItMatters: In practice, base attack is 142 physical, scaling D in Strength and D in Dexterity. Weapon skill: I Command Thee, Kneel! (15 FP).
whenToUse: It cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones, and Axe of Godrick needs 34 Strength and 22 Dexterity. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Axe of Godrick

desc:
Large iron axe with a long handle. Weapon of the maltreated Misbegotten.

Making use of the force generated by its length, this weapon's resentment-charged blows are difficult to stop.
location: Drop: Castle Morne (Weeping Peninsula) / Revenger's Shack (Liurnia of the Lakes) / Unsightly Catacombs & Leyndell, Royal Capital (Altus Plateau) / Cave of the Forlorn & Miquella's Haligtree (Consecrated Snowfield) / Scadu Altus Shadow of the Erdtree 2% drop chance to drop from the larger, Scaly...
whatItIs: A greataxe of 12.5 weight, Longhaft Axe hits with standard attacks. An enemy drop in Weeping Peninsula (a 2% chance).
whyItMatters: It starts at 146 physical attack and scales D in Strength and D in Dexterity. The skill is War Cry, 16 FP.
whenToUse: Longhaft Axe needs 24 Strength and 8 Dexterity, can take Ashes of War and affinity changes, and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Longhaft Axe

desc:
A rusty anchor wielded as a weapon. Each of its four flukes is thick and sharp, enabling piercing attacks.

When the Tarnished left the Lands Between with their Lord, one boat alone was said to have been left behind.
location: Guaranteed Drop: Morne Tunnel (Weeping Peninsula) Dropped by the Scaly Misbegotten area boss in Morne Tunnel.
whatItIs: Rusted Anchor belongs to the greataxe class at 12.5 weight, and its attack type is pierce. Scaly Misbegotten in Weeping Peninsula can drop it.
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 147 physical attack, scaling C in Strength and E in Dexterity. The skill is Barbaric Roar, 16 FP.
whenToUse: Rusted Anchor needs 26 Strength and 9 Dexterity, can take Ashes of War and affinity changes, and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Rusted Anchor

desc:
Bulky cleaver welded to a long shaft. Said to have been used to dispatch the remnants of defeated enemies, felling them like timber.

Perhaps that is the reason it excels at critical hits.
location: Drop: Liurnia of the Lakes / Caelid / Crumbling Farum Azula 4% drop chance from Greataxe-wielding Giant Skeletons with 100 Discovery. Farm_spot_executioner_greataxe_2.png|West of Church of Irith and Lake-Facing Cliffs grace. One crawls from the ground, 2 scythe skeletons are near.
whatItIs: Executioner's Greataxe belongs to the greataxe class at 15 weight, and its attack type is standard. It drops from Greataxe-wielding Giant Skeletons in Liurnia of the Lakes (a 4% chance).
whyItMatters: Base attack is 150 physical, scaling C in Strength and E in Dexterity. Weapon skill: War Cry (16 FP). Its critical value is 115.
whenToUse: Executioner's Greataxe needs 34 Strength and 8 Dexterity; it can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Executioner's Greataxe

desc:
A unique horn in which the power of ancestral spirits fiercely dwells, this large, wing-shaped specimen is wielded as a weapon of spirit worship.

In the ancestral spirit-worshipping faith, these are considered envoys' wings, made to reap the lives of beings which experience no sprouting.
location: Trade: Roundtable Hold Trade the Remembrance of the Regal Ancestor, gained by defeating Regal Ancestor Spirit, with Finger Reader Enia. Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).
whatItIs: Winged Greathorn belongs to the greataxe class at 11 weight, and its attack type is standard. It is traded for the Remembrance of the Regal Ancestor at Roundtable Hold.
whyItMatters: It starts at 130 physical attack and scales D in Strength and D in Dexterity. Its weapon skill is Soul Stifler, which costs 12 FP.
whenToUse: It cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones, and Winged Greathorn needs 30 Strength and 20 Dexterity. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Winged Greathorn

desc:
Huge carving knife made to cleanly butcher the human body. Signature weapon of the Ogress Anastasia, known to have eaten countless Tarnished while disguised as a Finger Maiden.

Restores a small amount of HP when it squarely strikes an enemy.
location: Guaranteed drop: Corpse-Stench Shack (Mt. Gelmir) Dropped by Anastasia, Tarnished-Eater when she invades outside of the Corpse-Stench Shack. This weapon is initially infused with the Sacred Affinity, in spite of having no Ash of War equipped.
whatItIs: A greataxe of 8.5 weight, Butchering Knife hits with standard attacks. Look for it as a drop from Anastasia, Tarnished-Eater in Mt. Gelmir.
whyItMatters: It starts at 134 physical attack and scales E in Strength and C in Dexterity. Weapon skill: Barbaric Roar (16 FP).
whenToUse: Butchering Knife needs 16 Strength and 20 Dexterity; it can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Butchering Knife

desc:
Bronze greataxe wielded by Valiant Gargoyles.

Just like the wielder, the missing parts have been mended with corpse wax; a patchwork of champions.
location: Guaranteed Drop: Altus Plateau Received upon defeating the Valiant Gargoyle enemy just north of the Outer Wall Phantom Tree grace located in Altus Plateau.
whatItIs: Gargoyle's Great Axe is a greataxe weighing 8.5 with standard attacks. Beat Valiant Gargoyle in Altus Plateau to get it.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 123 physical, scaling C in Strength and E in Dexterity. The skill is War Cry, 16 FP.
whenToUse: Gargoyle's Great Axe needs 24 Strength and 8 Dexterity, can take Ashes of War and affinity changes, and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Gargoyle's Great Axe

desc:
Bronze greataxe wielded by Valiant Gargoyles, mended with blackened corpse wax. Deals holy damage.

Such is the mark of those who serve Maliketh, the Black Blade.
location: Guaranteed drop: Grand Lift of Rold (Forbidden Lands) Received upon defeating the Black Blade Kindred before the Grand Lift of Rold, along with the Gargoyle's Black Blades.
whatItIs: A greataxe of 8.5 weight, Gargoyle's Black Axe hits with standard attacks. It comes from beating Black Blade Kindred.
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 100 physical attack and 120 holy, scaling D in Strength, E in Dexterity, and D in Faith. The skill is War Cry, 16 FP.
whenToUse: Gargoyle's Black Axe needs 24 Strength, 8 Dexterity, and 22 Faith, cannot be infused, and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Gargoyle's Black Axe

desc:
A long-hafted golden axe wielded by the Death Knight. Bears a representation of a decayed golden ring. Crackles with lightning, the power of the capital's ancient dragon cult.

The knight, once the personal guard of Godwyn, was also the protector of the Prince of Death's cadaver surrogate.
location: Guaranteed drop: Scorpion River Catacombs (Rauh Base) This weapon is dropped after defeating the Death Knight at Scorpion River Catacombs.
whatItIs: Death Knight's Longhaft Axe is a greataxe weighing 11.5 with standard attacks. Death Knight has to fall first in Ancient Ruins of Rauh before you get this weapon.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 113 physical plus 73 lightning, scaling D in Strength, E in Dexterity, and D in Faith. Its weapon skill is Blinkbolt: Long-hafted Axe, which costs 8 FP.
whenToUse: Death Knight's Longhaft Axe needs 23 Strength, 10 Dexterity, and 18 Faith; it cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Death Knight's Longhaft Axe

desc:
Weapon of the greater potentates of Bonny Village. An outsize butcher's cleaver used to dismember human bodies in the making of the great jars stored in the gaols.

Restores a very small amount of HP when it squarely strikes an enemy.
location: Loot: Bonny Village (Scadu Altus) This weapon can be found at Bonny Village below a small shed outside a house east of the Site of Grace, just west of the broken bridge in the central ravine.
whatItIs: Bonny Butchering Knife belongs to the greataxe class at 8.5 weight, and its attack type is standard. Found at Bonny Village in Scadu Altus.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 134 physical, scaling C in Strength and D in Dexterity. The skill is Hone Blade, 16 FP.
whenToUse: Bonny Butchering Knife needs 16 Strength and 20 Dexterity, cannot be infused, and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Bonny Butchering Knife

desc:
An exceedingly plain spear of modest weight.

Simple to wield compared to many of its peers, its strong attack unleashes a series of successive piercing thrusts.
location: Starting Equipment: 1 is part of the starting equipment of the Prophet origin. Purchase: Roundtable Hold 1 is sold for 600 Runes by the Twin Maiden Husks in Roundtable Hold. Loot: Lands Between / Realm of Shadow A base 4% chance to be dropped by the many Foot Soldiers that wield it in both the...
whatItIs: A spear of 4 weight, Short Spear hits with pierce attacks. For a new player, you have it from the start of the game.
whyItMatters: It starts at 112 physical attack and scales D in Strength and D in Dexterity. The skill is Impaling Thrust, 9 FP.
whenToUse: Short Spear needs 10 Strength and 10 Dexterity, can take Ashes of War and affinity changes, and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Short Spear

desc:
Weapon comprised of a blade attached to a long shaft.

A far-reaching piercing weapon, it can be wielded from behind the safety of a raised shield. Very effective against mounted foes.
location: Drop: Stormveil Castle (Limgrave) / Murkwater Cave (Limgrave) / Liurnia of the Lakes / Mt. Gelmir / Volcano Manor (Mt. Gelmir) / The Shaded Castle (Altus Plateau) Has a base 2% chance to drop from any spear-wielding Exile Soldier in Stormveil Castle, at a 2% drop rate.
whatItIs: Spear is a spear weighing 4.5 with pierce attacks. In practice, it is an enemy drop (a 2% chance).
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 114 physical attack, scaling E in Strength and D in Dexterity. Weapon skill: Impaling Thrust (9 FP).
whenToUse: It can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones, and Spear needs 12 Strength and 15 Dexterity. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Spear

desc:
Spear fashioned from pure crystal; a deed impossible for a human. Enwreathed with powerful magic, its attack scales with intelligence.
The inscrutable Crystalians have but one clear purpose; to safeguard their crystals unto the end. One theory posits that they yearn for the return of their creator who will carve for them new brethren.
location: Found inside a chest behind an illusory wall in Sellia Hideaway, located in Caelid. ru:Кристальное копьё
whatItIs: Crystal Spear is a spear weighing 5.5 with pierce attacks. A chest in Caelid holds it.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 110 physical plus 33 magic, scaling E in Strength, D in Dexterity, and E in Intelligence. The skill is Impaling Thrust, 9 FP.
whenToUse: Crystal Spear needs 10 Strength, 16 Dexterity, and 16 Intelligence, cannot be infused, and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Crystal Spear

desc:
Harpoon with a tip made from a sharpened meteorite shard. Wielded by the claymen who infest dynastic remains.
The blade emits a faint light and deals magic damage.
location: Drop: Siofra River / Ainsel River The slow-moving Claymen enemies have a 2% chance to drop this item. ru:Гарпун глиняного человека
whatItIs: Clayman's Harpoon is a spear weighing 5.5 with pierce attacks. Enemies in Siofra River drop it (a 2% chance).
whyItMatters: Base attack is 99 physical plus 64 magic, scaling D in Strength, E in Dexterity, and D in Intelligence. Weapon skill: Impaling Thrust (9 FP).
whenToUse: Clayman's Harpoon needs 12 Strength, 10 Dexterity, and 12 Intelligence; it can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Clayman's Harpoon

desc:
Spear of the Cleanrot Knights who fought alongside Malenia, Blade of Miquella.
The winged golden blade deals holy damage. The diminutive shield is blessed with an incantation that wards off rot.
Unique Skill: Sacred Phalanx
Release the power of a hidden incantation to erect a palisade of golden spears frontwards.
location: Cleanrot Knights have a chance to drop this item.
whatItIs: A spear of 5.5 weight, Cleanrot Spear hits with pierce attacks. An enemy drop.
whyItMatters: It starts at 102 physical attack with 66 holy on top and scales D in Strength, D in Dexterity, and D in Faith. Weapon skill: Sacred Phalanx (12 FP).
whenToUse: Cleanrot Spear needs 16 Strength, 16 Dexterity, and 14 Faith, cannot be infused, and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Cleanrot Spear

desc:
Spear with a wide tip.

In addition to its thrusting attacks, this highly versatile weapon can be swung to sweep through foes.
location: Drop: Limgrave / Liurnia of the Lakes / Caelid / Mt. Gelmir / Leyndell, Royal Capital / Deeproot Depths Can be dropped from Knight enemies that wield it, such as the Godrick Knight in the Gatefront Ruins in Limgrave, or the two Leyndell Knight near the Ninth Mt. Gelmir Campsite grace in Mt. Gelmir.
whatItIs: A spear of 6.5 weight, Partisan hits with pierce attacks. Look for it as a drop from Knight in Limgrave.
whyItMatters: It starts at 123 physical attack and scales D in Strength and D in Dexterity. Its weapon skill is Impaling Thrust, which costs 9 FP.
whenToUse: Partisan needs 15 Strength and 12 Dexterity; it can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Partisan

desc:
Rake decorated with many-colored fabrics. Ceremonial tool used by dancers during the festivities of Dominula, Windmill Village.
Crafted from human bone. Grants trace amounts of runes upon landing attacks.
location: 0.5% drop rate from the Dominula Dancers wielding them in Dominula, Windmill Village, located in the north of Altus Plateau. ru:Праздничные ребристые грабли
whatItIs: A spear of 5 weight, Celebrant's Rib-Rake hits with pierce attacks. It is an enemy drop (a 0.5% chance).
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 109 physical attack, scaling E in Strength and D in Dexterity. The skill is Barbaric Roar, 16 FP.
whenToUse: Celebrant's Rib-Rake needs 8 Strength and 14 Dexterity; it can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Celebrant's Rib-Rake

desc:
A longspear featuring an especially lengthy handle.

Specialized for use from long distances, it boasts the longest reach of any melee weapon. Incredibly useful even against foes on horseback, but hard to wield in cramped spaces.
location: Loot: Stormveil Castle (Limgrave) Found on a corpse inside Stormveil Castle, in the open area with flamethrower enemies.
whatItIs: Pike is a spear weighing 7.5 with pierce attacks. Corpse loot at Stormveil Castle.
whyItMatters: In practice, it starts at 115 physical attack and scales D in Strength and D in Dexterity. The skill on it is Charge Forth at 16 FP.
whenToUse: It can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones, and Pike needs 20 Strength and 14 Dexterity. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Pike

desc:
Torch fastened to a long pole. Lights up dark areas, but cannot be raised overhead.
Used by soldiers on watch, its attacks set foes aflame.
location: Dropped by the Exile Soldiers that wield it in Stormveil Castle.
whatItIs: Torchpole belongs to the spear class at 6 weight, and its attack type is pierce. It drops from Exile Soldiers.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 104 physical plus 31 fire, scaling D in Strength and D in Dexterity. Weapon skill: Charge Forth (16 FP).
whenToUse: Torchpole needs 14 Strength and 15 Dexterity; it cannot be infused and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Torchpole

desc:
Spear whittled from the weapon wielded by Gransax. One of the legendary armaments.
A great ancient dragon, Gransax once rained calamity upon the Royal Capital - the only time in historical record that Leyndell's walls have fallen. This marked the dawn of the war against the ancient dragons.
Unique Skill: Ancient Lightning Spear
Imbue the armament with the ancient dragons' red lightning, then throw it as a spear. Can be charged to increase its power.
location: Located in Leyndell, Royal Capital. Exit the Erdtree Sanctuary and descend with the elevator, then jump over the street railing and down onto the building below. The spear is on top of its gigantic version. Warning: This item is not present in Leyndell, Ashen Capital. It must be obtained prior...
whatItIs: Bolt of Gransax is a spear weighing 8.5 with pierce attacks. Found in Leyndell, Royal Capital.
whyItMatters: It starts at 98 physical attack with 63 lightning on top and scales D in Strength and D in Dexterity. Ancient Lightning Spear is its weapon skill, costing 25 FP per use.
whenToUse: It cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones, and Bolt of Gransax needs 20 Strength and 40 Dexterity. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Bolt of Gransax

desc:
Weapon consisting of a three-pronged blade affixed to a long pole. The long central blade closely resembles a katana.
A weapon of the Land of Reeds, known for its ability to be wielded as a spear while still being capable of performing slashing attacks.
location: Looted from a body in the Gael Tunnel. ru:Крестовая нагината
whatItIs: Cross-Naginata belongs to the spear class at 8 weight, and its attack type is pierce. Gael Tunnel is where it is found.
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 122 physical attack, scaling D in Strength and C in Dexterity. Each hit builds up blood loss (50). Weapon skill: Impaling Thrust (9 FP).
whenToUse: Cross-Naginata needs 16 Strength and 20 Dexterity, can take Ashes of War and affinity changes, and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Cross-Naginata

desc:
Ritual spear used by priests of old who were permitted to come among the Deathbirds.

The priests became guardians of the birds through the rite of Death, which also serves as an oath sworn to their distant resurrection.
location: Guaranteed Drop: Mountaintops of the Giants Dropped by the Death Rite Bird on the Mountaintops of the Giants, found just southwest of Castle Sol. This is the only Death Rite Bird that is active all day, instead of only at night.
whatItIs: A spear of 6.5 weight, Death Ritual Spear hits with pierce attacks. Dropped by Death Rite Bird.
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 99 physical attack and 64 magic, scaling E in Strength, D in Dexterity, and D in Intelligence. Spearcall Ritual is its weapon skill, costing 20 FP per use. Its critical value is 110.
whenToUse: Death Ritual Spear needs 14 Strength, 20 Dexterity, and 18 Intelligence, cannot be infused, and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Death Ritual Spear

desc:
Instrument of torture used on nobles behind the curtain at the Volcano Manor of Mt. Gelmir.

Its numerous spikes pierce the flesh, then singe the wounds with flame. The smell of burnt blood induces despair in the victim. A candlestick conceived by a thorough mind.
location: Guaranteed Drop: Volcano Manor (Mt. Gelmir) Received upon defeating the Abductor Virgin duo boss in Volcano Manor. ru:Подсвечник инквизитора
whatItIs: A spear of 7.5 weight, Inquisitor's Girandole hits with pierce attacks. Abductor Virgin has to fall first in Mt. Gelmir before you get this weapon.
whyItMatters: It starts at 102 physical attack with 66 fire on top and scales D in Strength, D in Dexterity, and D in Faith. Hits carry blood loss (50) buildup. Charge Forth is its weapon skill, costing 16 FP per use.
whenToUse: Inquisitor's Girandole needs 18 Strength, 15 Dexterity, and 16 Faith, cannot be infused, and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Inquisitor's Girandole

desc:
Weapon comprised of a spiked cylinder attached to a long pole. Capable of dealing strike damage when swung. The spikes induce blood loss.
Weapon of the Marionette Soldiers employed by sorcerers.
location: Dropped by the spear wielding Marionette Soldier enemies.
whatItIs: A spear of 6 weight, Spiked Spear hits with pierce attacks. It is an enemy drop.
whyItMatters: It starts at 120 physical attack and scales D in Strength and D in Dexterity. Hits carry blood loss (50) buildup. Weapon skill: Impaling Thrust (9 FP).
whenToUse: Spiked Spear needs 14 Strength and 16 Dexterity; it can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Spiked Spear

desc: Commonly used iron spear with no notable traits. The blade is severely rusted.
location: Drop: Nokron, Eternal City 2% drop from the spear wielding Fallen Hawk Soldiers near the Nokron, Eternal City grace.
whatItIs: Iron Spear is a spear weighing 4.5 with pierce attacks. An enemy drop in Nokron, Eternal City (a 2% chance).
whyItMatters: Base attack is 114 physical, scaling D in Strength and D in Dexterity. Weapon skill: Charge Forth (16 FP).
whenToUse: Iron Spear needs 13 Strength and 11 Dexterity; it can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Iron Spear

desc:
Spear fashioned from pure crystal; a deed impossible for a human. It festers with scarlet rot.
Enwreathed with powerful magic, its attack scales with intelligence.
location: Drop: Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree 8% drop from the Putrid Crystalian enemies that wield it. ru:Гнилое кристальное копьё
whatItIs: Rotten Crystal Spear belongs to the spear class at 5.5 weight, and its attack type is pierce. Putrid Crystalian can drop it (a 8% chance).
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 104 physical attack and 31 magic, scaling E in Strength, D in Dexterity, and E in Intelligence. Each hit builds up scarlet rot (55). The skill is Charge Forth, 16 FP.
whenToUse: Rotten Crystal Spear needs 10 Strength, 16 Dexterity, and 16 Intelligence; it cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Rotten Crystal Spear

desc:
Spear engraved with a smithscript. A throwing weapon created through the smithing arts.

Execute a strong attack, a dashing strong attack, or a mounted strong attack to throw the spear.
location: The weapon can be found at Ruined Forge of Starfall Past after looting a body on the main floor of said location.
whatItIs: Smithscript Spear is a spear weighing 4 with standard and pierce attacks. Ruined Forge of Starfall Past is where it is found.
whyItMatters: It starts at 107 physical attack and scales D in Strength, D in Dexterity, E in Intelligence, and E in Faith. Weapon skill: Impaling Thrust (9 FP).
whenToUse: Smithscript Spear needs 9 Strength, 12 Dexterity, 11 Intelligence, and 11 Faith, can take Ashes of War and affinity changes, and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Smithscript Spear

desc:
A metal-bodied spear of extremely lightweight make, being the result of a sophisticated molding technique.

Capable of swift consecutive attacks.
location: The weapon can be found lying on a corpse guarded by 3 Messmer Soldiers along the road going South-East from the Castle Front site of grace.
whatItIs: Swift Spear belongs to the spear class at 3 weight, and its attack type is standard and pierce. A corpse carries it.
whyItMatters: It starts at 99 physical attack and scales C in Dexterity. The skill is Impaling Thrust, 9 FP.
whenToUse: It can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones, and Swift Spear needs 10 Strength and 26 Dexterity. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Swift Spear

desc:
Weapon used by the bloodfiends. Three tines of carved bone spear the victim to provoke blood loss.

A ritual implement for blood offerings to the Formless Mother. At times, the bloodfiends will spill even their own blood using these forks.
location: Random Drop: Prospect Town, Rivermouth Cave, Stone Coffin Fissure (Gravesite Plain), Rauh Base 3% chance of dropping from Bloodfiends who carry this item.
whatItIs: Bloodfiend's Fork belongs to the spear class at 4.5 weight, and its attack type is standard and pierce. For a new player, an enemy drop in Gravesite Plain (a 3% chance).
whyItMatters: It starts at 103 physical attack and scales D in Strength, E in Dexterity, and D in Arcane. Hits carry blood loss (50) buildup. Weapon skill: Barbaric Roar (16 FP).
whenToUse: Bloodfiend's Fork needs 14 Strength, 8 Dexterity, and 13 Arcane; it can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Bloodfiend's Fork

desc:
Greatspear of the bloodfiend hexers. One of the most significant implements used in their blood rituals.

Sacred spears of blood are the instruments of communion with an outer god. The mother of truth desires a wound.
location: Guaranteed Drop: Rauh Base (Land of the Tower) Acquired after defeating a Bloodfiend Hexer in the small pond west of Taylew’s Ruined Forge. Must be physically picked up after killing the enemy.
whatItIs: Bloodfiend's Sacred Spear is a great spear weighing 8 with standard and pierce attacks. Enemies in Ancient Ruins of Rauh drop it.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 115 physical, scaling E in Strength, E in Dexterity, and C in Arcane. Hits carry blood loss (55) buildup. Weapon skill: Bloodfiend's Bloodboon (20 FP).
whenToUse: Bloodfiend's Sacred Spear needs 22 Strength, 12 Dexterity, and 13 Arcane; it cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Bloodfiend's Sacred Spear

desc:
Trident of Mohg, Lord of Blood. A sacred spear that will come to symbolize his dynasty.

As well as serving as a weapon, it is an instrument of communion with an outer god who bestows power upon accursed blood. The mother of truth desires a wound.
location: Trade: Finger Reader Enia Trade the Remembrance of the Blood Lord, dropped by Mohg, Lord of Blood, with Finger Reader Enia. Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums with a bell to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).
whatItIs: A great spear of 10 weight, Mohgwyn's Sacred Spear hits with pierce attacks. Trade in the Remembrance of the Blood Lord with Finger Reader Enia to get it.
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 96 physical attack and 62 fire, scaling D in Strength, E in Dexterity, and D in Arcane. Hits carry blood loss (55) buildup. Its weapon skill is Bloodboon Ritual, which costs 20 FP.
whenToUse: It cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones, and Mohgwyn's Sacred Spear needs 24 Strength, 14 Dexterity, and 27 Arcane. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Mohgwyn's Sacred Spear

desc:
Siluria's Tree, weapon of one of the two honored as foremost among the Crucible Knights.
The primordial form of the Erdtree is close in nature to life itself, and this spear, modeled on its crucible, is imbued with ancient holy essence.
Unique Skill: Siluria's Woe
Thrust the weapon in a spiraling motion, surrounding it in a vortex of wind. Charged attacks have the power to blow away enemies and can fire the tornado forwards.
location: Guaranteed Drop: Deeproot Depths Received upon defeating Crucible Knight Siluria.
whatItIs: A great spear of 10 weight, Siluria's Tree hits with pierce attacks. Beat Crucible Knight Siluria in Deeproot Depths to get it.
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 90 physical attack and 90 holy, scaling D in Strength, E in Dexterity, and D in Faith. Its weapon skill is Siluria's Woe, which costs 25 FP.
whenToUse: Siluria's Tree needs 27 Strength, 13 Dexterity, and 20 Faith; it cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Siluria's Tree

desc:
Weapon that serves as both greatsword and spear. Thought to have been used to hunt an immortal great serpent in the distant past, it manifests a long blade of light when facing such a creature.

When their master's heroic aspirations degenerated into mere greed, his men searched for a weapon with which they might halt their lord.
location: Mt. Gelmir (Volcano Manor) Loot: Can be picked up within the boss arena of Praetor Rykard. This item does not re-spawn when the player has one in either their inventory or chest, even in NG+. However it will re-spawn (and thus can be picked up again) from the same location should the player...
whatItIs: Serpent-Hunter belongs to the great spear class at 12 weight, and its attack type is pierce. Found in a chest in Mt. Gelmir.
whyItMatters: It starts at 111 physical attack and scales B in Strength and E in Dexterity. The skill on it is Great-Serpent Hunt at 10 FP.
whenToUse: It cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones, and Serpent-Hunter has no stat requirements. Try it the moment you find it.
name: Serpent-Hunter

desc:
War spear singed and blistered by fingers, used by Vyke, Knight of the Roundtable Hold.

Like Vyke himself, it has been tormented by the yellow flame of frenzy from within.
location: Guaranteed Drop: Church of Inhibition (Liurnia of the Lakes) Received upon defeating Festering Fingerprint Vyke.
whatItIs: A great spear of 8 weight, Vyke's War Spear hits with pierce attacks. Festering Fingerprint Vyke has to fall first in Liurnia of the Lakes before you get this weapon.
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 103 physical attack and 66 fire, scaling E in Strength, C in Dexterity, and D in Faith. It applies madness (65) buildup on hit. The skill is Frenzyflame Thrust, 14 FP.
whenToUse: It cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones, and Vyke's War Spear needs 16 Strength, 20 Dexterity, and 18 Faith. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Vyke's War Spear

desc:
Considered a type of greatspear, this weapon has no blade, but instead features a long, conical body designed to pierce.

Though heavy and hard to wield, this weapon displays its worth in horseback combat whether mounted or even on foot.
location: Loot: Limgrave Found on a corpse on a squarish ruin, northeast of the Warmaster's Shack.
whatItIs: Lance is a great spear weighing 9 with pierce attacks. Corpse loot in Limgrave.
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 123 physical attack, scaling D in Strength and D in Dexterity. Weapon skill: Charge Forth (16 FP).
whenToUse: It can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones, and Lance needs 20 Strength and 14 Dexterity. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Lance

desc:
Golden spear with tree-like design. Wielded by knights employed as palace guards in the Royal Capital of Leyndell. Deals holy damage.
Requiring superior dexterity to wield, this greatspear can perform consecutive thrust attacks despite its larger size.
location: Found inside a caravan south of the Liurnia Highway South Site of Grace, located in Liurnia of the Lakes.
whatItIs: A great spear of 9.5 weight, Treespear hits with pierce attacks. Found in Liurnia of the Lakes.
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 122 physical attack and 79 holy, scaling D in Strength, D in Dexterity, and D in Faith. Sacred Order is its weapon skill, costing 18 FP per use.
whenToUse: Treespear needs 15 Strength, 22 Dexterity, and 18 Faith; it cannot be infused and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Treespear

desc:
Weapon of Messmer the Impaler. 
A greatspear with a warped blade in the shape of undulating flame.

Remade by the forging arts of the realm of shadow, this weapon can be thrown by executing a strong attack, dashing strong attack, or mounted strong attack. Charge the attack to produce flame on impact.
location: Can be obtained after trading Remembrance of the Impaler with Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold.
whatItIs: Spear of the Impaler is a great spear weighing 9.5 with standard and pierce attacks. Trade in the Remembrance of the Impaler with Finger Reader Enia to get it.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 85 physical plus 102 fire, scaling E in Strength, C in Dexterity, and D in Faith. The skill is Messmer's Assault, 15 FP.
whenToUse: Spear of the Impaler needs 14 Strength, 35 Dexterity, and 18 Faith, cannot be infused, and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Spear of the Impaler

desc:
Weapon used by the soldiers who serve Messmer the Impaler. A greatspear with a steel blade worn from use.

Being made for overwhelming onslaughts, attacks with this weapon can be charged to unleash consecutive strikes.
location: Drop: Realm of Shadow There is a base 2.00% chance where Messmer Soldiers can drop this weapon. Three wielding spears can be found at a camp to the west from Moorth Ruins site of grace.
whatItIs: Messmer Soldier's Spear belongs to the great spear class at 8.5 weight, and its attack type is standard and pierce. An enemy drop in the Land of Shadow (a 2.00% chance).
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 122 physical attack, scaling D in Strength and D in Dexterity. Weapon skill: Impaling Thrust (9 FP).
whenToUse: Messmer Soldier's Spear needs 19 Strength and 16 Dexterity, can take Ashes of War and affinity changes, and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Messmer Soldier's Spear

desc:
Greatstaff of Jori, elder inquisitor. The tip bristles with golden barbs symbolic of the inquisition's torture, allowing one to wield the staff as a greatspear.

Attacks deal holy damage, and potency increases with faith.
location: Guaranteed Drop: Darklight Catacombs (Scadu Altus) Dropped by Jori, Elder Inquisitor.
whatItIs: A great spear of 7.5 weight, Barbed Staff-Spear hits with standard and pierce attacks. Look for it as a drop from Jori, Elder Inquisitor in Scadu Altus.
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 86 physical attack and 86 holy, scaling E in Strength, E in Dexterity, and C in Faith. Hits carry blood loss (55) buildup. The skill on it is Jori's Inquisition at 4 FP.
whenToUse: It cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones, and Barbed Staff-Spear needs 14 Strength, 18 Dexterity, and 22 Faith. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Barbed Staff-Spear

desc:
A long-handed polearm that combines the functions of both axe and spear.
Can be used to press a single enemy with continuous thrusting attacks, or swept at groups, taking advantage of its great reach and cleaving blade. A versatile weapon for any situation.
location: Nomadic Merchant east of Saintsbridge (x1) Starting equipment of the Vagabond class.
whatItIs: A halberd of 8 weight, Halberd hits with standard and pierce attacks. The Vagabond class starts with it.
whyItMatters: It starts at 125 physical attack and scales D in Strength and D in Dexterity. Weapon skill: Charge Forth (16 FP).
whenToUse: It can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones, and Halberd needs 14 Strength and 12 Dexterity. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Halberd

desc:
Glaive made from a hard, sharpened shell. Wielded by the pests who emerged from the Swamp of Aeonia. Slightly increases non-physical damage negation.
Though men might recognize the keen intellect of the pests evidenced by this spear's uncanny design, it will never be understood by them.
location: Chance to drop from Kindred of Rot enemies.
whatItIs: Pest's Glaive is a halberd weighing 7 with standard and pierce attacks. Dropped by Kindred of Rot.
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 120 physical attack, scaling D in Strength and D in Dexterity. Spinning Slash is its weapon skill.
whenToUse: Pest's Glaive needs 13 Strength and 13 Dexterity; it can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Pest's Glaive

desc:
This polearm features a hard, sharpened beak-like spike attached to its head, designed to pierce armor.
Though designed mainly as a thrusting weapon, its long handle can be utilized to get around an enemy's guard with a sideward sweeping attack.
location: Found north of the Liurnia Highway North grace, near a broken wagon. ru:Люцернский молот
whatItIs: A halberd of 7 weight, Lucerne hits with pierce attacks. Found in Liurnia of the Lakes.
whyItMatters: It starts at 121 physical attack and scales D in Strength and C in Dexterity. Its weapon skill is Charge Forth, which costs 16 FP.
whenToUse: Lucerne needs 15 Strength and 12 Dexterity, can take Ashes of War and affinity changes, and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Lucerne

desc:
A finely-crafted halberd intricately engraved with an ancient motif. Given to knights who, whether by misfortune or misdeed, were forced to abandon their homes.
Most of these knights were sent to the fringes, where they were forced to start anew with only despair for company.
location: +8 version dropped by Edgar. Dropped by Banished Knight enemies that wield it. One can be found near the Rampart Tower Site of Grace in Stormveil Castle.
whatItIs: Banished Knight's Halberd is a halberd weighing 8 with standard and pierce attacks. Dropped by Edgar.
whyItMatters: In practice, it starts at 125 physical attack and scales D in Strength and D in Dexterity. The skill is Charge Forth.
whenToUse: It can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones, and Banished Knight's Halberd needs 14 Strength and 12 Dexterity. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Banished Knight's Halberd

desc:
A beaten red battle standard is furled around this time-worn halberd.
Even after his lord was fled, Commander O'Neil continued to brandish this flag in the devastation of the rot-eaten field of battle, the sole veteran who remembers this battle with pride.
Unique Skill : Rallying Standard
Hoist the war banner aloft and give a rallying command. Raises attack power and defense for self and nearby allies.
