location: Received upon defeating Commander O'Neil in Aeonia Swamp located in Caelid. Category:Halberds ru:Штандарт командующего
whatItIs: Commander's Standard is a halberd weighing 11.5 with standard and pierce attacks. Beat Commander O'Neil for it.
whyItMatters: In practice, base attack is 138 physical, scaling D in Strength and D in Dexterity. The skill on it is Rallying Standard at 30 FP.
whenToUse: It cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones, and Commander's Standard needs 24 Strength and 14 Dexterity. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Commander's Standard

desc:
A jet-black glaive with a blade as weighty as a bludgeon. Weapon of the Night's Cavalry who ride funeral steeds.

This glaive excels at weighty slash attacks that crash into foes, making it a powerful weapon even on horseback.
location: Guaranteed Drop: Liurnia of the Lakes Dropped together with the Ash of War: Giant Hunt by a Night's Cavalry miniboss in Liurnia of the Lakes, immediately north of the East Raya Lucaria Gate grace where the Finger Reader Crone is. The Night's Cavalry only comes out during nighttime.
whatItIs: A halberd of 12 weight, Nightrider Glaive hits with standard and pierce attacks. Enemies in Liurnia of the Lakes drop it.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 129 physical, scaling C in Strength and E in Dexterity. Weapon skill: Spinning Slash (6 FP).
whenToUse: Nightrider Glaive needs 26 Strength and 10 Dexterity, can take Ashes of War and affinity changes, and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Nightrider Glaive

desc:
Weapon wielded by young Albinaurics.

The blade is said to resemble a partial image of a ripple, and its attack power scales with one's arcane attribute.
location: Drop: Liurnia of the Lakes / Consecrated Snowfield / Mohgwyn Palace Has a base 2% chance to be dropped by the Second-Generation Albinaurics that wield it.
whatItIs: Ripple Crescent Halberd is a halberd weighing 8.5 with standard and pierce attacks. It drops from Second-Generation Albinaurics in Liurnia of the Lakes (a 2% chance).
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 86 physical attack, scaling B in Arcane. Weapon skill: Spinning Slash (6 FP).
whenToUse: It cannot be infused and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones, and Ripple Crescent Halberd needs 12 Strength, 12 Dexterity, and 20 Arcane. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Ripple Crescent Halberd

desc:
A weapon comprised of a saw blade attached to a long grip. Brandished by the vulgar militia, its serrated edge is very effective at inflicting blood loss.
The saw is said to also be used to cut up bodies to feed the militia, but there are no firsthand witnesses to confirm the dire rumor.
location: Dropped by Vulgar Militia enemies that wield it. ru:Пила плебея-ополченца
whatItIs: A halberd of 8 weight, Vulgar Militia Saw hits with standard and pierce attacks. Dropped by Vulgar Militia.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 126 physical, scaling D in Strength and D in Dexterity. Hits carry blood loss (55) buildup. Weapon skill: Spinning Slash (6 FP).
whenToUse: Vulgar Militia Saw needs 15 Strength and 13 Dexterity, can take Ashes of War and affinity changes, and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Vulgar Militia Saw

desc:
Weighty halberd forged of gold. Wielded by the Order of Tree Sentinels, heavily equipped knights. Deals holy damage.

A masterfully crafted weapon that lives up to its heft, but is difficult for one of mere human strength to wield.
location: Guaranteed Drop: Limgrave Received upon defeating the Tree Sentinel in Limgrave.
whatItIs: Golden Halberd is a halberd weighing 13.5 with standard and pierce attacks. It comes from beating Tree Sentinel in Limgrave.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 134 physical plus 87 holy, scaling D in Strength, E in Dexterity, and D in Faith. Weapon skill: Golden Vow (40 FP).
whenToUse: It cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones, and Golden Halberd needs 30 Strength, 14 Dexterity, and 12 Faith. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Golden Halberd

desc:
Weapon comprised of a sharp blade affixed to a long grip. It is in fact a sickle repurposed to be a tool of war.
This far-reaching weapon excels at slashing attacks.
location: Dropped by Graveyard Skeleton enemies that wield it such as the one near the Sellia Backstreets grace in Caelid. ru:Глефа
whatItIs: Glaive is a halberd weighing 10 with standard and pierce attacks. Look for it as a drop from Graveyard Skeleton in Caelid.
whyItMatters: It starts at 132 physical attack and scales D in Strength and D in Dexterity. Weapon skill: Spinning Slash (6 FP).
whenToUse: It can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones, and Glaive needs 18 Strength and 15 Dexterity. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Glaive

desc:
Intricately crafted silver war sickle wielded by Loretta, Knight of the Haligtree.
Originally given for service as a personal guard to Carian royalty, the weapon's blue glintstone has been replaced with unalloyed gold.
location: Received upon defeating Loretta, Knight of the Haligtree.
whatItIs: Loretta's War Sickle belongs to the halberd class at 10 weight, and its attack type is standard and pierce. Beat Loretta, Knight of the Haligtree for it.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 110 physical plus 71 magic, scaling D in Strength, D in Dexterity, and D in Intelligence. The skill is Loretta's Slash, 14 FP.
whenToUse: Loretta's War Sickle needs 20 Strength, 15 Dexterity, and 20 Intelligence, cannot be infused, and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Loretta's War Sickle

desc:
Weapon comprising a long handle and broad blade sharpened from the hard wood of old trees.
Wielded by guardians of the Minor Erdtrees, known as experts in the arts of combat. The power of this weapon scales greatly with dexterity.
location: Erdtree Guardian enemies have a ~2% chance to drop this item.
whatItIs: Guardian's Swordspear belongs to the halberd class at 9 weight, and its attack type is standard and pierce. An enemy drop (a 2% chance).
whyItMatters: It starts at 139 physical attack and scales E in Strength and C in Dexterity. Weapon skill: Spinning Slash (6 FP).
whenToUse: Guardian's Swordspear needs 17 Strength and 16 Dexterity; it can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Guardian's Swordspear

desc:
A hooked blade attached to a long handle. Wielded by the vulgar militia, its attacks can slip through an enemy's guard.
The vulgar militia are undecorated stewards of rancid, scorched battlefields that none dare approach, and forbidden domains better forgotten by the rest of the world.
location: Dropped by Vulgar Militia enemies that wield it. ru:Шотель плебея-ополченца
whatItIs: Vulgar Militia Shotel is a halberd weighing 8 with standard and pierce attacks. Vulgar Militia can drop it.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 121 physical, scaling E in Strength and C in Dexterity. Weapon skill: Spinning Slash (6 FP).
whenToUse: Vulgar Militia Shotel needs 14 Strength and 16 Dexterity; it can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Vulgar Militia Shotel

desc:
Halberd shaped like a dragon, enwreathed with both ice and lightning.

Alas, the Dragonkin Soldiers never attained immortality, and perished as decrepit, pale imitations of their skyborn kin.
location: Guaranteed Drop: Siofra River Dropped by the Dragonkin Soldier boss after a gateway portal in the lower Siofra River region.
whatItIs: A halberd of 10.5 weight, Dragon Halberd hits with standard and pierce attacks. It drops from Dragonkin Soldier in Siofra River.
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 135 physical attack, scaling D in Strength and D in Dexterity. The skill on it is Spinning Slash at 17 FP.
whenToUse: It cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones, and Dragon Halberd needs 22 Strength and 10 Dexterity. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Dragon Halberd

desc:
Bronze halberd wielded by Valiant Gargoyles.
Just like the wielder, the missing parts have been mended with corpse wax, a patchwork of champions.
location: Received upon defeating the Gargoyle enemy near the West Capital Rampart grace, located in Leyndell.
whatItIs: Gargoyle's Halberd is a halberd weighing 12 with standard and pierce attacks. It comes from beating Gargoyle in Leyndell, Royal Capital.
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 131 physical attack, scaling C in Strength and E in Dexterity. Its weapon skill is Spinning Slash.
whenToUse: It can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones, and Gargoyle's Halberd needs 26 Strength and 10 Dexterity. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Gargoyle's Halberd

desc:
Bronze halberd wielded by Valiant Gargoyles, mended with blackened corpse wax. Deals holy damage.
Such is the mark of those who serve Maliketh, the Black Blade.
location: Dropped upon defeating the Black Blade Kindred guarding the Bestial Sanctum in Caelid. ru:Чёрная алебарда горгулий
whatItIs: Gargoyle's Black Halberd belongs to the halberd class at 12 weight, and its attack type is standard and pierce. Black Blade Kindred has to fall first in Caelid before you get this weapon.
whyItMatters: It starts at 103 physical attack with 123 holy on top and scales D in Strength, E in Dexterity, and D in Faith. The skill on it is Spinning Slash.
whenToUse: It cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones, and Gargoyle's Black Halberd needs 26 Strength, 10 Dexterity, and 22 Faith. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Gargoyle's Black Halberd

desc:
Sharp blade sculpted into a twisted shape. A glaive that has seen many years of use in the gravesite.

Said to serve as a medium for communion with spirits.
location: In order to obtain this weapon, you first start at the site of grace at Charo's Hidden Grave and walk through the arch to the northwest, turn right directly after and take the path that ramps up north, follow it to where it meets the edge of the Gravesite Plains and it will be on a grave.
whatItIs: A halberd of 6.5 weight, Spirit Glaive hits with slash and pierce attacks. Located in Gravesite Plain.
whyItMatters: It starts at 121 physical attack with 36 magic on top and scales D in Strength, D in Dexterity, and D in Intelligence. Its weapon skill is Rancor Slash, which costs 12 FP.
whenToUse: Spirit Glaive needs 14 Strength, 17 Dexterity, and 16 Intelligence; it cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Spirit Glaive

desc:
Weapon of Romina, Saint of the Bud. A scarlet glaive with a dangling bud-like blade. Attacks cause buildup of rot.

Once, in the crumbling, burning church, Romina held the bud in speechless silence. That bud would become her blade.
location: Trade: Remembrance of the Saint of the Bud Trade the Remembrance of the Saint of the Bud with Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold.
whatItIs: Poleblade of the Bud is a halberd weighing 10 with slash and pierce attacks. The Remembrance of the Saint of the Bud buys it.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 131 physical, scaling E in Strength, D in Dexterity, and D in Arcane. It applies scarlet rot (55) buildup on hit. The skill on it is Romina's Purification at 24 FP.
whenToUse: It cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones, and Poleblade of the Bud needs 14 Strength, 22 Dexterity, and 20 Arcane. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Poleblade of the Bud

desc:
Large scythe featuring a long, slender blade. Designed to reap, this weapon is capable of rapidly inflicting blood loss while also slipping through an enemy's guard.
In the hands of a highly dexterous wielder it is capable of striking fear into the heart of any foe.
location: Cliffbottom Catacombs, southeast Liurnia of the Lakes. On a boddy in the upper floor, guarded by four stone Imps.
whatItIs: Scythe belongs to the reaper class at 7.5 weight, and its attack type is slash. Located in Liurnia of the Lakes.
whyItMatters: It starts at 125 physical attack and scales E in Strength and C in Dexterity. Each hit builds up blood loss (55). The skill is Spinning Slash, 6 FP.
whenToUse: It can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones, and Scythe needs 14 Strength and 14 Dexterity. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Scythe

desc:
Greatscythe comprised of a large blade affixed to a crooked stick. Weapon wielded by the aged grave keepers who tend the forgotten graveyards throughout the Lands Between.

This weapon is said to have served as a charm against evil spirits in times of old.
location: Has a base 2% drop chance from the Skeleton enemies wielding it.
whatItIs: A reaper of 9.5 weight, Grave Scythe hits with slash attacks. It drops from Skeleton (a 2% chance).
whyItMatters: It starts at 144 physical attack and scales D in Strength and D in Dexterity. Hits carry blood loss (55) buildup. Weapon skill: Spinning Slash (6 FP).
whenToUse: It can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones, and Grave Scythe needs 17 Strength and 13 Dexterity. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Grave Scythe

desc:
War scythe of the Cleanrot Knights who fought alongside Malenia, Blade of Miquella.
This was the weapon of commanders in Malenia's army, and the half-halo blade deals holy damage.
Unique Skill: Miquella's Ring of Light
Summon Miquella's shining halo and fire it forwards. Can be fired in rapid succession.
location: Dropped by Cleanrot Knights. ru:Сияющая коса
whatItIs: Halo Scythe belongs to the reaper class at 8.5 weight, and its attack type is slash. It drops from Cleanrot Knights.
whyItMatters: It starts at 118 physical attack with 76 holy on top and scales D in Strength, D in Dexterity, and E in Faith. Hits carry blood loss (55) buildup. Weapon skill: Miquella's Ring of Light (11 FP).
whenToUse: Halo Scythe needs 13 Strength, 16 Dexterity, and 15 Faith; it cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Halo Scythe

desc:
Sacred scythe resembling a pair of white wings. Deals holy damage.
According to pagan belief, white-winged maidens are said to be Death's gentle envoys.
Unique Skill : Angel's Wings
Jump and imbue the wing-blade of the armament with light, then deliver a slashing attack on the enemy. The white wings impede recovery actions using a flask of tears.
location: Found underground in the Tombsward Ruins, on the Weeping Peninsula.
whatItIs: Winged Scythe is a reaper weighing 7.5 with slash attacks. Look for it in Weeping Peninsula.
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 87 physical attack and 104 holy, scaling E in Strength, D in Dexterity, and D in Faith. Hits carry blood loss (55) buildup. Angel's Wings is its weapon skill, costing 17 FP per use.
whenToUse: Winged Scythe needs 16 Strength, 16 Dexterity, and 24 Faith; it cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Winged Scythe

desc:
Signature weapon of the Pureblood Knight Ansbach. A viciously keen and slender scythe made for combat.

The obsidian edge relies not upon trickery to fulfil its violent purpose—through skill alone the wielder can rip and rend through foes, sowing blossoms of red upon the battlefield.
location: Quest reward: Enir-Ilim (Land of the Tower) Available after successfully assisting Sir Ansbach in his battle against Needle Knight Leda at the Specimen Storehouse. Then defeating Promised Consort Radahn. The item can be recovered from Ansbach's body, which can be found seated against one of the...
whatItIs: A reaper of 6.5 weight, Obsidian Lamina hits with slash attacks. Promised Consort Radahn has to fall first in Enir-Ilim before you get this weapon.
whyItMatters: It starts at 120 physical attack and scales E in Strength, C in Dexterity, and D in Arcane. Hits carry blood loss (55) buildup. Its weapon skill is Dynastic Sickleplay, which costs 7 FP.
whenToUse: It cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones, and Obsidian Lamina needs 12 Strength, 25 Dexterity, and 17 Arcane. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Obsidian Lamina

desc:
A leather whip. Not originally used for combat, but as an instrument of pain.

Through its supple attacks cannot be thwarted by parrying or even guarding, it is incapable of dealing critical hits.
location: Castle Morne: Inside the second prison cell area reached by dropping down onto a couple of beams. The room is filled with rats and a misbegotten.
whatItIs: Whip belongs to the whip class at 2 weight, and its attack type is strike. It is an enemy drop.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 103 physical, scaling D in Strength and D in Dexterity. The skill on it is Kick.
whenToUse: It can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones, and Whip needs 8 Strength and 14 Dexterity. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Whip

desc:
Hefty whip covered in crimson thorns. Weapon of the Prelates who lead the Fire Monks. A device of fearsome religious encouragement, it is fashioned in the image of the briars of sin.

Very effective at inflicting blood loss.
location: Drop: Mt. Gelmir / Mountaintops of the Giants / Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave Has a base 4% chance to drop from Fire Prelate enemies that wield it. ru:Шипастый кнут
whatItIs: Thorned Whip is a whip weighing 2.5 with strike attacks. Dropped by Fire Prelate (a 4% chance).
whyItMatters: Base attack is 105 physical, scaling E in Strength and C in Dexterity. Each hit builds up blood loss (50). The skill on it is Kick.
whenToUse: Thorned Whip needs 8 Strength and 16 Dexterity; it can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Thorned Whip

desc:
This ritual implement is a three pronged candlestick with solid flames formed of the magma of Mt. Gelmir.

When wielded as a weapon, the flames become supple whips of lava.
location: Quest Reward: Patches The reward from Patches in Volcano Manor after defeating Great Horned Tragoth. He won't give it to the player the first time he is spoken too. Instead, the area has to be reloaded in some way (either via teleporting or by exiting and re-entering the game) and he can be...
whatItIs: Magma Whip Candlestick belongs to the whip class at 2.5 weight, and its attack type is strike. You get it through Patches.
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 74 physical attack and 74 fire, scaling E in Strength, D in Dexterity, and D in Faith. Weapon skill: Sea of Magma (5 FP).
whenToUse: Magma Whip Candlestick needs 8 Strength, 16 Dexterity, and 18 Faith, cannot be infused, and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Magma Whip Candlestick

desc:
Metal whip formed of razor-sharp chain-link blades that have the appearance of flower petals. This work of art is handed down through the generations of the illustrious House Hoslow.

High dexterity is required to wield this weapon, but it excels at inflicting devastating blood loss. "The tale of House Hoslow is told in blood."
location: Guaranteed Drop: Mountaintops of the Giants Dropped by Juno Hoslow, Knight of Blood after invading him in the Mountaintops of the Giants for the final contract from Tanith, Volcano Manor Proprietress. Guaranteed Drop: Jarburg Dropped by Diallos at the end of his questline.
whatItIs: A whip of 3.5 weight, Hoslow's Petal Whip hits with strike attacks. Dropped by Juno Hoslow, Knight of Blood.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 113 physical, scaling D in Strength and D in Dexterity. Each hit builds up blood loss (55). The skill on it is Kick.
whenToUse: Hoslow's Petal Whip needs 10 Strength and 20 Dexterity; it can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Hoslow's Petal Whip

desc:
Hefty whip woven from the flame-red hair of a Fire Giant.

Every giant is red of hair, and Radagon was said to have despised his own red locks. Perhaps that was a curse of their kind.
location: Trade: Finger Reader Enia Trade the Remembrance of the Fire Giant, gained by defeating Fire Giant, with Finger Reader Enia. Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).
whatItIs: Giant's Red Braid belongs to the whip class at 2.5 weight, and its attack type is strike. Trade in the Remembrance of the Fire Giant with Finger Reader Enia to get it.
whyItMatters: It starts at 84 physical attack with 54 fire on top and scales D in Strength, D in Dexterity, and D in Faith. Flame Dance is its weapon skill, costing 25 FP per use.
whenToUse: Giant's Red Braid needs 18 Strength, 12 Dexterity, and 21 Faith, cannot be infused, and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Giant's Red Braid

desc:
This weapon made of extremely thin, flexible blades of metal is wielded like a whip by Nightfolk warriors.

Though in essence a whip with a cutting edge, it can also be used as a spear to pierce foes.
location: Found on a corpse up on the rooftops of Caria Manor located in Liurnia of the Lakes.
whatItIs: Urumi is a whip weighing 3 with slash attacks. Corpse loot in Liurnia of the Lakes.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 101 physical, scaling E in Strength and C in Dexterity. Kick is its weapon skill.
whenToUse: It can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones, and Urumi needs 10 Strength and 19 Dexterity. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Urumi

desc:
Whip bestrewn with rotting, misshapen teeth. Filthy and seething with disease, the teeth are embedded in the whip and dose the victim with deadly poison upon each strike.

As the wounds ripen they grow inflamed and ooze pus. The flesh of shamans was said to meld harmoniously with others.
location: Loot: Whipping Hut (Scadu Altus) Pillaged from a corpse inside the whipping hut.
whatItIs: Tooth Whip belongs to the whip class at 3 weight, and its attack type is strike. Looted from a corpse at Whipping Hut in Scadu Altus.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 109 physical, scaling E in Strength and D in Dexterity. Each hit builds up poison (66). The skill is Painful Strike, 16 FP.
whenToUse: Tooth Whip needs 10 Strength and 24 Dexterity, cannot be infused, and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Tooth Whip

desc:
A weapon built for striking with the fists, made of rough leather inlaid with iron rivets.
Fist weapons come in pairs, and two-handling this weapon will equip it to both hands.
location: Sold by Gatekeeper Gostoc for 800 runes.
whatItIs: Caestus belongs to the fist class at 1.5 weight, and its attack type is strike. It is for sale from Gatekeeper Gostoc for 800 runes.
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 90 physical attack, scaling D in Strength and D in Dexterity. Weapon skill: Endure (9 FP).
whenToUse: It can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones, and Caestus needs 8 Strength and 8 Dexterity. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Caestus

desc:
A caestus with the rivets replaced by blood loss-inducing spikes.
Fist weapons come in pair, and two-handling this weapon will equip it in both hands.
location: Sold by the Isolated Merchant in Caelid for 4000 runes. ru:Шипастый цестус
whatItIs: Spiked Caestus is a fist weighing 2 with strike attacks. Isolated Merchant sells it for 4,000 runes in Caelid.
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 91 physical attack, scaling D in Strength and D in Dexterity. Hits carry blood loss (45) buildup. Weapon skill: Endure (9 FP).
whenToUse: Spiked Caestus needs 8 Strength and 10 Dexterity, can take Ashes of War and affinity changes, and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Spiked Caestus

desc:
The embodiment of the power that still remained in the dragon's head that was grafted to Godrick's left arm.

The wielder's arm will take the form of a small dragon, sprouting sharp dragon fangs at the fist. This weapon cannot be two-handed.
location: Trade: Roundtable Hold Trade the Remembrance of the Grafted, gained by defeating Godrick the Grafted, with Finger Reader Enia. Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums with a bell to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).
whatItIs: Grafted Dragon belongs to the fist class at 2.5 weight, and its attack type is strike. The Remembrance of the Grafted buys it.
whyItMatters: It starts at 89 physical attack with 57 fire on top and scales D in Strength, D in Dexterity, and D in Faith. The skill is Bear Witness!, 20 FP.
whenToUse: It cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones, and Grafted Dragon needs 20 Strength, 14 Dexterity, and 16 Faith. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Grafted Dragon

desc:
Iron manifer of spherical shape. Big Boggart the blackguard's weapon of choice.

Not a weapon to be taken lightly, as its weighty blows shatter bones with ease.
location: Drop: Blackguard Big Boggart Received upon killing Blackguard Big Boggart.
whatItIs: A fist of 3 weight, Iron Ball hits with strike attacks. Beat Blackguard Big Boggart to get it.
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 101 physical attack, scaling D in Strength and E in Dexterity. Weapon skill: Endure (9 FP).
whenToUse: Iron Ball needs 11 Strength and 8 Dexterity, can take Ashes of War and affinity changes, and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Iron Ball

desc:
Spherical iron manifer covered in spikes which induce blood loss.

Used in brutal games of pugilism.
location: Loot: Leyndell, Royal Capital (Altus Plateau) Can be looted from a body at the colosseum in Leyndell, Royal Capital.
whatItIs: Star Fist belongs to the fist class at 3 weight, and its attack type is strike. Look for it in Leyndell, Royal Capital.
whyItMatters: It starts at 105 physical attack and scales D in Strength and E in Dexterity. Each hit builds up blood loss (45). The skill is Endure, 9 FP.
whenToUse: Star Fist needs 12 Strength and 8 Dexterity, can take Ashes of War and affinity changes, and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Star Fist

desc: Imported dagger design with a rather unique handle. The blade can be swung about as the extension of one's fist.
location: Loot: Fort Gael (Caelid) Found inside a chest in Fort Gael.
whatItIs: A fist of 2.5 weight, Katar hits with slash and pierce attacks. A chest at Fort Gael in Caelid holds it.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 97 physical, scaling D in Strength and D in Dexterity. Weapon skill: Impaling Thrust (9 FP). Its critical value is 110.
whenToUse: It can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones, and Katar needs 8 Strength and 10 Dexterity. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Katar

desc:
Horrific weapon made of a hardened skeletal arm. Wielded by Ensha of the Royal Remains.
Fitted by placing one's hands into the fists' grips until they dig in. "O clinging creature. A king relinquishes not the hand.
Skill: Lifesteal Fist
Skill that demonstrate mastery of the art of controlling vital energies. A slow, controlled punch with an energy-infused fist that renders foes unconcious and steals their HP. Only effective against foes of human build.
location: Received upon defeating Ensha of the Royal Remains. ru:Цепкая кость
whatItIs: Clinging Bone belongs to the fist class at 3 weight, and its attack type is slash and pierce. Ensha of the Royal Remains has to fall first before you get this weapon.
whyItMatters: It starts at 80 physical attack with 24 magic on top and scales E in Strength, C in Dexterity, and D in Arcane. Lifesteal Fist is its weapon skill, costing 14 FP per use.
whenToUse: Clinging Bone needs 8 Strength, 22 Dexterity, and 16 Arcane; it cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Clinging Bone

desc:
Bladed prosthetic leg enwreathed with the power of lightning, instead attached to the fist. 

Commander Niall, veteran of Castle Sol, offered this prosthesis in exchange for the lives of the defeated knights held prisoner. He went on to lead these men as an army of no nation.
location: Guaranteed Drop: Castle Sol (Mountaintops of the Giants) Dropped by Commander Niall upon his defeat at the end of Castle Sol.
whatItIs: A fist of 4 weight, Veteran's Prosthesis hits with slash and pierce attacks. It drops from Commander Niall in Mountaintops of the Giants.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 83 physical plus 53 lightning, scaling D in Strength and D in Dexterity. Storm Kick is its weapon skill, costing 10 FP per use.
whenToUse: Veteran's Prosthesis needs 15 Strength and 12 Dexterity; it cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Veteran's Prosthesis

desc:
One of the weapons originating from the Two Fingers. A formless sequence of ciphers comprise its blade, and as such no shield can repel it. Deals holy damage.

The furtive inscription appears to hang in the air; the language of light spoken by the Two Fingers.
location: Loot: Roundtable Hold Jump over the balcony rail in the Roundtable Hold, it will be in the rooms to the left.
whatItIs: Cipher Pata is a fist weighing 0 with slash and pierce attacks. Roundtable Hold Jump in Roundtable Hold is where it is found.
whyItMatters: Its base attack is 85 holy, with no physical component, scaling C in Faith. Its weapon skill is Unblockable Blade, which costs 17 FP.
whenToUse: It cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones, and Cipher Pata needs 30 Faith. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Cipher Pata

desc:
Concealed weapon used by Thiollier, of a design generally favored by poison-wielders for dark and subtle purposes.

Like St. Trina, who blossomed in the deep-purple garden, a rich poison is secreted from within which sends its victims into an eternal sleep.
location: Quest reward & Loot: Enir-Ilim Recovered from Thiollier's body at the end of his questline.
whatItIs: Thiollier's Hidden Needle is a fist weighing 0.5 with pierce attacks. Found in Enir-Ilim.
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 70 physical attack and 45 magic, scaling E in Strength, C in Dexterity, and D in Intelligence. Hits carry sleep (42) buildup. Sleep Evermore is its weapon skill, costing 16 FP per use.
whenToUse: Thiollier's Hidden Needle needs 10 Strength, 22 Dexterity, and 15 Intelligence, cannot be infused, and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Thiollier's Hidden Needle

desc:
A weapon comprised of a linear, double-sided blade attached to a substantial guard. Wielded by the Oathseeker Knights.

This versatile armament can be swung about like a fist or used in the manner of a straight sword.
location: Loot: Gravesite Plain (Realm of Shadow) Acquired from a corpse on a ledge by the front-entrance-way to the Church of Benediction.
whatItIs: Pata is a fist weighing 4 with standard and pierce attacks. A corpse in Gravesite Plain carries it.
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 104 physical attack, scaling D in Strength and D in Dexterity. Weapon skill: Impaling Thrust (9 FP).
whenToUse: It can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones, and Pata needs 11 Strength and 15 Dexterity. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Pata

desc: A glove stitched together from the flayed skin of the victims of a butcherous bloodbath. Afflicts target with deadly poison. Raises attack power when poisoning occurs in the vicinity. Forged of an unyielding, black impulse toward revenge fostered in those who have had everything burned or stolen from them, these are the weapons of the utterly downtrodden.
location: Loot: Belurat, Tower Settlement (Land of the Tower) Found by the northern edge of the poison swamp that can only be accessed through the sewers. The Well Depths Key is needed to access this area.
whatItIs: Poisoned Hand is a fist weighing 1 with strike attacks. Look for it at Belurat, Tower Settlement.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 76 physical, scaling E in Strength and C in Arcane. Hits carry poison (60) buildup. Its weapon skill is Poison Spear-Hand Strike, which costs 13 FP.
whenToUse: Poisoned Hand needs 8 Strength, 8 Dexterity, and 28 Arcane; it cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Poisoned Hand

desc: A glove stitched together from the flayed skin of the victims of a butcherous bloodbath. Afflicts target with madness. Raises attack power when madness is triggered in the vicinity. Forged of an unyielding, black impulse toward revenge fostered in those who were hunted down as heretics by their own brethren, these are the weapons of the utterly downtrodden.
location: Guaranteed Drop: Abyssal Woods Obtained from the killing the Madding Hand NPC in the Abyssal Woods, located south of the Woodland Trail Site of Grace.
whatItIs: Madding Hand belongs to the fist class at 1 weight, and its attack type is strike. It comes from beating Madding Hand NPC in Abyssal Woods.
whyItMatters: It starts at 53 physical attack with 63 fire on top and scales D in Strength, E in Dexterity, E in Intelligence, and E in Faith. It applies madness (55) buildup on hit. The skill on it is Madding Spear-Hand Strike at 13 FP.
whenToUse: Madding Hand needs 8 Strength, 8 Dexterity, 13 Intelligence, and 20 Faith, cannot be infused, and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Madding Hand

desc:
A giant fist of fractured rock. Taken from the body of a golem of the ruined forges.

Carved with a smithscript enabling strong attacks to launch the entire fist straight ahead.
location: Random Drop: Taylew's Ruined Forge (Rauh Base) 3% chance of dropping from Golem Smiths that use this weapon. ER Enemy Golem Smith Smithscript Fist.png|A golem smith that will drop this item. (Note how the color of its fists are different from the rest of its body)
whatItIs: A fist of 6 weight, Golem Fist hits with strike attacks. For a new player, an enemy drop in Ancient Ruins of Rauh (a 3% chance).
whyItMatters: Base attack is 110 physical, scaling C in Strength, E in Dexterity, E in Intelligence, and E in Faith. Weapon skill: Endure (9 FP).
whenToUse: Golem Fist needs 24 Strength, 8 Dexterity, 11 Intelligence, and 11 Faith, can take Ashes of War and affinity changes, and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Golem Fist

desc:
A shield awarded to Swordhands of Night, cast in a bottomless black from which no light can escape.

The outer surface is only semicorporeal, providing reliable defense against attacks that are not physical in nature.
location: Loot: Bonny Gaol (Scadu Altus) Recovered from a body lying on a guillotine-table. Located on a somewhat hidden floor of the gaol. To reach this floor, the player must progress through the dungeon until they reach a jar-elevator that has already begun to move on its own. This elevator will first...
whatItIs: Shield of Night is a small shield that weighs 2. Bonny Gaol in Scadu Altus is where it is found.
whyItMatters: It starts at 65 physical attack with 42 magic on top and scales D in Dexterity. Weapon skill: Revenge of the Night (5 FP). Blocking with it stops 74 percent physical, and its guard boost is 43.
whenToUse: Shield of Night needs 8 Strength and 15 Dexterity, cannot be infused, and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Shield of Night

desc:
Weapon worn on the fist comprised of sharp parallel blades favored by those who lurk in the dark. Lacerations cause blood loss with great effect.
Claw weapons come in pairs, and two-handing this weapon will equip it to both hands.
location: Found on a corpse in Stormveil Castle, near the Stormveil Cliffside grace.
whatItIs: Hookclaws is a claw weighing 2 with slash and pierce attacks. Corpse loot at Stormveil Castle.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 93 physical, scaling E in Strength and C in Dexterity. Hits carry blood loss (60) buildup. Weapon skill: Quickstep (3 FP). Its critical value is 110.
whenToUse: Hookclaws needs 8 Strength and 14 Dexterity; it can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Hookclaws

desc:
One of the weapons designed for gladiatorial combat. Used by duelists who were exiled from the colosseum.

The black fang protruding from the bronze snake head is coated in deadly poison.
location: Loot: Abandoned Cave (Caelid) Found on a corpse inside the Abandoned Cave located in Caelid.
whatItIs: Venomous Fang belongs to the claw class at 2.5 weight, and its attack type is slash and pierce. Corpse loot at Abandoned Cave.
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 97 physical attack, scaling D in Strength and D in Dexterity. Hits carry poison (72) buildup. Weapon skill: Quickstep (3 FP).
whenToUse: Venomous Fang needs 9 Strength and 9 Dexterity, can take Ashes of War and affinity changes, and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Venomous Fang

desc:
Large curved claws used by Bloodhound Knights.
The curve allows the weapon to slip through an enemy's guard.
location: Received after defeating a Bloodhound Knight inside Volcano Manor. ru:Когти ищеек
whatItIs: Bloodhound Claws belongs to the claw class at 3 weight, and its attack type is slash and pierce.
whyItMatters: It starts at 99 physical attack and scales D in Strength and D in Dexterity. It applies blood loss (60) buildup on hit. The skill on it is Bloodhound's Step at 5 FP. Its critical value is 110.
whenToUse: Bloodhound Claws needs 10 Strength and 15 Dexterity, can take Ashes of War and affinity changes, and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Bloodhound Claws

desc:
Claw comprised of two sharp, thin blades. Wielded by the assassins of ravenmount, this weapon allows them to imitate the attacks of Deathbirds.

Besides excelling at airborne attacks, its charge attack mimics the vicious swoop of a bird of prey.
location: Loot: Sage's Cave (Altus Plateau) Found inside Sage's Cave. They can be found inside a chest just beyond a room containing four skeletons, hidden behind an Illusory Wall.
whatItIs: Raptor Talons is a claw weighing 1.5 with slash and pierce attacks. Found in a chest at Sage's Cave.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 86 physical, scaling E in Strength and C in Dexterity. Hits carry blood loss (60) buildup. The skill is Quickstep, 3 FP. Its critical value is 110.
whenToUse: It can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones, and Raptor Talons needs 6 Strength and 14 Dexterity. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Raptor Talons

desc:
Claws of a bottomless black from which no light can escape. Wielded by Anna, Swordhand of Night.

Engraved with a smithscript enabling strong attack to launch all three claws at a target. The blades are only semicorporeal, and cannot be fully guarded against.
location: Guaranteed Drop: Finger Ruins of Miyr (Scadu Altus) Obtained from defeating the invading Swordhand of Night Anna on the approach to the hanging bell of the Finger Ruins.
whatItIs: Claws of Night is a claw weighing 3 with slash and pierce attacks. An enemy drop in Scadu Altus.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 79 physical plus 51 magic, scaling C in Dexterity. Each hit builds up blood loss (45). Its weapon skill is Scattershot Throw, which costs 11 FP. Its critical value is 110.
whenToUse: Claws of Night needs 8 Strength and 20 Dexterity, cannot be infused, and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Claws of Night

desc:
Colossal hammer with the appearance of roiling flames. Weapon of the Prelates who lead the Fire Monks. Its heft represents the weight of their guardianship.
The hammer's head is unusually substansial, and strong attacks will fling foes into the air.
location: Prelate's Inferno Crozier is dropped by a Fire Prelate in Fort Laiedd, west of the Volcano Manor on Mt. Gelmir. Prelate's Inferno Crozier will only drop one time in each playthrough. ru:Адский посох прелата
whatItIs: A colossal weapon of 23.5 weight, Prelate's Inferno Crozier hits with strike attacks. It drops from Fire Prelate in Mt. Gelmir.
whyItMatters: It starts at 156 physical attack and scales C in Strength and E in Dexterity. Its weapon skill is Prelate's Charge, which costs 7 FP.
whenToUse: Prelate's Inferno Crozier needs 45 Strength and 8 Dexterity, can take Ashes of War and affinity changes, and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Prelate's Inferno Crozier

desc:
Large stone staff embedded with glintstone. Wielded by Erdtree Burial Watchdogs who protect catacombs.
The Watchdogs, battered and broken over their lengthy tenure, rule the catacombs and are even said to command the imps.
Unique Skill : Sorcery of the Crozier
Channel magic into the glintstone to activate an ancient sorcery, producing floating magic projectiles that chase enemies automatically.
location: Found behind an illusory wall inside Road's End Catacombs, located in Liurnia of the Lakes.
whatItIs: Watchdog's Staff belongs to the colossal weapon class at 19 weight, and its attack type is strike. Found in Liurnia of the Lakes.
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 165 physical attack, scaling D in Strength and D in Dexterity. Its weapon skill is Sorcery of the Crozier, which costs 15 FP.
whenToUse: It cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones, and Watchdog's Staff needs 34 Strength and 10 Dexterity. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Watchdog's Staff

desc:
An enormous club of hard wood. Wildly hammering foes with this striking weapon requires no dexterity; only brute force.

While it may seem sacrilegious, this weapon is said to be a withered branch of the Erdtree. Imbued with holy power, this weapon will never snap.
location: Guaranteed Drop: Old Altus Tunnel (Altus Plateau) Received upon defeating the Stonedigger Troll located inside the Old Altus Tunnel. It requires two Stonesword Keys to access.
whatItIs: A colossal weapon of 17 weight, Great Club hits with strike attacks. Beat Stonedigger Troll in Altus Plateau to get it.
whyItMatters: It starts at 154 physical attack with 46 holy on top and scales C in Strength and E in Faith. Its weapon skill is Golden Land, which costs 16 FP.
whenToUse: Great Club needs 35 Strength, cannot be infused, and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Great Club

desc:
Fanned golden horn of the Oracle Envoys. Profoundly weighty, its blows are sure to be felt.
Originally an instrument, but one that cannot be sounded by a mere human. Or perhaps it is too early to sound the call.
Unique Skill : Great Oracular Bubble
Blow on the horn to release a massive magic bubble. The bubble floats gently through the air towards its target.
location: Drop: Leyndell, Royal Capital / Miquella's Haligtree 2% chance to drop from Giant Oracle Envoy enemies. ru:Большой рожок посланца
whatItIs: Envoy's Greathorn belongs to the colossal weapon class at 19.5 weight, and its attack type is strike. Dropped by Giant Oracle Envoy (a 2% chance).
whyItMatters: It starts at 121 physical attack with 78 holy on top and scales D in Strength, D in Dexterity, and D in Faith. Its weapon skill is Great Oracular Bubble, which costs 16 FP.
whenToUse: It cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones, and Envoy's Greathorn needs 28 Strength, 12 Dexterity, and 24 Faith. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Envoy's Greathorn

desc:
Greataxe designed for gladiatorial combat. Used by duelists who were exiled from the colosseum.
A weapon reserved for duelist champions, the charge attack is particularly ferocious.
location: Drop: Leyndell, Royal Capital 4% chance to drop from the Grave Warden Duelist enemies that wield it near the West Capital Rampart grace. ru:Секира дуэлянта
whatItIs: Duelist Greataxe is a colossal weapon weighing 20 with standard attacks. It drops from Grave Warden Duelist in Leyndell, Royal Capital (a 4% chance).
whyItMatters: Base attack is 170 physical, scaling E in Strength and D in Dexterity. Weapon skill: Endure (9 FP).
whenToUse: Duelist Greataxe needs 30 Strength and 10 Dexterity, can take Ashes of War and affinity changes, and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Duelist Greataxe

desc:
Weapon of Godfrey, Elden Lord. It was broken in a battle fought as leader of the Tarnished during the Long March.
This weapon is symbolic of Godfrey's vow to conduct himself as a lord, later becoming an emblem of the golden lineage.
In the days of the past, a crown was warranted with strength.
Unique Skill: Regal Roar
Let loose a mighty war cry, raising attack power, while sending out a shockwave that cannot be guarded against by stomping the ground. While active, strong attack becomes a lunging slash.
location: Trade the Remembrance of Hoarah Loux, dropped by Hoarah Loux, Warrior, with Finger Reader Enia. Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method). ru:Топор Годфри
whatItIs: Axe of Godfrey is a colossal weapon weighing 18 with standard attacks. Trade in the Remembrance of Hoarah Loux with Finger Reader Enia to get it.
whyItMatters: It starts at 165 physical attack and scales D in Strength and D in Dexterity. Its weapon skill is Regal Roar.
whenToUse: Axe of Godfrey needs 42 Strength and 14 Dexterity; it cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Axe of Godfrey

desc:
Weapon said to have been whittled from the claw of a great, ancient dragon, wielded by grotesque Tree Sentinels who yet serve the Erdtree.
The claw is enwreathed with lightning, and tears through the dragons' feeble descendants with ease.
location: Dropped by the Draconic Tree Sentinel boss guarding the entrance to Leyndell, Royal Capital. ru:Драконий коготь
whatItIs: Dragon Greatclaw belongs to the colossal weapon class at 16 weight, and its attack type is standard. It drops from Draconic Tree Sentinel in Leyndell, Royal Capital.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 120 physical plus 78 lightning, scaling D in Strength and D in Dexterity. The skill is Endure, 9 FP.
whenToUse: It cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones, and Dragon Greatclaw needs 30 Strength and 14 Dexterity. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Dragon Greatclaw

desc:
Ceremonial staff depicting the Erdtree in its historic radiance. Wielded by the avatars who protect the Minor Erdtrees.
The avatars, emerging in the wake of the Elden Ring's shattering, were determined to protect the withering Erdtree's offspring.
Unique Skill : Erdtree Slam
Jump up high into the air and crash down on the ground ahead. The resulting pratfall sends golden shockwaves in all directions. This is the most powerful of all the Ground Slam skills.
location: Dropped by an Erdtree Avatar near the Great Waterfall Crest grace located in Deeproot Depths. ru:Посох воплощения
whatItIs: A colossal weapon of 20 weight, Staff of the Avatar hits with strike attacks. It drops from Erdtree Avatar in Deeproot Depths.
whyItMatters: It starts at 113 physical attack with 73 holy on top and scales C in Strength, E in Dexterity, and D in Faith. The skill on it is Erdtree Slam at 19 FP.
whenToUse: Staff of the Avatar needs 34 Strength, 8 Dexterity, and 24 Faith, cannot be infused, and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Staff of the Avatar

desc:
Part of a Fallingstar Beast's jaw, hard and shining black, fashioned into a weapon.
With its sharp point, this colossal weapon can skewer foes.
Unique Skill: Gravity Bolt
Imbue the jaw of the fallingstar beast with gravitational lightning sending a bolt crashing down a short distance away. Can be fired in rapid succession.
location: Acquired by defeating the Full-Grown Fallingstar Beast boss in a large crater on Mt. Gelmir, south of the Ninth Mt. Gelmir Campsite grace.
whatItIs: Fallingstar Beast Jaw belongs to the colossal weapon class at 21.5 weight, and its attack type is pierce. Beat Full-Grown Fallingstar Beast in Mt. Gelmir to get it.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 131 physical plus 85 magic, scaling D in Strength, D in Dexterity, and E in Intelligence. The skill on it is Gravity Bolt at 13 FP.
whenToUse: Fallingstar Beast Jaw needs 34 Strength, 12 Dexterity, and 20 Intelligence; it cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Fallingstar Beast Jaw

desc:
Great iron wheel lined with flesh-flaying blades. Device of torture used by Inquisitor Ghiza. As the wheel spins it causes severe pain and blood loss.

The design was adopted for use as the iconic weapon wielded by Iron Virgins.
location: Guaranteed Drop: Volcano Manor (Mt. Gelmir) Dropped by the Inquisitor Ghiza invader in the Volcano Manor.
whatItIs: Ghiza's Wheel is a colossal weapon weighing 19 with standard attacks. Look for it as a drop from Inquisitor Ghiza in Mt. Gelmir.
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 156 physical attack, scaling D in Strength and D in Dexterity. Each hit builds up blood loss (70). Its weapon skill is Spinning Wheel, which costs 3 FP.
whenToUse: Ghiza's Wheel needs 28 Strength and 18 Dexterity; it cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Ghiza's Wheel

desc:
A hammer made from a boulder, used in the War against the Giants. One of the heftiest weapons in the entire Lands Between.
After the giants were quelled, and man turned against man in violence, this weapon was all but forgotten. Man has grown feeble in comparison to his forebears.
location: Found inside a carriage south of Outer Wall Phantom Tree grace, located in Altus Plateau. ru:Гроза великанов
whatItIs: A colossal weapon of 26.5 weight, Giant-Crusher hits with strike attacks. Look for it in Altus Plateau.
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 155 physical attack, scaling C in Strength. Weapon skill: Endure (9 FP).
whenToUse: Giant-Crusher needs 60 Strength; it can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Giant-Crusher

desc: A great halberd of black stone crafted by a civilization now gone to ruin. Wielded by the Guardian Golem.
location: Drop: Weeping Peninsula / Stormhill / Greyoll's Dragonbarrow / Liurnia of the Lakes / Capital Outskirts / Leyndell, Royal Capital / Leyndell, Ashen Capital / Mountaintops of the Giants 10% chance to drop from Guardian Golem enemies that wield it (5% from non-respawning ones).
whatItIs: Golem's Halberd belongs to the colossal weapon class at 21.5 weight, and its attack type is standard and pierce. Guardian Golem in Weeping Peninsula can drop it (a 10% chance).
whyItMatters: It starts at 158 physical attack and scales D in Strength and D in Dexterity. Weapon skill: Charge Forth (16 FP).
whenToUse: Golem's Halberd needs 36 Strength and 14 Dexterity; it can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Golem's Halberd

desc:
Mining tool of stonedigger trolls used to crack bedrock.
Trolls are descended from the giants, and these were supposedly once used as ceremonial smithing tools. In the distant past, smithing was considered divine.
location: Found on a corpse inside Old Altus Tunnel, located in Mt. Gelmir. It requires two stonesword keys to access the tunnel.
whatItIs: A colossal weapon of 16 weight, Troll's Hammer hits with strike attacks. Looted from a corpse at Old Altus Tunnel in Mt. Gelmir.
whyItMatters: It starts at 153 physical attack with 45 fire on top and scales C in Strength, E in Dexterity, and D in Faith. The skill on it is Troll's Roar at 22 FP.
whenToUse: Troll's Hammer needs 28 Strength, 8 Dexterity, and 10 Faith; it cannot be infused and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Troll's Hammer

desc:
Ceremonial staff depicting the Erdtree in its historic radiance. It festers with scarlet rot.
Wielded by the avatars who protect the Minor Erdtrees.
Unique Skill : Erdtree Slam
Jump up high into the air and crash down on the ground ahead. The resulting pratfall sends golden shockwaves in all directions. This is the most powerful of all the Ground Slam skills.
location: Dropped by the Putrid Avatar/scarlet rot Erdtree Avatar patrolling the bridge in Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree. ru:Гнилой посох
whatItIs: Rotten Staff is a colossal weapon weighing 18 with strike attacks. Dropped by Putrid Avatar.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 165 physical, scaling D in Strength and E in Dexterity. Each hit builds up scarlet rot (75). Erdtree Slam is its weapon skill, costing 19 FP per use.
whenToUse: It cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones, and Rotten Staff needs 34 Strength and 8 Dexterity. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Rotten Staff

desc:
Greataxe designed for gladiatorial combat, now festering with scarlet rot.

Used by duelists who were exiled from the colosseum.
location: Guaranteed Drop: Ordina, Liturgical Town (Consecrated Snowfield) Dropped by a Rotten Duelist north-west of Ordina, Liturgical Town, together with the Rotten Duelist Greaves.
whatItIs: A colossal weapon of 20 weight, Rotten Greataxe hits with standard attacks. Dropped by Rotten Duelist.
whyItMatters: It starts at 162 physical attack and scales E in Strength and C in Dexterity. Each hit builds up scarlet rot (65). Weapon skill: Endure (9 FP).
whenToUse: Rotten Greataxe needs 30 Strength and 10 Dexterity; it can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Rotten Greataxe

desc:
Great hammer wielded by Devonia, longest-serving of the Crucible Knights.

Weapon forged of primordial gold, marked by its reddish hue and inhabited by ancient holiness. A torrent of life is engraved upon the striking face.
location: Guaranteed Drop: Ancient Ruins of Rauh (Land of the Tower) Defeat Crucible Knight Devonia at the Ancient Ruins of Rauh. They drop their hammer along with the Crucible Hammer-Helm.
whatItIs: Devonia's Hammer is a colossal weapon weighing 20 with strike attacks. Crucible Knight Devonia has to fall first in Ancient Ruins of Rauh before you get this weapon.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 147 physical plus 44 holy, scaling C in Strength, E in Dexterity, and D in Faith. Its weapon skill is Devonia's Vortex, which costs 16 FP.
whenToUse: Devonia's Hammer needs 30 Strength, 13 Dexterity, and 19 Faith, cannot be infused, and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Devonia's Hammer

desc:
The head of a monstrous shadow sunflower manifestation of the Scadutree. Then again, it might be just a flower, wielded as a weapon.

Much like the Scadutree itself in appearance, a second stalk winds tightly around the first, almost as if in a tender embrace.
location: Trade: Finger Reader Enia Trade the Remembrance of the Shadow Sunflower, gained by defeating the Scadutree Avatar, with Finger Reader Enia. Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums with a bell to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).
whatItIs: Shadow Sunflower Blossom is a colossal weapon weighing 16 with strike attacks. Trade in the Remembrance of the Shadow Sunflower with Finger Reader Enia to get it.
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 114 physical attack and 114 holy, scaling D in Strength, E in Dexterity, and D in Faith. Shadow Sunflower Headbutt is its weapon skill, costing 16 FP per use.
whenToUse: It cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones, and Shadow Sunflower Blossom needs 24 Strength, 8 Dexterity, and 25 Faith. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Shadow Sunflower Blossom

desc:
The head of Metyr, the finger-mother, wielded as a weapon without modification.

From within the center of the fingerprint that wrinkles the creature's foremost protrusion, a tiny wart-like eye gazes vacantly into the beyond.
location: The weapon can be obtained upon trading the Remembrance of the Mother of Fingers with Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold.
whatItIs: Gazing Finger belongs to the colossal weapon class at 15 weight, and its attack type is strike. It is traded for the Remembrance of the Mother of Fingers at Roundtable Hold.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 133 physical plus 86 magic, scaling C in Strength, D in Intelligence, and E in Faith. The skill is Kowtower's Resentment, 31 FP.
whenToUse: Gazing Finger needs 20 Strength, 8 Dexterity, 20 Intelligence, and 14 Faith; it cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Gazing Finger

desc:
This torch's tip is wrapped in oil-soaked rags and set on fire. The flame can illuminate dark locales, or used to attack enemies.
Can be raised up when equipped in the left hand, illuminated more of the surrounding area.
Skill: Torch Attack
Thrust your torch forward to set foes ablaze. This Skill is especially effective against foes who are weak to fire.
location: Purchase: Limgrave Bought from Merchant Kalé at Church of Elleh for 200 Runes.
whatItIs: A torch of 1.5 weight, Torch hits with strike attacks. It is for sale from Merchant Kal for 200 runes in Limgrave.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 54 physical plus 97 fire, scaling D in Strength and D in Dexterity. The skill is Torch Attack.
whenToUse: Torch needs 5 Strength and 5 Dexterity; it cannot be infused and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Torch

desc:
Torch wound with metal wire. The flame can illuminate dark locales, or be used to attack enemies.

Heavier than a normal torch, but the heated filament boosts fire damage dealt.
location: Loot: Weeping Peninsula Found at Castle Morne along the northern side of the castle, top level. It's on a body at the end of a narrow path, guarded by two Misbegotten. To reach this spot from the beginning, start at the Castle Morne Lift Site of Grace and enter the castle. Then, run up the pile...
whatItIs: Steel-Wire Torch belongs to the torch class at 3 weight, and its attack type is strike. Weeping Peninsula is where it is found.
whyItMatters: It starts at 61 physical attack with 109 fire on top and scales D in Strength and C in Dexterity. Its weapon skill is Firebreather, which costs 8 FP.
whenToUse: Steel-Wire Torch needs 10 Strength and 8 Dexterity, cannot be infused, and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Steel-Wire Torch

desc:
Candlestand torch that burns with a light-purple flame. The carving depict St. Trina, but in adult form, somewhat unnervingly.
The light-purple flame induces sleep.
Unique Skill: Fires of Slumber
Blow into the candlestick's flame, creating a stream of hazy purple fire to cover the ground ahead. The intoxicating flames inflict the sleep ailment upon foes.
location: Loot: Consecrated Snowfield Found inside one of the Troll-drawn Carriages in the southeast of the Snowfield, northeast of the Consecrated Snowfield Site of Grace and west of the Consecrated Snowfield Catacombs Sites of Grace. The other Carriage contains the Flowing Curved Sword, and at night...
whatItIs: St. Trina's Torch belongs to the torch class at 3 weight, and its attack type is strike. Look for it in Consecrated Snowfield.
whyItMatters: It starts at 51 physical attack with 91 fire on top and scales E in Strength, D in Dexterity, and D in Faith. It applies sleep (72) buildup on hit. Fires of Slumber is its weapon skill, costing 15 FP per use.
whenToUse: It cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones, and St. Trina's Torch needs 10 Strength, 10 Dexterity, and 14 Faith. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: St. Trina's Torch

desc:
Metal torch that burns with cold ghostflame. Tool of the Fallen Hawks who prowl the underground rivers.

When the band's last embers were used up in their long search, they began to burn the bones of their fellows, acquiring the cold ghostflame, but sealing their fate as dwellers of the underground for all eternity.
location: Loot: Siofra River Found on a corpse on the rooftops near the entrance of Nokron, Eternal City. This section of rooftops can only be accessed when entering through the crater in Limgrave (only accessible after deating Starscourge Radahn). After that, proceed to the parapets of Nokron and make a...
whatItIs: Ghostflame Torch is a torch weighing 2.5 with strike attacks. A corpse in Siofra River carries it.
whyItMatters: It starts at 50 physical attack with 90 magic on top and scales E in Strength, E in Dexterity, and D in Intelligence. Hits carry frostbite (65) buildup. The skill is Torch Attack.
whenToUse: Ghostflame Torch needs 10 Strength, 10 Dexterity, and 14 Intelligence; it cannot be infused and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Ghostflame Torch

desc:
A torch which burns oil infused with special incense. The aroma pacifies wild beasts.
Torches such as these were used to keep unwelcome beasts away from treasure troves hidden in caves.
Skill : Torch Attack
Thrust torch forward to set foes ablaze. This skill is especially effective against foes who are weak to fire.
location: Purchase: Dragonbarrow 1x sold for 1,200 Runes by the Isolated Merchant at the Isolated Merchant's Shack in north-west Dragonbarrow, Caelid.
whatItIs: Beast-Repellent Torch is a torch weighing 2.5 with strike attacks. It is for sale from Isolated Merchant for 1,200 runes in Greyoll's Dragonbarrow.
whyItMatters: It starts at 58 physical attack with 104 fire on top and scales C in Strength and E in Dexterity. Torch Attack is its weapon skill.
whenToUse: Beast-Repellent Torch needs 12 Strength and 8 Dexterity, cannot be infused, and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Beast-Repellent Torch

desc:
Torch given to protectors of the Erdtree. Its flames are bestowed with a special incantation which allows the bearer to see assassins cloaked in veils.

Furnished on behalf of the Erdtree and the Grace-Given Lord such that a Night of the Black Knives will never come again.
location: Purchase: Capital Outskirts 1x sold for 7,000 Runes by the Hermit Merchant at Hermit Merchant's Shack. More precisely, found north of the first rampart of the capital and by the northern wall, alternatively far west of the Minor Erdtree in the Capital Outskirts.
whatItIs: Sentry's Torch is a torch weighing 5 with strike attacks. Hermit Merchant sells it for 7,000 runes.
whyItMatters: It starts at 56 physical attack with 100 holy on top and scales D in Strength, E in Dexterity, and D in Faith. Weapon skill: Torch Attack.
whenToUse: It cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones, and Sentry's Torch needs 15 Strength, 8 Dexterity, and 15 Faith. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Sentry's Torch

desc:
A torch made by attaching a dying flame of frenzy to a small spinal column.

In a distant land, in an age long past, was born a man who failed to become the Lord of Frenzied Flame. All that remains of him is cradled gently by Nanaya.
location: Loot: Abyssal Woods Found on a body inside of Midra's Manse. From the Midra's Library Site of Grace head west and jump across the rafters and bookcases to reach the northern wall and then continue west. Note that this requires pulling a lever to raise a bookcase at the end. To reach this lever,...
whatItIs: Nanaya's Torch is a torch weighing 3.5 with strike attacks. Look for it in Abyssal Woods.
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 55 physical attack and 99 fire, scaling E in Strength, E in Dexterity, E in Intelligence, and E in Faith. It applies madness (65) buildup on hit. Feeble Lord's Frenzied Flame is its weapon skill, costing 3 FP per use.
whenToUse: It cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones, and Nanaya's Torch needs 10 Strength, 10 Dexterity, 14 Intelligence, and 16 Faith. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Nanaya's Torch

desc:
A stone lantern carved to resemble a lamenting human head, the eyes vacantly beaming out light. Can be raised up when equipped in the left hand, illuminating more of the surrounding area.

The unusual expression somehow imparts a sense of contentment. The languid ease of one who needs not sight.
location: Loot: Lamenter's Gaol (Gravesite Plain) Can be found by starting from the pit with Living Jar Warriors and the Gaol Lower Level Key is, then climbing back up the way into the pit taking the first door on the left, and then going through the illusory wall at the end of the small corridor and...
whatItIs: Lamenting Visage belongs to the torch class at 2 weight, and its attack type is strike. Found at Lamenter's Gaol in Gravesite Plain.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 71 physical, scaling B in Strength. The skill on it is Blindfold of Happiness at 10 FP.
whenToUse: Lamenting Visage needs 9 Strength, cannot be infused, and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Lamenting Visage

desc:
A small metal roundshield. The bump in the center is designed to parry.

A well-timed parry deflects an enemy's attack, breaking their stance and leaving them open to a critical hit. Though risk is inherent, this shield favors aggression.
location: Equipped: One is part of the starting gear for the Bandit class. Purchase: Stormveil Castle One is sold for 1,500 Runes by Gatekeeper Gostoc.
whatItIs: Buckler is a small shield that weighs 1.5. It is Bandit starting gear.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 68 physical, scaling E in Strength and D in Dexterity. The skill on it is Buckler Parry. Its guard blocks 74 percent of physical damage with a guard boost of 45.
whenToUse: Buckler needs 8 Strength and 13 Dexterity; it can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Buckler

desc:
Golden shield used by the perfumers of Leyndell during military service.
Made to be thin and light of weight, even those lacking strength can employ this immunity-boosting shield.
location: Drop: Altus Plateau/Leyndell, Royal Capital/Scadu Altus/Shadow Keep 2% drop chance from Perfumer enemies in the base game. Several can be found throughout Perfumer's Grotto, making it a good place to farm for this shield. 4% drop chance from Perfumers found in Shadow of the Erdtree.
whatItIs: Perfumer's Shield belongs to the small shield class at 1.5 weight. Dropped by Perfumer (a 2% chance).
whyItMatters: Base attack is 67 physical, scaling E in Strength. Parry is its weapon skill. Blocking with it stops 78 percent physical, and its guard boost is 45.
whenToUse: Perfumer's Shield needs 8 Strength, can take Ashes of War and affinity changes, and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Perfumer's Shield

desc:
Small copper dome-shaped roundshield carried by the man-serpents of Mt. Gelmir.

Said to have been tempered in lava, it boasts great resistance to fire.
location: Drop: Volcano Manor (Mt. Gelmir) 4% drop chance from the sword-and-shield-wielding Man-Serpents found throughout the Manor. One can be found just outside of the Guest Hall Site of Grace. 3.03% drop chance from the Magma Blade-and-shield-wielding Manserpents found in the Manor.
whatItIs: Man-Serpent's Shield is a small shield that weighs 2. Dropped by Magma Blade-and-shield-wielding Manserpents (a 4% chance).
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 70 physical attack, scaling E in Strength. No Skill is its weapon skill. Blocking with it stops 85 percent physical, and its guard boost is 48.
whenToUse: It can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones, and Man-Serpent's Shield needs 8 Strength. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Man-Serpent's Shield

desc:
A creaky old wooden shield, circular in shape. Roughly reinforced with vines.

There are countless other shields available of better make. This piece of scrap isn't worth the effort of equipping.
location: Equipped: One is part of the starting gear for the Prophet class. Drop: Limgrave/Weeping Peninsula/Liurnia of the Lakes/Mt. Gelmir/Altus Plateau 2% drop chance from sword-and-shield wielding Demi-Humans. A easy-to-farm group of four can be found in-between the Forest Lookout Tower and the South...
whatItIs: Rickety Shield belongs to the small shield class at 1 weight. The Prophet class starts with it.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 70 physical, scaling E in Strength. The skill is Parry. Blocking with it stops 74 percent physical, and its guard boost is 46.
whenToUse: It can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones, and Rickety Shield needs 8 Strength. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Rickety Shield

desc:
Pillory made to punish serious felons, used as a shield. Though made of good, sturdy wood, it is only a makeshift tool and performs as such.
Perhaps due to its use as a device with which the guilty were made to endure prolonged suffering, it raises vitality.
location: Loot: Gaol Cave (Caelid) After using the lever to open all the cages in the cave, drop down forwards from the lever platform and turn left, and then a now-opened caged cave on the left contains this item and an Old Fang.
whatItIs: Pillory Shield belongs to the small shield class at 3.5 weight. It is an enemy drop.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 71 physical, scaling E in Strength. The skill is No Skill. Its guard blocks 82 percent of physical damage with a guard boost of 50.
whenToUse: Pillory Shield needs 10 Strength; it can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Pillory Shield

desc:
Shield fashioned from a tall broken jar carried by the beastmen of Farum Azula. There is a particular knack to wielding it.

The beastmen have always fired earthenware jars for the express purpose of making shields. Such are their ways, strange though they are.
location: Drop: Crumbling Farum Azula 2% drop chance from the sword-and-shield and throwing knife variants of Beastman of Farum Azula. One sword-and-shield Beastman can be found just after the Crumbling Beast Grave Depths Site of Grace, along with a dog.
whatItIs: Beastman's Jar-Shield is a medium shield weighing 5. An enemy drop in Crumbling Farum Azula (a 2% chance).
whyItMatters: It starts at 71 physical attack and scales E in Strength. No Skill is its weapon skill. Its guard blocks 98 percent of physical damage with a guard boost of 53.
whenToUse: It can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones, and Beastman's Jar-Shield needs 10 Strength. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Beastman's Jar-Shield

desc:
A small, wooden roundshield. It is light and easy to handle, but cannot offer the damage negation of a metal shield.

Its emblem is an ancient thorn design. Though it isn't much, it boosts fire damage negation.
location: Equipped: One is part of the start gear for the Samurai class. Purhase: Weeping Peninsula One is sold for 600 Runes by the Nomadic Merchant on the path to Castle Morne, at the Castle Morne Rampart Site of Grace.
whatItIs: Red Thorn Roundshield is a small shield that weighs 1.5. Nomadic Merchant sells it for 600 runes in Weeping Peninsula.
whyItMatters: It starts at 70 physical attack and scales E in Strength. Its weapon skill is Parry. Its guard blocks 81 percent of physical damage with a guard boost of 47.
whenToUse: Red Thorn Roundshield needs 8 Strength; it can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Red Thorn Roundshield

desc:
A small, wooden roundshield. It is light and easy to handle, but cannot offer the damage negation of a metal shield.

An ancient cipher engraving lines the circumference. Though it isn't much, it boosts holy damage negation.
location: Equipped: One is part of the starting gear for the Astrologer class. Drop: Limgrave/Weeping Peninsula/Mt. Gelmir/Altus Plateau/Stone Coffin Fissure 2% drop chance from small shield-wielding Skeletons. This is despite that fact that they can wield either a Scripture Wooden Shield or an Iron...
whatItIs: Scripture Wooden Shield belongs to the small shield class at 1.5 weight. The Astrologer class starts with it.
whyItMatters: In practice, base attack is 70 physical, scaling E in Strength. The skill is Parry. Blocking with it stops 82 percent physical, and its guard boost is 47.
whenToUse: Scripture Wooden Shield needs 8 Strength, can take Ashes of War and affinity changes, and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Scripture Wooden Shield

desc:
Small wooden roundshield that has been reinforced with metal. It is light and easy to handle, but cannot offer the damage negation of a true metal shield.

The design riveted to the center represents both sword and tree.
location: Equipped: One is part of the starting gear for the Warrior class. Purchase: Limgrave Sold for 600 Runes by the Nomadic Merchant in Mistwood, east Limgrave. This merchant is south of the Minor Erdtree in the region, and northwest of Fort Haight. <!--
whatItIs: Riveted Wooden Shield belongs to the small shield class at 2 weight. It is Warrior starting gear.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 72 physical, scaling E in Strength. The skill on it is Parry. Blocking with it stops 86 percent physical, and its guard boost is 49.
whenToUse: It can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones, and Riveted Wooden Shield needs 8 Strength. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Riveted Wooden Shield

desc:
Small wooden roundshield that has been reinforced with metal. It is light and easy to handle, but cannot offer the damage negation of a true metal shield.
The design is said to represent the stars of the night sky, portending fate.
location: Loot: Academy Gate Town (Liurnia of the Lakes) Found behind a building in the far west of the town, just before and to the left of the bridge to the locked gate of the Academy of Raya Lucaria. <!--
whatItIs: Blue-White Wooden Shield is a small shield that weighs 2. Found at Academy Gate Town in Liurnia of the Lakes.
whyItMatters: It starts at 72 physical attack and scales E in Strength. The skill is No Skill. Its guard blocks 85 percent of physical damage with a guard boost of 49.
whenToUse: It can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones, and Blue-White Wooden Shield needs 8 Strength. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Blue-White Wooden Shield

desc:
Small metal roundshield depicting a sinister rift.
An antiquated charm that glares back at an enemy, it boosts focus.
location: Equipped: One is part of the starting gear for the Prisoner class. Purchase: Bellum Highway (Liurnia of the Lakes) One is sold for 1,800 Runes by the Nomadic Merchant found just a bit north of Bellum Church.
whatItIs: Rift Shield is a small shield that weighs 2. It is Prisoner starting gear.
whyItMatters: In practice, it starts at 70 physical attack and scales E in Strength. The skill is Parry. Its guard blocks 85 percent of physical damage with a guard boost of 47.
whenToUse: Rift Shield needs 8 Strength; it can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Rift Shield

desc:
An ordinary small roundshield made of metal. Heavier than a wooden shield, but boasts higher damage negation.

Finely balanced, this shield is easy to use.
location: Purchase: Limgrave One is sold for 900 Runes by the Nomadic Merchant found just southeast of Coastal Cave, beneath the collapsed structure.
whatItIs: Iron Roundshield belongs to the small shield class at 3 weight. It is for sale from Nomadic Merchant for 900 runes in Limgrave.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 74 physical, scaling E in Strength. Its weapon skill is No Skill. Its guard blocks 88 percent of physical damage with a guard boost of 51.
whenToUse: Iron Roundshield needs 8 Strength, can take Ashes of War and affinity changes, and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Iron Roundshield

desc:
Small metal roundshield. Heavier than a wooden shield, but boasts higher damage negation.
Though the gold leaf is peeling and the effect is slight, it still boosts holy damage negation.
location: Loot: Church of Pilgrimage (Weeping Peninsula) Found on a corpse in the small graveyard west of the Church. It's on the westernmost grave, reached in an almost straight line west from the Sacred Tear in the church.
whatItIs: Gilded Iron Shield is a small shield that weighs 3. Corpse loot at Church of Pilgrimage.
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 74 physical attack, scaling E in Strength. Weapon skill: Parry. Blocking with it stops 88 percent physical, and its guard boost is 51.
whenToUse: Gilded Iron Shield needs 8 Strength; it can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Gilded Iron Shield

desc:
Small metal roundshield. Heavier than a wooden shield, but boasts higher damage negation.
The ice crest originates from a Carian princess. Though the effect is slight, it boosts magic damage negation and resistance to frost.
location: Loot: Caria Manor (Liurnia of the Lakes) Upon entering Caria Manor, follow the right hand wall past a small staircase, where a large Fingercreeper will ambush you. Continue following the wall instead of going up the stairs and you will eventually reach an item on a rocky outcropping near a...
whatItIs: Ice Crest Shield is a small shield that weighs 3. Caria Manor in Liurnia of the Lakes is where it is found.
whyItMatters: It starts at 74 physical attack and scales E in Strength. Weapon skill: No Skill. Its guard blocks 87 percent of physical damage with a guard boost of 51.
whenToUse: Ice Crest Shield needs 9 Strength, can take Ashes of War and affinity changes, and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Ice Crest Shield

desc:
Small shield made upon Mt. Gelmir forged from uncooling lava.

Resists frost with its heat, and can even be used to deal fire damage if wielded as a weapon.
location: Loot: Volcano Manor (Mt. Gelmir) Obtained from a corpse in the Volcano Manor Legacy Dungeon. The corpse is inside a cave in front of gravestones near the bottom of the Prison Town. Starting from the Prison Town Church Site of Grace, exit into the Prison Town and drop down on the left side of the...
whatItIs: Smoldering Shield belongs to the small shield class at 3 weight. A corpse at Volcano Manor in Mt. Gelmir carries it.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 58 physical plus 37 fire, scaling E in Strength and D in Faith. Its weapon skill is Shield Bash, which costs 10 FP. Blocking with it stops 89 percent physical, and its guard boost is 51.
whenToUse: It cannot be infused and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones, and Smoldering Shield needs 10 Strength, 9 Dexterity, and 12 Faith. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Smoldering Shield

desc:
Small shield of antlers arranged in an eddy-like pattern. If used to attack a foe, the shield's antlers inflict blood loss.
