Once given to a Tarnished warrior who cultivated close ties to the ancestral followers. Though the effect is only slight, it boosts immunity, robustness, and focus.
location: Loot: Uld Palace Ruins (Liurnia of the Lakes) From the Ruined Labyrinth Site of Grace, head north to the nearby Wandering Mausoleum and then head left. The shield is on a corpse on the left after riding a bit, hanging of a cliff south of the Mausoleum's pond.
whatItIs: Spiralhorn Shield belongs to the small shield class at 2 weight. Looted from a corpse at Uld Palace Ruins in Liurnia of the Lakes.
whyItMatters: It starts at 75 physical attack and scales E in Strength. Hits carry blood loss (45) buildup. The skill on it is Parry. Its guard blocks 75 percent of physical damage with a guard boost of 44.
whenToUse: Spiralhorn Shield needs 8 Strength and 10 Dexterity; it can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Spiralhorn Shield

desc:
Armament designed for gladiatorial combat. Rises above its peers as a particularly showy specimen.

The sculpted bronze snake is a poisonous breed, boosting the wielder's resistance to poison.
location: Loot: Volcano Cave (Mt. Gelmir) From the cave's Site of Grace, take the right path when the cave splits, then fall down one drop and then turn around rather than falling down further. Following this path leads to a smaller section with the shield and 3 Arteria Leaves.
whatItIs: Coil Shield belongs to the small shield class at 1.5 weight. An enemy drop in Mt. Gelmir.
whyItMatters: It starts at 77 physical attack and scales E in Strength. It applies poison (72) buildup on hit. The skill is Viper Bite, 8 FP. Blocking with it stops 78 percent physical, and its guard boost is 38.
whenToUse: Coil Shield needs 10 Strength and 10 Dexterity, cannot be infused, and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Coil Shield

desc:
Roundshield engraved with a smithscript. A throwing weapon created through the smithing arts. Can be thrown by performing the armament's Skill.
Unique Skill: Discus Hurl
Throws the roundshield like a discus using the smithing arts. Once thrown, the shield will remain airbone for a moment before beginning a vertical rotation that chases down its target.
location: Loot: Taylew's Ruined Forge (Rauh Base) Found by running up the raised stone pillar and then jumping off to the right at the top. Go through the doorway and run up a ramp to the right to reach a platform with the shield, guarded by a greatpot-wielding Golem Smith and a falling Molten Tear.
whatItIs: Smithscript Shield belongs to the small shield class at 2.5 weight. Look for it at Taylew's Ruined Forge in Ancient Ruins of Rauh.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 72 physical, scaling D in Strength, E in Dexterity, E in Intelligence, and E in Faith. Its weapon skill is Discus Hurl, which costs 3 FP. Blocking with it stops 84 percent physical, and its guard boost is 47.
whenToUse: It cannot be infused and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones, and Smithscript Shield needs 10 Strength, 15 Dexterity, 11 Intelligence, and 11 Faith. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Smithscript Shield

desc:
A standard medium-sized metal shield.

Metal shields reliably negate physical damage when guarding, a trait which made them highly trusted on the battlefield.
location: Purchase: Liurnia of the Lakes One is sold for 1,000 Runes by the Nomadic Merchant next to the Liurnia Lake Shore Site of Grace, at the southern end of Liurnia's great lake. <!--
whatItIs: Kite Shield belongs to the medium shield class at 4.5 weight. Sold by Nomadic Merchant for 1,000 runes.
whyItMatters: It starts at 78 physical attack and scales D in Strength. No Skill is its weapon skill. Blocking with it stops 100 percent physical, and its guard boost is 56.
whenToUse: Kite Shield needs 12 Strength, can take Ashes of War and affinity changes, and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Kite Shield

desc:
Leather shield of Stormveil soldiers. Much like the castle, it is marred by mottling and thorns.
Some say it is the curse of grafting which causes such affliction, while others talk of its root being something altogether more sinister hidden deep within the castle.
location: Loot: Stormveil Castle Located halfway up the wooden walkway to the side entrance of the castle that Gostoc recommends, found just after the Stormveil Cliffside Site of Grace.
whatItIs: Marred Leather Shield is a medium shield that weighs 3. Look for it at Stormveil Castle.
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 75 physical attack, scaling D in Strength. Each hit builds up blood loss (50). No Skill is its weapon skill. Its guard blocks 90 percent of physical damage with a guard boost of 51.
whenToUse: Marred Leather Shield needs 8 Strength, can take Ashes of War and affinity changes, and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Marred Leather Shield

desc:
Wooden shield of Stormveil soldiers. Much like the castle,
it is marred by mottling and thorns.

Some say it is the curse of grafting which causes such
affliction, while others talk of its root being something
altogether more sinister hidden deep within the castle.
location: Loot: Stormveil Castle Drop down the north side of the tower on the left on the wall north of the Rampart Tower Site of Grace, then continue dropping down until a broken, thorned tower is reached with the shield.
whatItIs: Marred Wooden Shield is a medium shield that weighs 4. An enemy drop.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 76 physical, scaling D in Strength. Each hit builds up blood loss (50). The skill on it is No Skill. Its guard blocks 92 percent of physical damage with a guard boost of 52.
whenToUse: Marred Wooden Shield needs 8 Strength; it can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Marred Wooden Shield

desc:
A tall medium-sized metal shield. Given to knights who, whether by misfortune or misdeed, were forced to abandon their homes.
Most of these knights were sent to the fringes, where they were forced to start anew with only despair for company.
location: Drop: Stormveil Castle / Cathedral of Dragon Communion (Caelid) / Castle Sol (Mountaintops of the Giants) / Crumbling Farum Azula 4% drop chance from shield-wielding Banished Knight. The Knight at the entrance of the Cathedral of Dragon Communion is an easy target when farming for this item.
whatItIs: Banished Knight's Shield is a medium shield weighing 6. In practice, an enemy drop in Caelid (a 4% chance).
whyItMatters: It starts at 81 physical attack and scales D in Strength. No Skill is its weapon skill. Blocking with it stops 100 percent physical, and its guard boost is 60.
whenToUse: Banished Knight's Shield needs 14 Strength, can take Ashes of War and affinity changes, and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Banished Knight's Shield

desc:
Tall oval shield made of metal carried by young Albinaurics.
The ornamentation represents the primordial drop of dew from which they are said to have been created. Boasts exceptional magic damage negation. The Albinaurics' most formidable foes were sorcerers, after all.
location: Drop: Liurnia of the Lakes / Consecrated Snowfield 2% drop chance from curved sword- or axe-wielding Second-Generation Albinauric enemies. Three shield-wielders can be found on a sunken church/trio of buildings northwest of the Academy Gate Town Site of Grace and southwest of the icon for...
whatItIs: Albinauric Shield is a medium shield that weighs 4.5. Enemies in Liurnia of the Lakes drop it (a 2% chance).
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 78 physical attack, scaling D in Strength. The skill on it is Parry. Its guard blocks 100 percent of physical damage with a guard boost of 56.
whenToUse: It can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones, and Albinauric Shield needs 11 Strength. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Albinauric Shield

desc:
Shield of honor depicting a city crowned by the sun. It has seen better days.
Much like the wear upon the shield, the Seat of the Sun is long faded away.
location: Drop: Limgrave / Liurnia of the Lakes / Caelid / Capital Outskirts / Crumbling Farum Azula 2% drop chance from red-caped Skeletons and shield-wielding Beast Skeletons. Two easily farmable Skeletons of this type can be found besides the road from the Saintsbridge Site of Grace to Summonwater...
whatItIs: Sun Realm Shield is a medium shield weighing 3.5. In practice, enemies in Limgrave drop it (a 2% chance).
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 74 physical attack, scaling D in Strength. Weapon skill: Parry. Its guard blocks 92 percent of physical damage with a guard boost of 56.
whenToUse: Sun Realm Shield needs 8 Strength; it can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Sun Realm Shield

desc:
Shield of radiant silver, festooned with amber and carried by Loretta, Knight of the Haligtree.

whenToUse: Fingerprint Stone Shield needs 48 Strength, can take Ashes of War and affinity changes, and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Fingerprint Stone Shield

desc:
Greatshield painted with a divine scene; the recipience of a blessed tear from the Erdtree. An item that looks back fondly on the age of plenty.

The divine scene acts in and of itself as a sacred invocation; gradually restoring the carrier's HP.
location: Loot: Woodfolk Ruins (Altus Plateau) Found on the right side inside the northernmost building at Woodfolk Ruins.
whatItIs: Icon Shield is a greatshield weighing 9. Look for it at Woodfolk Ruins in Altus Plateau.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 111 physical, scaling D in Strength. Its weapon skill is No Skill. Its guard blocks 95 percent of physical damage with a guard boost of 61.
whenToUse: It cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones, and Icon Shield needs 22 Strength. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Icon Shield

desc:
Tricksome shield made from white stone depicting a malformed one-eyed god. The barrel of a firearm pokes through the open mouth.

Once worshipped by the giants, this evil deity is believed to have been slain by Queen Marika.
location: Guaranteed Drop: Guardians' Garrison (Mountaintops of the Giants) Dropped by Chief Guardian Arghanthy in the Guardians' Garrison in Mountaintops of the Giants.
whatItIs: One-Eyed Shield is a greatshield that weighs 20.5. It drops from Chief Guardian Arghanthy in Mountaintops of the Giants.
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 146 physical attack, scaling D in Strength. Its weapon skill is Flame Spit, which costs 28 FP. Its guard blocks 100 percent of physical damage with a guard boost of 67.
whenToUse: One-Eyed Shield needs 36 Strength; it cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: One-Eyed Shield

desc:
Tricksome bronze shield depicting the face of a Fire Giant. Several tongues leap from its open mouth.

The dreadful visage and burning flames are designed to remind one of the horror of facing a Fire Giant. In other words, this shield has an instructional function.
location: Loot: Caelem Ruins (Caelid) It can be found in northeast Caelid, in a chest that's accessible after defeating the Mad Pumpkin Head Duo boss in the Caelem Ruins.
whatItIs: Visage Shield belongs to the greatshield class at 24 weight. Chest loot at Caelem Ruins in Caelid.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 155 physical, scaling D in Strength. Tongues of Fire is its weapon skill, costing 5 FP per use. Blocking with it stops 100 percent physical, and its guard boost is 75.
whenToUse: It cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones, and Visage Shield needs 44 Strength. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Visage Shield

desc:
A large wooden shield covered with spikes. Though relatively light, it lacks in damage negation.

Designed to perform shield bashes, these attacks riddle the enemy with holes, earning it the nickname of "pard shield."
location: Loot: Caelid Found on the path from Deep Siofra Well to the Caelid Colosseum, on a small rock near where the first Golem Archer stands.
whatItIs: Spiked Palisade Shield is a greatshield that weighs 9.5. Caelid is where it is found.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 116 physical, scaling D in Strength. It applies blood loss (70) buildup on hit. Shield Bash is its weapon skill. Its guard blocks 95 percent of physical damage with a guard boost of 62.
whenToUse: Spiked Palisade Shield needs 20 Strength; it can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Spiked Palisade Shield

desc:
An iron greatshield large enough to cover the entire body. Depicts the Roundtable Hold, gathering place of champions.

Greatshields boast high damage negation and guard capacity, making enemy attacks easy to repel.
location: Loot: Stormveil Castle From the Secluded Cell Site of Grace, head back towards the Living Jars, then turn right and follow the wall upon reaching the next level up the ramp to find a wooden scaffolding. At the end of the scaffolding is a ledge that can be jumped up to and the followed to the...
whatItIs: Manor Towershield is a greatshield weighing 15.5. Look for it at Stormveil Castle From the Secluded Cell.
whyItMatters: It starts at 111 physical attack and scales D in Strength. Its weapon skill is Shield Bash. In practice, blocking with it stops 100 percent physical, and its guard boost is 71.
whenToUse: Manor Towershield needs 30 Strength; it can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Manor Towershield

desc:
An iron greatshield large enough to cover the entire body. Emblazoned with an old, interleaving tree.

Greatshields boast high damage negation and guard capacity, making enemy attacks easy to repel.
location: Purchase: Altus Plateau Purchased from the Nomadic Merchant near the Forest-Spanning Greatbridge Site of Grace in central Altus Plateau for 3800 Runes. This location is southeast of the Altus Plateau Minor Erdtree.
whatItIs: Crossed-Tree Towershield is a greatshield that weighs 15.5. You can buy it from Nomadic Merchant in Altus Plateau for 3,800 runes.
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 111 physical attack, scaling D in Strength. Its weapon skill is Shield Bash. In practice, its guard blocks 100 percent of physical damage with a guard boost of 71.
whenToUse: It can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones, and Crossed-Tree Towershield needs 30 Strength. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Crossed-Tree Towershield

desc:
An iron greatshield large enough to cover the entire body. Features an inverted hawk crest.

Greatshields boast high damage negation and guard capacity, making enemy attacks easy to repel.
location: Drop: Nokron, Eternal City 1% drop chance from Greatshield-wielding Fallen Hawk Soldiers. Starting from the Nokron, Eternal City Site of Grace, three Greatshield-wielders can be found at the gazebo just to the east. A fourth one can be found at the tree in a corner northeast of the gazebo, and a...
whatItIs: Inverted Hawk Towershield is a greatshield that weighs 16. Look for it as a drop from Greatshield-wielding Fallen Hawk Soldiers (a 1% chance) in Nokron, Eternal City.
whyItMatters: In practice, it starts at 111 physical attack and scales D in Strength. The skill is Shield Bash. Its guard blocks 100 percent of physical damage with a guard boost of 65.
whenToUse: Inverted Hawk Towershield needs 30 Strength, can take Ashes of War and affinity changes, and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Inverted Hawk Towershield

desc:
Huge head of one of the giant ants which inhabit the two underground rivers, used without modification as a shield. Excels at repelling enemy attacks.

Giant ants are venomous creatures, granting a boost to immunity when wielding this shield.
location: Loot: Nokstella, Eternal City Can be found in a chest in a small room at the beginning of Nokstella, Eternal City. From the Nokstella, Eternal City Site of Grace, heading up the stairs just to the west of the Grace there is a room with a treasure chest to the south on the first landing that...
whatItIs: Ant's Skull Plate is a greatshield weighing 12.5. Found in a chest at Nokstella, Eternal City.
whyItMatters: It starts at 114 physical attack and scales D in Strength. Hits carry poison (90) buildup. The skill is Shield Bash, 10 FP. Blocking with it stops 100 percent physical, and its guard boost is 70.
whenToUse: Ant's Skull Plate needs 28 Strength, cannot be infused, and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Ant's Skull Plate

desc:
Greatshield shaped like a fang, featuring the crest of red-maned lion.

Carried by the Redmane Knights who fought alongside Radahn.
location: Drop: Caelid 4% drop chance from Redmane Knights (except for the Greatbow-wielding ones). A lone Redmane Knight can be found in a small camp a bit southwest of the Smoldering Wall Site of Grace. Three Redmane Knights can be found atop Fort Gael (ignoring the Greatbow-wielder outside of the Fort,...
whatItIs: Redmane Greatshield belongs to the greatshield class at 14 weight. Look for it as a drop from Redmane Knights (a 4% chance) in Caelid.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 108 physical, scaling D in Strength. Its weapon skill is No Skill. Blocking with it stops 100 percent physical, and its guard boost is 65.
whenToUse: Redmane Greatshield needs 30 Strength; it can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Redmane Greatshield

desc:
Metal greatshield painted with a sun in eclipse. Carried by the headless mausoleum knights.

The eclipsed sun, drained of color, is the protective star of soulless demigods. It aids the mausoleum knights by keeping Destined Death at bay.
location: Drop: Liurnia of the Lakes / Deeproot Depths / Consecrated Snowfield 4% drop rate from Greatsword-wielding Mausoleum Knight (excluding the Greatbow-wielding ones). One Greatsword-wielding Knight can be found with its back turned just outside of the Black Knife Catacombs, providing an easy...
whatItIs: Eclipse Crest Greatshield is a greatshield weighing 15. In practice, an enemy drop in Liurnia of the Lakes (a 4% chance).
whyItMatters: Base attack is 110 physical, scaling D in Strength. Weapon skill: No Skill. For a new player, its guard blocks 100 percent of physical damage with a guard boost of 71.
whenToUse: Eclipse Crest Greatshield needs 32 Strength, can take Ashes of War and affinity changes, and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Eclipse Crest Greatshield

desc:
Metal greatshield painted with a peering cuckoo. Carried by the enchanted knights sworn to the academy.

Boasting high magic damage negation, this shield is used to hunt down mages. "Our enemy is none other than Caria itself."
location: Drop: Liurnia of the Lakes 4% drop chance from Cuckoo Knights. Four knights can be found on and beside the road leading northeast from East Raya Lucaria Gate Site of Grace to a point just south of Bellum Church.
whatItIs: Cuckoo Greatshield is a greatshield weighing 15. Look for it as a drop from Cuckoo Knights (a 4% chance) in Liurnia of the Lakes.
whyItMatters: It starts at 110 physical attack and scales D in Strength. Its weapon skill is No Skill. Its guard blocks 100 percent of physical damage with a guard boost of 62.
whenToUse: Cuckoo Greatshield needs 32 Strength; it can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Cuckoo Greatshield

desc:
Oval greatshield made of gold, carried by knights who protect the Royal Capital of Leyndell.

Knights of Leyndell are reputed for their sturdiness, exemplified by this shield's exceptional guard capacity.
location: Drop: Liurnia of the Lakes / Altus Plateau / Mt. Gelmir / Leyndell, Royal Capital 4% drop chance from Leyndell Knights (excluding the Greatbow-wielding ones but including the frenzied ones). The earliest Leyndell Knight can be found wandering alone just south of the Artist's Shack in Liurnia.
whatItIs: Golden Greatshield is a greatshield that weighs 17. Look for it as a drop from Leyndell Knights (a 4% chance) in Liurnia of the Lakes.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 113 physical, scaling D in Strength. Weapon skill: No Skill. Its guard blocks 100 percent of physical damage with a guard boost of 70.
whenToUse: It can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones, and Golden Greatshield needs 34 Strength. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Golden Greatshield

desc:
Metal greatshield coated with gold. Carried by knights loyal to Godrick.

The red tinge in the gold coat mirrors the primordial matter that became the Erdtree. The color of homeward yearning.
location: Drop: Limgrave / Weeping Peninsula 4% drop chance from Godrick Knights. One spear-wielding Knight can be found at Gatefront Ruins. Two greatsword-wielding Knights can be found inside of the Godrick Soldier camp between Warmaster's Shack and Deathtouched Catacombs.
whatItIs: Gilded Greatshield is a greatshield weighing 16.5. It drops from Godrick Knights in Limgrave (a 4% chance).
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 115 physical attack, scaling D in Strength. Weapon skill: No Skill. For a new player, blocking with it stops 100 percent physical, and its guard boost is 71.
whenToUse: It can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones, and Gilded Greatshield needs 36 Strength. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Gilded Greatshield

desc:
Metal greatshield depicting the Haligtree with unalloyed gold. Carried by knights who have vowed to serve Miquella's Haligtree. Possesses high holy damage negation.

Yet now, with the Haligtree misshapen, this wondrous rendition is a fleeting fantasy.
location: Drop: Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree Has a 4% drop chance from one specific Haligtree Knight standing at the northern side of the chapel beyond the Drainage Channel Site of Grace.
whatItIs: Haligtree Crest Greatshield is a greatshield that weighs 18.5. An enemy drop (a 4% chance).
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 116 physical attack, scaling D in Strength. No Skill is its weapon skill. Put simply, blocking with it stops 100 percent physical, and its guard boost is 71.
whenToUse: Haligtree Crest Greatshield needs 36 Strength; it can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Haligtree Crest Greatshield

desc:
Wooden greatshield reinforced with a metal ornamentation.

Greatshields boast high damage negation and guard capacity, making enemy attacks easy to repel.
location: Loot: Stormveil Castle (Limgrave) Found on the upper floor of a guardhouse in Stormveil's courtyard, more specifically the guardhouse to the right if entering the area from the main gates and on the opposite side of the room with the "Prophecy" Painting.
whatItIs: Wooden Greatshield is a greatshield weighing 8. Stormveil Castle in Limgrave is where it is found.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 95 physical, scaling D in Strength. The skill is No Skill. Its guard blocks 91 percent of physical damage with a guard boost of 56.
whenToUse: Wooden Greatshield needs 14 Strength, can take Ashes of War and affinity changes, and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Wooden Greatshield

desc:
Wooden tower shield. Lightweight for a greatshield and easy to handle. Commonly used in the Shattering.

Greatshields boast high damage negation and guard capacity, making enemy attacks easy to repel.
location: Drop: Limgrave / Liurnia of the Lakes / Caelid / Deeproot Depths / Altus Plateau / Miquella's Haligtree 2% drop chance from any Spear-and-Greatshield-wielding Godrick Soldiers, Raya Lucaria Soldiers, Radahn Soldiers, Mausoleum Soldiers, Leyndell Soldiers, or Haligtree Soldiers.
whatItIs: Lordsworn's Shield is a greatshield that weighs 9. For a new player, an enemy drop in Limgrave (a 2% chance).
whyItMatters: Base attack is 99 physical, scaling D in Strength. The skill is Shield Bash, 10 FP. Blocking with it stops 94 percent physical, and its guard boost is 63.
whenToUse: It can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones, and Lordsworn's Shield needs 16 Strength. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Lordsworn's Shield

desc:
Weighty shields carried by the Black Knights, servants of Messmer the Impaler. Made of black steel with decorative embellishments in gold.

Symbolic of their iron conviction in their crusade, the Black Knights will never yield. Nor will they ever doubt their purpose.
location: Guaranteed Drop: Fog Rift Fort (Gravesite Plain) Dropped by Black Knight Garrew, who can be found patrolling the southern ramparts of the Fog Rift Fort.
whatItIs: Black Steel Greatshield is a greatshield that weighs 19.5. Dropped by Black Knight Garrew.
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 119 physical attack, scaling D in Strength. Shield Bash is its weapon skill, costing 10 FP per use. Blocking with it stops 100 percent physical, and its guard boost is 69.
whenToUse: Black Steel Greatshield needs 35 Strength; it can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Black Steel Greatshield

desc:
Greatshield made of the unusual metal known as verdigris.

Boasts greater guard capacity than damage negation. To the extent that the shield will continue to protect its target even if its bearer should die.
location: Guaranteed Drop / Loot from Moore. Its location and availability can be determined by the player's dialogue-choices as they talk to Moore about the breaking of Miquella's great rune: Scadu Altus - If the player tells Moore to "Remain sad forever". Moore will quietly move to the cliffs north of...
whatItIs: Verdigris Greatshield is a greatshield that weighs 28. An enemy drop in Scadu Altus.
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 162 physical attack, scaling D in Strength. Its weapon skill is Moore's Charge, which costs 16 FP. Its guard blocks 100 percent of physical damage with a guard boost of 82.
whenToUse: Verdigris Greatshield needs 49 Strength; it cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Verdigris Greatshield

desc:
Staff with a glintstone embedded at the tip. A catalyst for casting sorceries.
Sorceries must be memorized first at a site of lost grace, and a staff must be equipped to cast them.
location: Equip: Starting equipment for the Prisoner class. Guaranteed drop: Limgrave Guaranteed drop from a Sorcerer Noble just south of Waypoint Ruins, just west of the graveyard with Wolves (one-time drop only). Drop: Limgrave/Liurnia of the Lakes/Caelid/Altus Plateau/Consecrated Snowfield/Castle...
whatItIs: Glintstone Staff is a glintstone staff weighing 3. It is Prisoner starting gear.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 25 physical, scaling E in Strength and C in Intelligence. The skill on it is No Skill.
whenToUse: Glintstone Staff needs 6 Strength and 10 Intelligence, cannot be infused, and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Glintstone Staff

desc:
Staff fashioned from pure crystal; a deed impossible for a human. Enhances Crystalian sorceries.
The Crystalian's faint cogitation is known as the "wisdom of stone." This staff can only be wielded by those of intellect high enough to grasp such wisdom.
location: Loot: Liurnia of the Lakes Found in a treasure chest inside Academy Crystal Cave. The chest is on a raised platform hidden by an illusory wall, which in turn is found to the left just after the door to the room with the Battlemage/fog wall to the boss. Entering the cave requires 2 Stonesword Keys.
whatItIs: Crystal Staff is a glintstone staff that weighs 4.5. Found in a chest in Liurnia of the Lakes.
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 31 physical attack, scaling D in Strength and B in Intelligence. The skill on it is No Skill.
whenToUse: It cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones, and Crystal Staff needs 8 Strength and 48 Intelligence. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Crystal Staff

desc:
Staff with a forked tip, embedded with red glintstones. Enhances lava sorceries.
The Man-Serpents of Mt. Gelmir draw from faith in addition to intelligence to enhance the potency of their sorcery.
location: Drop: Mt. Gelmir 11.11% drop chance from the egg-headed Man-Serpent near the throne in Volcano Manor, right before Rykard's teleporter at the end of the area.
whatItIs: Gelmir Glintstone Staff belongs to the glintstone staff class at 2.5 weight. An enemy drop in Mt. Gelmir (a 11.11% chance).
whyItMatters: It starts at 29 physical attack and scales E in Strength, D in Intelligence, and D in Faith. The skill is No Skill.
whenToUse: Gelmir Glintstone Staff needs 6 Strength, 14 Intelligence, and 14 Faith, cannot be infused, and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Gelmir Glintstone Staff

desc:
Glintstone staff styled as a scepter. A gift once given to the demi-humans to foster peace, it can be wielded even by those of low intelligence.
Sneered at by fools in the academy.
location: Guaranteed drop: Weeping Peninsula Dropped by the Demi-Human Queen found in the Demi-Human Forest Ruins.
whatItIs: Demi-Human Queen's Staff belongs to the glintstone staff class at 3 weight. Look for it as a drop from Demi-Human Queen in Weeping Peninsula.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 31 physical, scaling D in Strength and C in Intelligence. The skill on it is No Skill.
whenToUse: Demi-Human Queen's Staff needs 6 Strength and 10 Intelligence, cannot be infused, and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Demi-Human Queen's Staff

desc:
Magic scepter of Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon. The glintstone is known as a Carian Blue, enhancing full moon sorceries.

Only those of the highest intelligence may wield this, the finest of all glintstone staves.
location: Purchase: Roundtable Hold Trade the Remembrance of the Full Moon Queen, gained by defeating Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon, with Finger Reader Enia. Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums with a bell to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).
whatItIs: Carian Regal Scepter is a glintstone staff that weighs 3. Trade in the Remembrance of the Full Moon Queen with Finger Reader Enia to get it.
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 24 physical attack, scaling E in Strength, E in Dexterity, and B in Intelligence. The skill on it is Spinning Weapon at 20 FP.
whenToUse: Carian Regal Scepter needs 8 Strength, 10 Dexterity, and 60 Intelligence; it cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Carian Regal Scepter

desc:
Staff of a sorcerer-miner who extracts glintstone from crystal tunnels. The staff itself is a tool used to mine, and the ferrule is also embedded with a glintstone.
Boosts the power of Stonedigger sorceries.
location: Drop: Liurnia of the Lakes/Caelid/Altus Plateau 2% drop chance from regular and sack-carrying Glintstone Miners found in mines. Plenty are found throughout the entirety of Raya Lucaria Crystal Tunnel, making it a good place to farm for it. Sellia Crystal Tunnel is the earliest farming spot for...
whatItIs: Digger's Staff is a glintstone staff that weighs 4.5. In practice, an enemy drop in Liurnia of the Lakes (a 2% chance).
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 38 physical attack, scaling D in Strength and C in Intelligence. Its weapon skill is No Skill.
whenToUse: It cannot be infused and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones, and Digger's Staff needs 8 Strength and 12 Intelligence. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Digger's Staff

desc:
Staff of the astrologers. A glintstone is embedded in the tip, enabling it to be used as a catalyst for sorceries.

Sorceries must be memorized first at a site of lost grace, and a staff must be equipped to cast them.
location: Equipped: Starting equipment for the Astrologer origin. Purchase: Liurnia of the Lakes 1x sold by the Nomadic Merchant at the Liurnia Lake Shore Site of Grace for 800 Runes.
whatItIs: Astrologer's Staff is a glintstone staff that weighs 3. On this one, it is in your inventory from the very beginning.
whyItMatters: It starts at 25 physical attack and scales E in Strength and C in Intelligence. Weapon skill: No Skill.
whenToUse: Astrologer's Staff needs 7 Strength and 16 Intelligence, cannot be infused, and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Astrologer's Staff

desc:
Staff embedded with a blue glintstone. One of two types of Carian staff.
Gifted to enchanted knights, it enhances Glintblade sorceries.
location: Loot: Liurnia of the Lakes Located on top of the Highway Lookout Tower in southeastern Liurnia of the Lakes, northeast of Laskyar Ruins and south of an Artist's Shack.
whatItIs: Carian Glintblade Staff is a glintstone staff that weighs 2.5. Found in Liurnia of the Lakes.
whyItMatters: It starts at 22 physical attack and scales E in Strength, E in Dexterity, and C in Intelligence. Weapon skill: No Skill.
whenToUse: Carian Glintblade Staff needs 6 Strength, 12 Dexterity, and 22 Intelligence, cannot be infused, and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Carian Glintblade Staff

desc:
Staff embedded with sullied amber, said to be a very part of the Prince of Death. Enhances death sorceries.
One of the staves deemed heretical by the academy for its ability to allow sorceries to be augmented through faith in addition to intelligence.
location: Loot: Deeproot Depths Found on top of a building reached by running up the roots northeast of The Nameless Eternal City grace.
whatItIs: Prince of Death's Staff is a glintstone staff that weighs 3. Found in Deeproot Depths.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 25 physical, scaling E in Strength, D in Intelligence, and D in Faith. No Skill is its weapon skill.
whenToUse: Prince of Death's Staff needs 6 Strength, 18 Intelligence, and 18 Faith, cannot be infused, and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Prince of Death's Staff

desc:
Short staff with a blue glintstone embedded. Wielded by the Albinaurics of old.
The Albinaurics harbor a secret; they cast sorcery using their innate arcaneness.
location: Loot: Mt. Gelmir Found together with the Albinauric Mask in the same room as an Omenkiller, located on the third floor of the same building as the Guest Hall Site of Grace, located in Volcano Manor. This room is accessed by jumping onto a balcony from the roof of the building. The balcony is...
whatItIs: Albinauric Staff belongs to the glintstone staff class at 2.5 weight. Volcano Manor in Mt. Gelmir is where it is found.
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 17 physical attack, scaling E in Strength, D in Intelligence, and C in Arcane. Its weapon skill is No Skill.
whenToUse: Albinauric Staff needs 6 Strength, 10 Intelligence, and 12 Arcane; it cannot be infused and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Albinauric Staff

desc:
Staff of the Academy of Raya Lucaria, embedded with a turquoise glintstone.
Only a recognized sorcerer is permitted to wield this staff.
location: Guaranteed drop: Liurnia of the Lakes Dropped by Thops, either by killing him in the Church of Irith or upon finishing his questline, inside the Academy of Raya Lucaria just before the Schoolhouse Classroom site of grace. Drop: Liurnia of the Lakes/Caelid/Mt. Gelmir
whatItIs: Academy Glintstone Staff belongs to the glintstone staff class at 3 weight. Thops in Liurnia of the Lakes can drop it.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 25 physical, scaling E in Strength and B in Intelligence. The skill on it is No Skill.
whenToUse: Academy Glintstone Staff needs 6 Strength and 28 Intelligence, cannot be infused, and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Academy Glintstone Staff

desc:
Staff embedded with a blue glintstone. One of two types of Carian staff.
Given to sorcerers that they might enact the role of knight. Enhances Carian sword sorceries.
location: Loot: Liurnia of the Lakes Located in the regular version of Carian Study Hall, on a small pedestal just before the elevator to the second floor.
whatItIs: Carian Glintstone Staff is a glintstone staff weighing 3. Found in Liurnia of the Lakes.
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 25 physical attack, scaling E in Strength and C in Intelligence. No Skill is its weapon skill.
whenToUse: Carian Glintstone Staff needs 6 Strength, 8 Dexterity, and 24 Intelligence, cannot be infused, and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Carian Glintstone Staff

desc:
Staff of the primeval glintstone sorcerer Azur. Only those who have glimpsed what lies beyond the wisdom of stone may wield it.
Reduces casting time of sorceries, but consumes additional FP.
location: Loot: Liurnia of the Lakes Found in a secluded room on the highest level of the Church of the Cuckoo, accessed via the rooftops of the Academy of Raya Lucaria. From the Debate Parlor site of grace, go outside to the left until you meet two Glintstone Sorcerers. Jump down on the stairs next to...
whatItIs: Azur's Glintstone Staff belongs to the glintstone staff class at 4 weight. Found in Liurnia of the Lakes.
whyItMatters: It starts at 24 physical attack and scales D in Strength and B in Intelligence. Its weapon skill is No Skill.
whenToUse: Azur's Glintstone Staff needs 10 Strength and 52 Intelligence; it cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Azur's Glintstone Staff

desc:
Staff of the primeval glintstone sorcerer Lusat. Only those who have glimpsed what lies beyond the wisdom of stone may wield it.
Enhances power of all sorceries, but consumes additional FP.
location: Loot: Caelid Found inside a chest after the Nox Swordstress & Nox Monk boss fight in Sellia, Town of Sorcery.
whatItIs: Lusat's Glintstone Staff is a glintstone staff that weighs 4. Found in a chest in Caelid.
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 24 physical attack, scaling D in Strength and B in Intelligence. No Skill is its weapon skill.
whenToUse: It cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones, and Lusat's Glintstone Staff needs 10 Strength and 52 Intelligence. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Lusat's Glintstone Staff

desc:
Staff embedded with a dark purple glintstone, said to be the fragment of a meteorite. Boasts high sorcery scaling and boosts gravity sorceries as well.

However, this staff cannot be strengthened in any way.
location: Loot: Caelid Found inside a broken tower with Miranda Sprouts in the southwestern part of Street of Sages Ruins, in the northwestern corner of the Swamp of Aeonia.
whatItIs: Meteorite Staff is a glintstone staff weighing 4.5. Caelid is where it is found.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 39 physical, scaling D in Strength and S in Intelligence. Its weapon skill is No Skill.
whenToUse: Meteorite Staff needs 6 Strength and 18 Intelligence, cannot be infused, and has no recorded upgrade path. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Meteorite Staff

desc:
A heretical staff fashioned from a smoldering, withered sapling that turns the blood of sacrifices pierced by it into glintstone. Similar to hex magic.

Sorceries are scaled with faith rather than intelligence when wielding this staff which enhances thorn sorceries in particular.
location: Drop: Liurnia of the Lakes / Mt. Gelmir / Mountaintops of the Giants 2% drop chance from Guilty, aka Thorn-Fire Sorcerers. The earliest place to find them is around the Fire Monk camp just north of the Artist's Shack in eastern Liurnia, while alternative farming spots is Fort Laiedd in Mt....
whatItIs: Staff of the Guilty is a glintstone staff that weighs 4.5. It drops from Guilty in Liurnia of the Lakes (a 2% chance).
whyItMatters: It starts at 38 physical attack and scales D in Strength and C in Faith. Hits carry blood loss (45) buildup. Its weapon skill is No Skill.
whenToUse: It cannot be infused and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones, and Staff of the Guilty needs 8 Strength and 12 Faith. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Staff of the Guilty

desc:
Staff fashioned from pure crystal; a deed impossible for a human. It festers with scarlet rot.
Enhances Crystalian sorceries.
location: Drop: Miquella's Haligtree 8% drop chance from Putrid Crystalian Mage enemies such as the one near the Elphael Inner Wall grace.
whatItIs: Rotten Crystal Staff belongs to the glintstone staff class at 4.5 weight. Dropped by Putrid Crystalian Mage (a 8% chance).
whyItMatters: Base attack is 42 physical, scaling D in Strength and B in Intelligence. Hits carry scarlet rot (50) buildup. Its weapon skill is No Skill.
whenToUse: Rotten Crystal Staff needs 8 Strength and 48 Intelligence, cannot be infused, and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Rotten Crystal Staff

desc:
Staff missing its glintstone. Wielded by sorcerers who believe that discovery comes through acts of asceticism.
This staff only distinguishes itself when casting invisibility sorceries, but that is reason enough for some to wield it.
location: Loot: Caelid Found on a corpse on a balcony in the northwestern parts of Sellia, Town of Sorcery, in eastern Caelid.
whatItIs: Staff of Loss is a glintstone staff that weighs 2.5. Looted from a corpse in Caelid.
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 22 physical attack, scaling E in Strength, E in Dexterity, and C in Intelligence. Weapon skill: No Skill.
whenToUse: Staff of Loss needs 6 Strength, 12 Dexterity, and 14 Intelligence, cannot be infused, and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Staff of Loss

desc:
Staff fashioned from the tail-fingers of Metyr, the Mother of Fingers, and the microcosm raised aloft over the crux they form. Catalyst for casting both sorceries and incantations.
The Mother received signs from the Greater Will from the beyond of the microcosm. Despite being broken and abandoned, she kept waiting for another message to come.
location: Trade: Roundtable Hold Trade the Remembrance of the Mother of Fingers, dropped by Metyr, Mother of Fingers, with Finger Reader Enia. Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums with a bell to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).
whatItIs: Staff of the Great Beyond is a glintstone staff weighing 2. Trade in the Remembrance of the Mother of Fingers with Finger Reader Enia to get it.
whyItMatters: It starts at 27 physical attack and scales E in Strength, D in Intelligence, and D in Faith. The skill on it is No Skill.
whenToUse: It cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones, and Staff of the Great Beyond needs 7 Strength, 25 Intelligence, and 25 Faith. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Staff of the Great Beyond

desc:
Staff of Count Ymir, who made himself a Mother of Fingers.
Carried for want of tail-fingers of his own. 
Enhances finger sorceries. 

The crystal ball, though representative of a microcosm, would not receive any sign.
location: Guaranteed drop: Cathedral of Manus Metyr (Scadu Altus) Dropped by Count Ymir, Mother of Fingers in the Cathedral of Manus Metyr, after having slain Metyr, Mother of Fingers.
whatItIs: Maternal Staff is a glintstone staff that weighs 2.5. Look for it as a drop from Count Ymir, Mother of Fingers in Scadu Altus.
whyItMatters: It starts at 26 physical attack and scales E in Strength, D in Intelligence, and D in Arcane. Weapon skill: No Skill.
whenToUse: Maternal Staff needs 7 Strength, 21 Intelligence, and 21 Arcane; it cannot be infused and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Maternal Staff

desc:
A sacred seal bestowed by a Finger Maiden which serves as a catalyst for casting sacred incantations.

Incantations must be memorized first at a site of lost grace, and a sacred seal must be equipped to cast them.
location: Equipped: Part of the starting equipment for the Prophet and Confessor Origins. Purchase: Roundtable Hold Can be purchased from the Twin Maiden Husks for 800 Runes.
whatItIs: Finger Seal is a sacred seal that weighs 1.5. Here, it is in your inventory from the very beginning.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 25 physical, scaling E in Strength and C in Faith. No Skill is its weapon skill.
whenToUse: Finger Seal needs 4 Strength and 10 Faith; it cannot be infused and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Finger Seal

desc:
Sacred seal of the Godskin Apostles, inlaid with obsidian.
Said to represent the manipulation of black flame, this catalyst enhances godslayer incantations.
location: Loot: Stormveil Castle Found inside a chest behind a fog wall that requires 1 Stonesword Key to open. The cellar entrance can be found to the left in the castle courtyard (the one just before the Liftside Chamber Site of Grace) if entered via the main gate and is guarded over by four rats.
whatItIs: Godslayer's Seal belongs to the sacred seal class at 1.5 weight. Found in a chest at Stormveil Castle.
whyItMatters: It starts at 25 physical attack and scales E in Strength and C in Faith. The skill is No Skill.
whenToUse: It cannot be infused and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones, and Godslayer's Seal needs 4 Strength and 27 Faith. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Godslayer's Seal

desc:
Sacred seal depicting the one-eyed god of the Fire Giants, adorned with braids of red hair.

Sacred seal wielded by Fire Monks and Prelates, this catalyst enhances Giant's Flame incantations.
location: Loot: Mountaintops of the Giants Found near a Fire Prelate enemy inside the Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave, reached by taking an elevator down and then sending it up again, then pulling the elevator's lever to ride down another floor using a hidden compartment and then finally climbing up a...
whatItIs: Giant's Seal is a sacred seal that weighs 1.5. Look for it in Mountaintops of the Giants.
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 25 physical attack, scaling E in Strength and C in Faith. The skill is No Skill.
whenToUse: Giant's Seal needs 4 Strength and 14 Faith, cannot be infused, and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Giant's Seal

desc:
Sacred seal made from Gravel Stone thought to be an ancient dragon scale. Enhances Dragon Cult incantations of the Royal Capital.
The worship of the ancient dragons does not conflict with belief in the Erdtree. After all, this seal, and lightning itself, are both imbued with gold.
location: Guaranteed loot: Leyndell, Royal Capital Dropped by a specific spear-wielding Leyndell Knight, found just to the left when standing outside of the front gate to the Fortified Manor.
whatItIs: Gravel Stone Seal is a sacred seal that weighs 1.5. Enemies in Leyndell, Royal Capital drop it.
whyItMatters: In practice, it starts at 25 physical attack and scales E in Strength and C in Faith. The skill is No Skill.
whenToUse: Gravel Stone Seal needs 4 Strength and 18 Faith, cannot be infused, and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Gravel Stone Seal

desc:
Sacred seal granted by Gurranq, the Beast Clergyman. A rare trinket which allows incantions to be scaled with strength.

The claw mark represents Gurranq's wrath. Enhances bestial incantations learned from Gurranq.
location: Quest Reward: Dragonbarrow (Caelid) Received after feeding 1 Deathroot to Gurranq, Beast Clergyman inside the Bestial Sanctum.
whatItIs: Clawmark Seal belongs to the sacred seal class at 1.5 weight. Located in Greyoll's Dragonbarrow.
whyItMatters: It starts at 31 physical attack and scales D in Strength and D in Faith. No Skill is its weapon skill.
whenToUse: Clawmark Seal needs 4 Strength and 10 Faith, cannot be infused, and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Clawmark Seal

desc:
A formless sacred seal depicting the ceremonial observation of Order. Enhances Golden Order Fundamentalist incantations.
Fundamentalism is scholarship in all but name. Scales incantations using both intelligence and faith.
location: Loot: Capital Outskirts Found at the tree inside of the Minor Erdtree Church, southwest of Leyndell, Royal Capital.
whatItIs: Golden Order Seal belongs to the sacred seal class at 0 weight. Found at Capital Outskirts in Leyndell, Royal Capital.
whyItMatters: It starts at 24 physical attack and scales D in Intelligence and D in Faith. The skill on it is No Skill.
whenToUse: Golden Order Seal needs 17 Intelligence and 17 Faith; it cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Golden Order Seal

desc:
A formless sacred seal decorated with an Erdtree crest, once the focus of religion in the Lands Between.
Even though the Elden Ring is shattered, and the Erdtree has dulled from its former radiance, earnest faith continues to hold the answers.
location: Loot: Mt. Gelmir Found inside a open cell just northwest of the Prison Town Church Site of Grace, located in Volcano Manor. There is an Omenkiller enemy near it. Can also be found by starting at the Guest Hall Site of Grace and backtracking to the top floor of the building, before exiting it...
whatItIs: Erdtree Seal is a sacred seal weighing 0. Volcano Manor in Mt. Gelmir is where it is found.
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 25 physical attack and 15 holy, scaling C in Faith. The skill on it is No Skill.
whenToUse: Erdtree Seal needs 40 Faith, cannot be infused, and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Erdtree Seal

desc:
Formless drakeblood seal with a dragon communion crest. Enhances Dragon Communion incantations.

The sacrificial devouring of the heart gives power. Indeed, Dragon Communion is too primal in nature for the term "incantation" to be appropriate. This seal scales incantations with one's arcane attribute.
location: Dropped by a spectral Banished Knight located in the Fringefolk Hero's Grave in Limgrave. To find it, start at the Stranded Graveyard Site of Grace and head down the first two ramps in the Grave, then head right in the split to go up another two ramps. The Knight is inside a small room at the...
whatItIs: Dragon Communion Seal is a sacred seal that weighs 0. An enemy drop in Limgrave.
whyItMatters: It starts at 25 physical attack and scales D in Faith and C in Arcane. The skill is No Skill.
whenToUse: Dragon Communion Seal needs 10 Faith and 10 Arcane, cannot be infused, and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Dragon Communion Seal

desc:
Formless sacred seal bestowed by the maiden of the Three Fingers. Enhances incantations of the frenzied flame.

This seal is the mark of the Lord of Frenzied Flame. Scales incantations using strength, dexterity, intelligence and faith all together.
location: Loot: Subterranean Shunning-Grounds (Leyndell, Royal Capital/Leyndell, Ashen Capital) Received by completing Lightseeker Hyetta's questline by accepting the blessing of the Three Fingers and then touching her.
whatItIs: Frenzied Flame Seal is a sacred seal that weighs 0. Look for it in Subterranean Shunning-Grounds.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 25 physical, scaling E in Strength, E in Dexterity, E in Intelligence, and D in Faith. It applies madness (55) buildup on hit. Its weapon skill is No Skill.
whenToUse: It cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones, and Frenzied Flame Seal has no stat requirements. Anyone can use it right away.
name: Frenzied Flame Seal

desc:
Sacred seal of the spiritual seekers known as the Dryleaf Sect. Enhances incantations of Miquella.

Those who saw the decline of the Erdtree in the fallen leaves long ago braced themselves for the weakening of Order, and embraced a strict faith. And then, they made to serve a new god.
location: Loot: Recluses' River (Scadu Altus) Found on one of the cliffs facing the river north of Recluses' River Downstream site of grace.
whatItIs: Dryleaf Seal belongs to the sacred seal class at 1.5 weight. Found at Recluses' River in Scadu Altus.
whyItMatters: In practice, Before upgrades it has 25 physical attack, scaling E in Strength and C in Faith. The skill is No Skill.
whenToUse: It cannot be infused and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones, and Dryleaf Seal needs 8 Strength and 27 Faith. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Dryleaf Seal

desc:
Sacred seal of the Fire Knights, who answer directly to Messmer the Impaler.

Enhances fire incantations of Messmer.

The emblem of Messmer's army depicts a golden ring and the fire of his sacred seal.
location: Loot: Shadow Keep, Church District (Shadow Keep) After draining the water from the district, this item can be found on the floor behind the decapitated statue of Marika inside the largest church in the district. It is guarded by Wego, Fire Knight Elder along with his putrid corpse summons.
whatItIs: Fire Knight's Seal is a sacred seal that weighs 1.5. Looted from a corpse at Shadow Keep, Church District in Shadow Keep.
whyItMatters: In practice, base attack is 25 physical, scaling E in Strength and C in Faith. Its weapon skill is No Skill.
whenToUse: It cannot be infused and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones, and Fire Knight's Seal needs 8 Strength and 23 Faith. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Fire Knight's Seal

desc:
Sacred seal of soiled amber engraved with a spiral tree design.

Enhances spiral incantations.

The majesty of the white tower, stretching to reach the gods, even inspired a secret faith in the invaders, the people of the Erdtree.
location: Loot: Gravesite Plain (through Rauh Base) Reward from "The Sacred Tower" Painting, which can be acquired from interacting with a painting found in a cave, northeast of the Scorched Ruins. The player can only acquire this item after having burned the Sealing Tree past the Church of the Bud. After...
whatItIs: Spiraltree Seal is a sacred seal that weighs 1.5. Found in Gravesite Plain.
whyItMatters: For a new player, base attack is 25 physical, scaling E in Strength and C in Faith. No Skill is its weapon skill.
whenToUse: Spiraltree Seal needs 8 Strength and 17 Faith; it cannot be infused and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Spiraltree Seal

desc:
A small bow for firing arrows from a distance. Other than its ability to fire off arrows in rapid succession, it is also well-suited for use on horseback.

To use a bow, arrows must also be equipped.
location: Starting equipment: 1 is part of the starting equipment for the Bandit origin. Purchase: Limgrave 1 is sold for 600 Runes by the Nomadic Merchant found beneath a collapsed structure just southeast of Coastal Cave. Drop: Weeping Peninsula / Liurnia of the Lakes / Caelid / Mountaintops of the...
whatItIs: Shortbow is a light bow that weighs 2.5. Here, you have it from the start of the game.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 65 physical, scaling E in Strength and E in Dexterity. The skill on it is Barrage at 22 FP.
whenToUse: Shortbow needs 8 Strength and 10 Dexterity; it cannot be infused and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Shortbow

desc:
Shortbow wielded by Winged Misbegotten. Fine fur clings to it.

Designed to inflict additional damage by sacrificing range.
location: Drop: Weeping Peninsula / Leyndell, Royal Capital / Cave of the Forlorn & Miquella's Haligtree (Consecrated Snowfield) 2% drop chance from Winged Misbegotten enemies. A group of 3 can be found just southeast of the Ailing Village Outskirts Site of Grace in Weeping Peninsula, along the cliffs.
whatItIs: Misbegotten Shortbow belongs to the light bow class at 3 weight. Dropped by Winged Misbegotten (a 2% chance).
whyItMatters: It starts at 68 physical attack and scales D in Strength and E in Dexterity. Weapon skill: Barrage (22 FP).
whenToUse: Misbegotten Shortbow needs 16 Strength and 8 Dexterity, cannot be infused, and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Misbegotten Shortbow

desc:
Shortbow of polished red wood. Fashioned by a master craftsman and wielded by pages.

A bow which requires dexterity rather than strength to master.
location: Drop: Tombsward Ruins (Weeping Peninsula) / Academy of Raya Lucaria & Caria Manor (Liurnia of the Lakes) / Redmane Castle (Caelid) / Shaded Castle & Leyndell, Royal Capital (Altus Plateau) / Castle Ensis (Gravesite Plain) 4% chance to drop from Pages and Noble Pages.
whatItIs: Red Branch Shortbow belongs to the light bow class at 2.5 weight. It drops from Pages and Noble Pages in Weeping Peninsula (a 4% chance).
whyItMatters: Base attack is 65 physical, scaling E in Strength and D in Dexterity. Its weapon skill is Barrage, which costs 22 FP.
whenToUse: It cannot be infused and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones, and Red Branch Shortbow needs 8 Strength and 16 Dexterity. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Red Branch Shortbow

desc:
Bow fashioned from a minstrel's harp. Sonorous tones still resound when firing arrows.

Troubadours sing tales of champions, both in the honorable service of the Erdtree, and the one who spurns honor for blasphemy.
location: Loot: Altus Plateau Found on top of a cliff east of Sainted Hero's Grave in Altus Plateau. Requires having examined the "Champion's Song" Painting just inside the northeastern section of the wall around Shaded Castle.
whatItIs: Harp Bow is a light bow weighing 2. Look for it in Altus Plateau.
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 62 physical attack, scaling E in Strength and E in Dexterity. Weapon skill: Barrage (22 FP).
whenToUse: Harp Bow needs 9 Strength and 9 Dexterity; it cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Harp Bow

desc:
Bow composited from a mix of materials.

Demands high attributes, and is tricky to wield, but is a fearsome tool when mastered.
location: Purchase: Bellum Church (Liurnia of the Lakes) 1 is sold for 3500 runes by a Nomadic Merchant just down an incline north of Bellum Church, located in northern Liurnia of the Lakes.
whatItIs: Composite Bow belongs to the light bow class at 3 weight. Sold by a merchant for 3,500 runes.
whyItMatters: It starts at 65 physical attack and scales E in Strength and D in Dexterity. The skill on it is Mighty Shot at 66 FP.
whenToUse: Composite Bow needs 15 Strength and 15 Dexterity; it cannot be infused and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Composite Bow

desc:
A crude shortbow fashioned from sickly bone.

A medium for spirit-calling, and a product of the ancient hexing arts of the tower.
location: Loot: Belurat, Tower Settlement (Land of the Tower) Found at the bottom floor of the tower with the spiraling staircase, located at the northwestern edge of the settlement. It is guarded by two giant Spider Scorpions.
whatItIs: Bone Bow is a light bow weighing 3. Look for it at Belurat, Tower Settlement.
whyItMatters: It starts at 66 physical attack and scales E in Strength and E in Dexterity. Rancor Shot is its weapon skill, costing 33 FP per use.
whenToUse: Bone Bow needs 8 Strength and 11 Dexterity; it cannot be infused and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Bone Bow

desc:
Longbow made to fire arrows over great distances. Compared to a shortbow, arrows fired reach further and deal more damage.
To use a bow, arrows must also be equipped.
location: Part of Samurai origin's starting equipment. Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold for 1,200 Runes. Dropped by Skeletons wielding the longbow.
whatItIs: Longbow is a bow that weighs 4. Note that it is in your inventory from the very beginning.
whyItMatters: It starts at 80 physical attack and scales E in Strength and D in Dexterity. Weapon skill: Mighty Shot (66 FP).
whenToUse: Longbow needs 9 Strength and 14 Dexterity; it cannot be infused and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Longbow

desc:
Longbow featuring delicate silverwork. Wielded by Albinauric wolfback archers.
This bow requires dexterity over strength to master.
location: Drop: Consecrated Snowfield / Ordina, Liturgical Town 4% drop from Albinauric Archer enemies. ru:Лук альбинора
whatItIs: Albinauric Bow belongs to the bow class at 4.5 weight. It drops from Albinauric Archer in Consecrated Snowfield (a 4% chance).
whyItMatters: It starts at 82 physical attack and scales E in Strength and D in Dexterity. Weapon skill: Mighty Shot (66 FP).
whenToUse: Albinauric Bow needs 7 Strength and 18 Dexterity, cannot be infused, and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Albinauric Bow

desc:
Longbow made from animal horn. Wielded by master hunters of the ancestral followers.
Imbues arrows fired with magic damage. Reveals its true worth when used with magic-infused arrows.
location: Found on a corpse in the area below Hallowhorn Grounds in the Siofra River region.
whatItIs: Horn Bow is a bow weighing 4.5. Looted from a corpse in Siofra River.
whyItMatters: It starts at 65 physical attack with 30 magic on top and scales E in Strength, D in Dexterity, and E in Intelligence. Mighty Shot is its weapon skill, costing 66 FP per use.
whenToUse: Horn Bow needs 10 Strength, 14 Dexterity, and 12 Intelligence, cannot be infused, and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Horn Bow

desc:
Longbow featuring Erdtree styling. In times of old, when faith and battle went hand in hand, this weapon was created in tandem with the Golden Arrow.
Scales all arrow damage with faith, revealing its true worth when used with holy-infused arrows.
location: Found inside a chest that can be accessed by going on the rooftops near the Erdtree Sanctuary grace, located in Leyndell, Royal Capital. ru:Лук Древа Эрд
whatItIs: Erdtree Bow belongs to the bow class at 4 weight. A chest in Leyndell, Royal Capital holds it.
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 40 physical attack and 50 holy, scaling E in Strength, E in Dexterity, and D in Faith. Its weapon skill is Mighty Shot, which costs 66 FP.
whenToUse: Erdtree Bow needs 8 Strength, 12 Dexterity, and 14 Faith; it cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Erdtree Bow

desc:
Malformed bow in the shape of a pair of poisonous snakes. Imbues arrows with poison through pagan magic, revealing its true worth when used with poison-infused arrows.

Used by assassins known as the Formless Serpents.
location: Loot: Abandoned Cave (Caelid) Found inside the Abandoned Cave by a pool of Scarlet Rot.
whatItIs: Serpent Bow is a bow that weighs 3.5. Abandoned Cave in Caelid is where it is found.
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 75 physical attack, scaling E in Strength, D in Dexterity, and D in Arcane. The skill is Mighty Shot, 66 FP.
whenToUse: Serpent Bow needs 8 Strength, 15 Dexterity, and 11 Arcane; it cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Serpent Bow

desc:
Longbow which utilizes a series of pulleys and strings. The complex mechanism, which required advanced mathematical and mechanical understand to craft, was likely made by a certain genius who learned Golden Order fundamentalism.

Enhances precision while shooting, enabling arrows to fly much further distances.
location: Found on a corpse up a tower near the First Mt. Gelmir Campsite grace. ru:Блочный лук
whatItIs: Pulley Bow belongs to the bow class at 5 weight. A corpse in Mt. Gelmir carries it.
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 77 physical attack, scaling D in Strength and D in Dexterity. Weapon skill: Mighty Shot (66 FP).
whenToUse: It cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones, and Pulley Bow needs 11 Strength and 11 Dexterity. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Pulley Bow

desc:
Longbow carved from black wood to resemble a blade. One of the most difficult bows to master.

The blade-like body of the bow is light and cuts through the air. Though a longbow, it can be wielded similarly to a shortbow.
location: Loot: Leyndell, Royal Capital (Altus Plateau) Found on a corpse on the rooftops of lower Leyndell, Royal Capital. The rooftops be accessed by going down the stairs from the Avenue Balcony Site of Grace, jumping over a railing to the right and climbing a series of stairs to the northeast. The...
whatItIs: Black Bow is a bow weighing 4. Corpse loot in Leyndell, Royal Capital.
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 70 physical attack, scaling E in Strength and D in Dexterity. Barrage is its weapon skill, costing 22 FP per use.
whenToUse: It cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones, and Black Bow needs 9 Strength and 20 Dexterity. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Black Bow

desc:
Weapon of Sir Ansbach. A longbow consisting of two bow bodies and two strings.

Unusually for a longbow, it can be wielded similarly to a light bow—provided that the wielder has the extraordinary dexterity demanded.
location: Quest Reward / Guaranteed Drop: Specimen Storehouse (Shadow Keep) Obtained from either assisting Ansbach or Leda in their confrontation at Specimen Storehouse.
whatItIs: Ansbach's Longbow is a bow weighing 4.5. It is an enemy drop.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 74 physical, scaling E in Strength and D in Dexterity. Fan Shot is its weapon skill, costing 1212 FP per use.
whenToUse: Ansbach's Longbow needs 9 Strength and 43 Dexterity; it cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Ansbach's Longbow

desc:
Greatbow of black iron wielded by General Radahn. Decorated with a lion motif.

Imbued with gravitational power of the Starscourge, when used along with Radahn's Spear, it becomes a true weapon of a champion.
location: Trade: Remembrance of the Starscourge Trade the Remembrance of the Starscourge with Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold. Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums with a bell to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough either way).
whatItIs: Lion Greatbow is a greatbow that weighs 9.5. It is traded for the Remembrance of the Starscourge at Roundtable Hold.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 120 physical, scaling D in Strength and D in Dexterity. The skill on it is Radahn's Rain at 3232 FP.
whenToUse: Lion Greatbow needs 22 Strength and 18 Dexterity; it cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Lion Greatbow

desc:
Greatbow of black stone crafted by a civilization now gone to ruin. Weapon of the Guardian Golem.

Extremely heavy, this greatbow requires enormous strength just to draw, suggesting it was not designed for human use.
location: Drop: Weeping Peninsula / Stormhill / Greyoll's Dragonbarrow / Liurnia of the Lakes / Capital Outskirts / Leyndell, Royal Capital / Leyndell, Ashen Capital / Mountaintops of the Giants / Scadu Altus / Charo's Hidden Grave 10% chance to drop from Guardian Golem enemies that wield it (5% from...
whatItIs: Golem Greatbow is a greatbow that weighs 14.5. Look for it as a drop from Guardian Golem (a 10% chance) in Weeping Peninsula.
whyItMatters: It starts at 130 physical attack and scales D in Strength and E in Dexterity. Through and Through is its weapon skill, costing 99 FP per use.
whenToUse: Golem Greatbow needs 24 Strength and 18 Dexterity, cannot be infused, and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Golem Greatbow

desc:
Greatbow featuring Erdtree styling. In times of old, when faith and battle went hand in hand, this weapon was created in tandem with the Golden Great Arrow.

Scales all arrow damage with faith, revealing its true worth when used with holy-infused arrows.
location: Guaranteed Drop: Fringefolk Hero's Grave (Limgrave) Received when destroying the Chariot in the Hero's Grave, along with 10 Great Arrows. The Chariot is destroyed by dropping one of 3 massive urns on top of it. Doing this requires a ranged weapon and some ammunition, which should then be fired...
whatItIs: Erdtree Greatbow belongs to the greatbow class at 11 weight. An enemy drop in Limgrave.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 60 physical plus 65 holy, scaling E in Strength, E in Dexterity, and D in Faith. The skill is Through and Through, 99 FP.
whenToUse: It cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones, and Erdtree Greatbow needs 20 Strength, 14 Dexterity, and 14 Faith. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Erdtree Greatbow

desc:
Enormous greatbow larger than any man. Can not be drawn with any ordinary level of strength, but the force of its shots is extraordinary.

A greatbow can only fire great arrows.
location: Loot: Altus Plateau Found inside a chest on top of the Highway Lookout Tower in northern Altus, just on the border to the Capital Outskirts. Drop: Altus Plateau / Deeproot Depths Has a 4% chance to drop from Greatbow-wielding Leyndell Knights, Haligtree Knights, Mausoleum Knights, and Redmane...
whatItIs: Greatbow is a greatbow that weighs 10. Greatbow-wielding Leyndell Knights, Haligtree Knights, Mausoleum in Altus Plateau can drop it (a 4% chance).
whyItMatters: In practice, Before upgrades it has 125 physical attack, scaling D in Strength and D in Dexterity. The skill on it is Through and Through at 99 FP.
whenToUse: Greatbow needs 20 Strength and 20 Dexterity; it cannot be infused and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Greatbow

desc:
Weapon of Igon, the broken drake warrior. A greatbow fashioned from two dragon bones bound with coarse rope. Covered in gashes left by claws.

Imbued with Igon's obsession, enhancing the power of Igon's Harpoon.
location: Quest Reward / Guaranteed Drop: Gravesite Plain / Jagged Peak Acquired from Igon's corpse after either completing his questline or killing him at any of his possible locations. This item may come with Ash of War: Igon's Drake Hunt already attached only if the player choses to fulfill Igon's...
whatItIs: A greatbow of 12.5 weight, Igon's Greatbow hits with pierce attacks. Igon's in Gravesite Plain hands it over.
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 120 physical attack, scaling D in Strength and E in Dexterity. Weapon skill: Through and Through (99 FP).
whenToUse: Igon's Greatbow needs 23 Strength and 16 Dexterity; it cannot be infused and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Igon's Greatbow

desc:
A crossbow of simple make, usable by anyone, but lacking in both power and accuracy.

Bolts must be equipped to use a crossbow.
location: Drop: Weeping Peninsula / Limgrave / Liurnia of the Lakes / Altus Plateau / Scadu Altus / Shadow Keep 4% drop chance from crossbow-wielding Foot Soldiers: Godrick Foot Soldiers, Raya Lucaria Foot Soldiers, Leyndell Foot Soldiers, and Messmer Foot Soldiers. There are two easily farmed Godrick...
whatItIs: Soldier's Crossbow is a crossbow weighing 3.5. An enemy drop in Weeping Peninsula (a 4% chance).
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 60 physical attack. The skill on it is Kick.
whenToUse: Soldier's Crossbow needs 10 Strength and 8 Dexterity; it cannot be infused and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Soldier's Crossbow

desc:
Ranged weapon made from a bow fixed to a stock. Deals good damage and is simple to use, but requires reloading after firing.

Bolts must be equipped to use a crossbow.
location: Purchase: Weeping Peninsula 1 is sold for 1,500 Runes by the Nomadic Merchant at the Castle Morne Rampart Site of Grace, north of Castle Morne itself.
whatItIs: Light Crossbow is a crossbow that weighs 4. It is for sale from Nomadic Merchant for 1,500 runes in Weeping Peninsula.
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 65 physical attack. Its weapon skill is Kick.
whenToUse: Light Crossbow needs 12 Strength and 8 Dexterity; it cannot be infused and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Light Crossbow

desc:
Heavy crossbow with iron limbs, increasing damage dealt.

Commonly employed in the Shattering.
location: Loot: Limgrave / Liurnia of the Lakes / Caelid / Greyoll's Dragonbarrow / Deeproot Depths / Altus Plateau / Miquella's Haligtree / Gravesite Plain / Scadu Altus 2% drop chance from crossbow-wielding Soldier enemies: Godrick Soldiers, Raya Lucaria Soldiers, Radahn Soldiers, Mausoleum Soldiers,...
whatItIs: Heavy Crossbow is a crossbow weighing 5.5. For a new player, enemies in Limgrave drop it (a 2% chance).
whyItMatters: It starts at 72 physical attack. The skill is Kick.
whenToUse: Heavy Crossbow needs 14 Strength and 10 Dexterity, cannot be infused, and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Heavy Crossbow

desc:
Crossbow made with pulleys and power springs. The complex mechanism, which required advanced mathematical and mechanical understanding to craft, was likely made by a certain genius who learned Golden Order fundamentalism. 

One touch fires a volley of bolts. Be warned; large stores of bolts can be quickly spent.
location: Loot: Craftsman's Shack (Mt. Gelmir) Found on a corpse near the Craftsman's Shack Site of Grace, on top of the wooden platforms just outside.
whatItIs: Pulley Crossbow is a crossbow that weighs 4. Looted from a corpse at Craftsman's Shack in Mt. Gelmir.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 65 physical. Weapon skill: Kick.
whenToUse: It cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones, and Pulley Crossbow needs 16 Strength and 16 Dexterity. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Pulley Crossbow

desc:
One-of-a-kind enchanted crossbow of exquisitely detailed craftmanship. Made to celebrate the matrimonial union, and reconciliation, between the houses of the Erdtree and the Full Moon, Leyndell and Raya Lucaria. 

The two rings dance when reloading the weapon. Reveals true worth when used with holy-infused bolts.
location: Loot: Academy of Raya Lucaria (Liurnia of the Lakes) Found inside a chest up a tower on the rooftops of Raya Lucaria.
whatItIs: Full Moon Crossbow is a crossbow weighing 4. Found in a chest at Academy of Raya Lucaria.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 50 physical plus 50 magic. Its weapon skill is Kick.
whenToUse: Full Moon Crossbow needs 10 Strength, 10 Dexterity, and 14 Intelligence, cannot be infused, and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Full Moon Crossbow

desc:
Large crossbow made from composite materials. One of the largest of all bolt-firing devices.

Its limbs are more pliable than metallic ones, allowing bolts fired from this weapon to pierce even helms forged of steel.
location: Loot: Stormveil Castle (Limgrave) Found inside Stormveil Castle, near the explosive ballista shooting enemies. The quickest path to the Arbalest is through the Rampart Tower Site of Grace. Jump down and enter the room that has a fog wall that can only be broken with a Stonesword Key. After...
whatItIs: Arbalest is a crossbow weighing 6. Found at Stormveil Castle in Limgrave.
whyItMatters: It starts at 77 physical attack. The skill on it is Kick.
whenToUse: It cannot be infused and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones, and Arbalest needs 18 Strength and 12 Dexterity. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Arbalest

desc:
Black crossbow featuring a long stock. Used for sniping, it has a very long range.

Weapon of Crepus, who served the Two Fingers from the shadows of the Roundtable as the head confessor.
location: Loot: Roundtable Hold Found behind a fog wall that requires 1 Stonesword Key to open inside the Roundtable Hold. This door is reached by going down a flight of stairs in the eastern wing, past Smithing Master Hewg, and then turning around. Found alongside 20 Black-Key Bolts.
whatItIs: Crepus's Black-Key Crossbow belongs to the crossbow class at 5 weight. Look for it in Roundtable Hold.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 68 physical. Its weapon skill is Kick.
whenToUse: Crepus's Black-Key Crossbow needs 14 Strength and 16 Dexterity; it cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Crepus's Black-Key Crossbow

desc:
A mechanized crossbow that has been fitted with a fan-shaped contraption.

This metallic piece adds a reloading system used in the execution of a unique battle art.
location: Loot: Scadu Altus Found alongside the road just south of the Ghostflame Dragon north of the Moorth Highway, South Site of Grace and southwest of Moorth Ruins.
whatItIs: Repeating Crossbow is a crossbow that weighs 6. Look for it in Scadu Altus.
whyItMatters: It starts at 74 physical attack. The skill on it is Repeating Fire at 2626 FP.
whenToUse: Repeating Crossbow needs 13 Strength and 15 Dexterity, cannot be infused, and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Repeating Crossbow

desc:
A modified crossbow made by combining two crossbows into one.

Capable of loading multiple bolts and firing them simultaneously, enabling a spread of fire.
location: Loot: Gravesite Plain Pillaged from a corpse in a small ruined campsite by the cliffs facing Ellac River, south of the Castle Front military encampment. From the site of grace, circle around the tall mesa to the south and drop down to a low ledge with three Messmer Soldiers.
whatItIs: Spread Crossbow is a crossbow weighing 5. Corpse loot at Gravesite Plain Pillaged.
whyItMatters: It starts at 68 physical attack. The skill is Kick.
whenToUse: Spread Crossbow needs 11 Strength and 17 Dexterity; it cannot be infused and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Spread Crossbow

desc:
An unconventional ballistic device modelled on a weapon used to besiege castles. Only capable of firing greatbolts.

Perfect for reckless acts such as storming a castle or facing an entire army alone.
location: Loot: Forest Lookout Tower (Weeping Peninsula) Found in a chest on top of the Forest Lookout Tower in the Weeping Peninsula, located southwest of the Bridge of Sacrifice from Limgrave.
whatItIs: Hand Ballista belongs to the ballista class at 10 weight. A chest at Forest Lookout Tower in Weeping Peninsula holds it.
whyItMatters: It starts at 150 physical attack. The skill on it is Kick.
whenToUse: Hand Ballista needs 30 Strength and 14 Dexterity; it cannot be infused and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Hand Ballista

desc:
Jar cannon which uses explosives to fire greatbolts. Deals great damage but is slow to reload.

Experimental firearm brought to the assault on Volcano Manor, where it was discovered that no one knew how to use it.
location: Guaranteed Drop: Volcano Cave (Mt. Gelmir) Dropped by Demi-Human Queen Margot inside of Volcano Cave.
whatItIs: Jar Cannon belongs to the ballista class at 15 weight. Look for it as a drop from Demi-Human Queen Margot in Mt. Gelmir.
