whyItMatters: It starts at 192 physical attack. The skill on it is Kick.
whenToUse: It cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones, and Jar Cannon needs 34 Strength and 12 Dexterity. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Jar Cannon

desc:
A type of jar cannon used to fire greatbolts. A masterwork of Spellmachinist Rabbath.

The power of the glintstones that encircle the barrel imbues bolts with magic damage and guides shots toward their targets.
location: Loot: Rabbath's Rise (Scadu Altus) Found in the study of Rabbath's Rise. Can be accessed by ascending using a nearby Sealed Spiritspring or by descending down the rise from the cliffs southeast of Shaman Village.
whatItIs: Rabbath's Cannon belongs to the ballista class at 15 weight. Rabbath's Rise in Scadu Altus is where it is found.
whyItMatters: It starts at 135 physical attack with 135 magic on top. Kick is its weapon skill.
whenToUse: It cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones, and Rabbath's Cannon needs 28 Strength and 16 Dexterity. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Rabbath's Cannon

desc:
A technique for hand-to-hand combat without the aid of a weapon. This martial art combines fist strikes and kicks.

The teachings of a group of spiritual seekers known as the Dryleaf Sect, revealed only to those of worthy valor and character. The practice of this martial art marks the dawn of an ascetic's journey.
location: Quest Reward: Moorth Ruins (Scadu Altus) Obtained from defeating Dryleaf Dane in an honorable duel at the Moorth Ruins site of grace. To challenge Dane to a duel, retrieve the May the Best Win gesture from the Highroat Cross site of grace then perform the gesture to its completion in front of him.
whatItIs: Dryleaf Arts belongs to the hand-to-hand class at 1 weight, and its attack type is strike. Beat Dryleaf Dane in Scadu Altus to get it.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 86 physical, scaling D in Strength and D in Dexterity. The skill on it is Palm Blast at 14 FP.
whenToUse: Dryleaf Arts needs 8 Strength and 8 Dexterity; it can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Dryleaf Arts

desc:
A technique for hand-to-hand combat without the aid of a weapon. This martial art focuses on kicking techniques.

This kick-based martial art is unique to Dane, a Dryleaf and sworn ally of Leda. He acquired these skills by training with the aid of a waterfall; letting the water beat his body, and throwing himself into its basin.
location: Loot: Enir-Ilim (Land of the Tower) Pillaged from Dane's corpse after successfully defeating the Miquellan Loyalists bossfight.
whatItIs: A hand-to-hand of 1 weight, Dane's Footwork hits with strike attacks. Corpse loot in Enir-Ilim.
whyItMatters: It starts at 86 physical attack and scales D in Strength and D in Dexterity. Palm Blast is its weapon skill, costing 14 FP per use.
whenToUse: It can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones, and Dane's Footwork needs 8 Strength and 8 Dexterity. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Dane's Footwork

desc:
Perfume bottle remade into a weapon by perfumers of the realm of shadow.

Attacks release perfumed powder, producing sparks of fire.

The crusade was a violent purge, and the perfumers were not called there to heal.
location: Loot: Gravesite Plain Acquired from a chest in the southeastern corner of the military encampment by the Castle Front site of grace.
whatItIs: Firespark Perfume Bottle is a perfume bottle weighing 1 with standard attacks. A chest in Gravesite Plain holds it.
whyItMatters: Its base attack is 118 fire, with no physical component, scaling C in Dexterity. The skill on it is Kick.
whenToUse: Firespark Perfume Bottle needs 3 Strength and 14 Dexterity, cannot be infused, and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Firespark Perfume Bottle

desc:
Perfume bottle remade into a weapon by perfumers of the realm of shadow.

Attacks release perfumed powder, producing an icy chill.

From time to time, perfumers set out on journeys to pursue new aromatics and flower gardens.
location: Loot: Lamenter's Gaol (Charo's Hidden Grave) Located in a room guarded by a restless Jar Innards enemy. The room can be reached after opening the first locked door of the gaol using the Upper Gaol Key, descending down the first ladder and arriving into a room with the frozen floor, where a Jar...
whatItIs: A perfume bottle of 1 weight, Chilling Perfume Bottle hits with standard attacks. Lamenter's Gaol is where it is found.
whyItMatters: Its base attack is 112 magic, with no physical component, scaling D in Dexterity and D in Intelligence. Hits carry frostbite (60) buildup. The skill on it is Kick.
whenToUse: It cannot be infused and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones, and Chilling Perfume Bottle needs 3 Strength, 13 Dexterity, and 13 Intelligence. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Chilling Perfume Bottle

desc:
Perfume bottle remade into a weapon by perfumers of the realm of shadow.

Attacks release perfumed powder, producing frenzied flame.

From time to time, perfumers set out on journeys to pursue new aromatics and flower gardens.
location: Loot: Abandoned Church (Abyssal Woods) Pillaged from a seated corpse located by the northern wall of the Church Ruins.
whatItIs: Frenzyflame Perfume Bottle belongs to the perfume bottle class at 1 weight, and its attack type is standard. A corpse at Abandoned Church in Abyssal Woods carries it.
whyItMatters: Its base attack is 112 fire, with no physical component, scaling E in Strength, D in Dexterity, E in Intelligence, and E in Faith. It applies madness (60) buildup on hit. Weapon skill: Kick.
whenToUse: It cannot be infused and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones, and Frenzyflame Perfume Bottle needs 3 Strength, 10 Dexterity, 12 Intelligence, and 12 Faith. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Frenzyflame Perfume Bottle

desc:
Perfume bottle remade into a weapon by perfumers of the realm of shadow.

Attacks release perfumed powder, producing lightning.

From time to time, perfumers set out on journeys to pursue new aromatics and flower gardens.
location: Loot: Gravesite Plain Found in a small pond surrounded by Lightning Sheep southeast of the Ellac River Downstream site of grace / northeast of the Cerulean Coast site of grace.
whatItIs: Lightning Perfume Bottle belongs to the perfume bottle class at 1 weight, and its attack type is standard. Gravesite Plain is where it is found.
whyItMatters: Its base attack is 118 lightning, with no physical component, scaling D in Dexterity and D in Faith. Its weapon skill is Kick.
whenToUse: Lightning Perfume Bottle needs 3 Strength, 16 Dexterity, and 14 Faith, cannot be infused, and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Lightning Perfume Bottle

desc:
Perfume bottle customized by Thiollier.

Attacks release perfumed powder, producing deadly poison.

There are some techniques of the perfuming arts that employ poison. Upon learning of this, Thiollier threw himself into mastering those techniques, and he made them his own.
location: Purchase: Gravesite Plain Can be acquired from Thiollier for 6000. If this item was not bought from Thiollier before he moves from his first location, then it can alternatively be bought from Moore for 6000. Can alternatively be bought from the Twin Maiden Husks for 6000 after giving them...
whatItIs: Deadly Poison Perfume Bottle belongs to the perfume bottle class at 1 weight, and its attack type is standard. Thiollier sells it in Gravesite Plain.
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 98 physical attack, scaling D in Dexterity and D in Arcane. Hits carry poison (66) buildup. Its weapon skill is Deadly Poison Spray, which costs 21 FP.
whenToUse: Deadly Poison Perfume Bottle needs 3 Strength, 13 Dexterity, and 18 Arcane, cannot be infused, and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Deadly Poison Perfume Bottle

desc:
A thrusting shield of gold ornamentation which enables the wielder to attack and guard simultaneously.

In the realm of shadow, though far away from the Erdtree, ritual combat continued to hold weight.
location: Loot: Specimen Storehouse. Head north from the Storehouse, First Floor Site of Grace and up the stairs. Turn left and continue up two more flights of stairs until you reach a Fire Knight facing away from you. Follow the wooden path to the left of the Fire Knight, and on left you will see a...
whatItIs: Dueling Shield is a thrusting shield that weighs 9. Found at Specimen Storehouse.
whyItMatters: In practice, base attack is 125 physical, scaling D in Strength and D in Dexterity. Weapon skill: Shield Strike. Its guard blocks 88 percent of physical damage with a guard boost of 58.
whenToUse: It can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones, and Dueling Shield needs 15 Strength and 14 Dexterity. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Dueling Shield

desc:
Silver thrusting shield embedded with glintstones. Enables the wielder to attack and guard simultaneously.

Once wielded by Rellana, the Twin Moon Knight, during her sole entry into ritual combat—a demonstration of fidelity to the Erdtree.
location: Loot: Specimen Storehouse (Shadow Keep) Located west of the Storehouse, Back Section site of grace, it can be found at the end of an open room guarded by a Fire Knight and a couple Shadow Undead.
whatItIs: Carian Thrusting Shield belongs to the thrusting shield class at 10.5 weight. Look for it at Specimen Storehouse in Shadow Keep.
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 122 physical attack and 36 magic, scaling D in Strength, D in Dexterity, and D in Intelligence. Shield Strike is its weapon skill. Its guard blocks 94 percent of physical damage with a guard boost of 64.
whenToUse: Carian Thrusting Shield needs 17 Strength, 13 Dexterity, and 15 Intelligence; it can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Carian Thrusting Shield

desc:
A "thrusting shield," or combined weapon and shield. Enables the wielder to attack and guard simultaneously.

An armament once used in rites of combat performed to honor the Erdtree, now lost to time.
location: Loot: Caelid Colosseum Found on a corpse inside the Caelid Colosseum, just behind the Great Jar. Two Stonesword Keys are required to activate the elevator down in Siofra River in order to reach this location. Category:weapon
whatItIs: Ritual Thrusting Shield belongs to the thrusting shield class at 10 weight. A corpse at Caelid Colosseum in Caelid carries it.
whyItMatters: In practice, Before upgrades it has 135 physical attack, scaling D in Strength and D in Dexterity. Blocking with it stops 82 percent physical, and its guard boost is 55.
whenToUse: Ritual Thrusting Shield needs 13 Strength and 12 Dexterity, can take Ashes of War and affinity changes, and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Ritual Thrusting Shield

desc:
Dagger engraved with a smithscript.

Reduced mass enhances the effects of the smithing arts, allowing this weapon to function as a throwing dagger for all attacks. 

Once thrown, the dagger instantly reappears in the wielder's hand.
location: Found at Ruined Forge Lava Intake. Proceed normally through the dungeon until you reach the lever that moves the lava pipe and then drop down to the floor below. The dagger can be found behind the Golem Smith.
whatItIs: Smithscript Dagger is a throwing blade weighing 1.5 with standard and pierce attacks. An enemy drop.
whyItMatters: It starts at 62 physical attack and scales E in Strength, C in Dexterity, E in Intelligence, and E in Faith. Piercing Throw is its weapon skill, costing 9 FP per use.
whenToUse: It can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones, and Smithscript Dagger needs 5 Strength, 11 Dexterity, 11 Intelligence, and 11 Faith. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Smithscript Dagger

desc:
Curved blade wielded with a backhand grip. A type of weapon wielded by hornsent for generations.

Wielding this weapon resembles a deadly dance.
location: Loot: Gravesite Plain This weapon can be found beside a coffin in a gazebo in the Inquisitor section of Gravesite Plain, north-northeast of the Scorched Ruins Site of Grace. On acquisition it has Ash of War: Blind Spot pre-equipped, despite already having Blind Spot as its underlying base skill...
whatItIs: Backhand Blade belongs to the backhand blade class at 2 weight, and its attack type is slash and pierce. Gravesite Plain is where it is found.
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 105 physical attack, scaling D in Strength and D in Dexterity. Blind Spot is its weapon skill, costing 9 FP per use.
whenToUse: Backhand Blade needs 10 Strength and 13 Dexterity, can take Ashes of War and affinity changes, and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Backhand Blade

desc:
Circular backhand blade engraved with a smithscript. A throwing weapon created through the smithing arts.

Execute a strong attack to throw the backhand blade, causing it to fly in a curved trajectory.
location: Loot: Ruined Forge of Starfall Past (Scadu Altus) It can be looted from a body located by the edge of the sewage waterfall in the depths of the Forge. More specifically, it's found a bit behind a lever-locked gate inside of the Forge.
whatItIs: Smithscript Cirque belongs to the backhand blade class at 2 weight, and its attack type is slash. Look for it at Ruined Forge of Starfall Past in Scadu Altus.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 100 physical, scaling D in Strength, D in Dexterity, E in Intelligence, and E in Faith. Weapon skill: Blind Spot (9 FP).
whenToUse: Smithscript Cirque needs 9 Strength, 14 Dexterity, 11 Intelligence, and 11 Faith; it can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Smithscript Cirque

desc:
Weapon of the masked Curseblades. Circular backhand blade with wave-like cutting edges, sharpened into points that incite blood loss.

Long ago, this was employed by the ascetics who strove to become tutelary deities as a ritualistic object in their self-flagellating dances.
location: Drop: Gravesite Plain / Belurat, Tower Settlement / Scadu Altus / Ancient Ruins of Rauh 3% drop chance from Curseblades (2% drop chance from some of the Curseblades in Scaduview and Ancient Ruins of Rauh). There is an easily reached Curseblade walking down the stairs leading down from the...
whatItIs: Curseblade's Cirque belongs to the backhand blade class at 4.5 weight, and its attack type is slash. Dropped by Curseblades (a 3% chance).
whyItMatters: Base attack is 108 physical, scaling E in Strength and C in Dexterity. Hits carry blood loss (45) buildup. The skill on it is Deadly Dance at 15 FP.
whenToUse: It cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones, and Curseblade's Cirque needs 9 Strength and 22 Dexterity. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Curseblade's Cirque

desc:
Curved blade wielded with a backhand grip, said to have originated from the hidden realm of shadow.

The style of combat associated with this weapon is marked by spinning slashes and gouging thrust attacks.
location: Purchase: Twin Maiden Husks Sold by the Twin Maiden Husks at Roundtable Hold for 1,000 Runes.
whatItIs: Reverse-Bladed Sword belongs to the backhand blade class at 3 weight, and its attack type is slash and pierce. It is for sale from Twin Maiden Husks for 1,000 runes in Roundtable Hold.
whyItMatters: In practice, Before upgrades it has 115 physical attack, scaling D in Strength and D in Dexterity. Weapon skill: Blind Spot (9 FP).
whenToUse: It can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones, and Reverse-Bladed Sword needs 9 Strength and 11 Dexterity. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Reverse-Bladed Sword

desc:
Large katana with a prominent tempering pattern on its black blade, unique to warriors of the Land of Reeds. The most finely honed of its ilk.

Designed for aggression, this armament requires the wielder to throw their entire body into swinging it. The slashing attacks of its honed edge incite blood loss.
location: Loot: Gravesite Plain Found on a corpse in the lake on the northern Gravesite Plain, west of Abandoned Ailing Village, where the Ghostflame Dragon is fought. Comes equipped with the Ash of War: Overhead Stance by default.
whatItIs: Great Katana is a great katana weighing 9 with slash and pierce attacks. A corpse in Gravesite Plain carries it.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 145 physical, scaling D in Strength and D in Dexterity. Hits carry blood loss (55) buildup. Overhead Stance is its weapon skill, costing 18 FP per use.
whenToUse: Great Katana needs 14 Strength and 18 Dexterity, can take Ashes of War and affinity changes, and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Great Katana

desc:
Great katana with spines of gravel stone along its blade, wielded by the Ancient Dragon-Man of the Dragon's Pit. Has an anti-dragon effect.

Formerly a Dragon Communion warrior, the Ancient Dragon-Man was once arbiter of those worthy to devour the Dreaded One.
location: Guaranteed Drop: Dragon's Pit (Gravesite Plain) The Dragon-Hunter's Great Katana is received upon defeating the Ancient Dragon-Man at the end of the Dragon's Pit dungeon.
whatItIs: Dragon-Hunter's Great Katana is a great katana weighing 10.5 with slash and pierce attacks. Beat Ancient Dragon-Man in Gravesite Plain to get it.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 152 physical, scaling D in Strength and D in Dexterity. Each hit builds up blood loss (55). Its weapon skill is Dragonwound Slash, which costs 18 FP.
whenToUse: Dragon-Hunter's Great Katana needs 15 Strength and 20 Dexterity; it cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Dragon-Hunter's Great Katana

desc:
A great katana with the tempering pattern of its blade forever stained red with blood. Weapon of Rakshasa, who cuts down and devours.

A berserker's weapon used to endure enemy attacks and reply with one's full fury. When attacking, the wielder is less likely to stagger from counterattacks, but will also take increased damage.
location: Guaranteed Drop: Eastern Nameless Mausoleum (Scadu Altus) Gained by defeating Rakshasa in the Eastern Nameless Mausoleum.
whatItIs: A great katana of 9.5 weight, Rakshasa's Great Katana hits with slash and pierce attacks. Beat Rakshasa for it.
whyItMatters: It starts at 155 physical attack and scales E in Strength and C in Dexterity. Hits carry blood loss (55) buildup. The skill is Weed Cutter, 8 FP.
whenToUse: Rakshasa's Great Katana needs 12 Strength and 27 Dexterity; it cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Rakshasa's Great Katana

desc:
Large katana with a long, heavy blade. A weapon unique to warriors of the Land of Reeds.

Designed for aggression, this armament requires the wielder to throw their entire body into swinging it. The slashing attacks of its honed edge incite blood loss.
location: Loot: Greyoll's Dragonbarrow Found on a corpse close to the Fort Faroth site of grace, sitting on top of a large malformed skull next to where Greyoll lies. ReedGK Location.jpg|The corpse that holds the item
whatItIs: Reed Great Katana belongs to the great katana class at 10 weight, and its attack type is slash and pierce. A corpse in Greyoll's Dragonbarrow carries it.
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 158 physical attack, scaling D in Strength and D in Dexterity. Hits carry blood loss (55) buildup. Weapon skill: Overhead Stance (18 FP).
whenToUse: It can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones, and Reed Great Katana needs 11 Strength and 16 Dexterity. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Reed Great Katana

desc:
Though its blade is of standard greatsword length, its weight has been whittled away to the absolute minimum.

Nicknamed after ladies of noble status for its refined appearance. With cultivated form, one can wield this weapon as swiftly as one might a straightsword.
location: Loot: Castle Ensis (Gravesite Plain) The weapon can be found in a chest at the top of a watchtower in Castle Ensis. The watchtower can be reached from the Castle-Lord's Chamber Site of Grace by heading out the small arched doorway onto a stone balcony, jumping over the ledge, and continuing...
whatItIs: Milady belongs to the light greatsword class at 6.5 weight, and its attack type is standard and pierce. Found in a chest at Castle Ensis.
whyItMatters: Base attack is 116 physical, scaling D in Strength and D in Dexterity. Weapon skill: Impaling Thrust (9 FP).
whenToUse: It can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones, and Milady needs 12 Strength and 17 Dexterity. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Milady

desc:
Light greatsword with gold inlaid. Weapon of Leda, the Needle Knight. Deals holy damage.

Though polished to a mirror sheen, this blade still reeks with the stench of crusted blood that lingers from the cull of her knightly comrades.
location: Guaranteed drop: Enir-Ilim Received after defeating Leda and her allies in their boss fight near the top of Enir-Ilim.
whatItIs: Leda's Sword belongs to the light greatsword class at 7.5 weight, and its attack type is standard and pierce. Beat Leda in Enir-Ilim to get it.
whyItMatters: It starts at 101 physical attack with 65 holy on top and scales E in Strength, C in Dexterity, and D in Faith. Needle Piercer is its weapon skill, costing 19 FP per use.
whenToUse: Leda's Sword needs 11 Strength, 22 Dexterity, and 19 Faith; it cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Leda's Sword

desc:
Carian light greatsword embedded with blue glintstone. Weapon of Rellana, the Twin Moon Knight.

Two swords as a single armament. When two-handing, a straight sword engraved with golden flame will be carried in the left hand. Here, and here alone, were moon and fire ever together.
location: Trade: Roundtable Hold Trade the Remembrance of the Twin Moon Knight, gained by defeating Rellana, Twin Moon Knight, with Finger Reader Enia. Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).
whatItIs: A light greatsword of 8 weight, Rellana's Twin Blades hits with standard and pierce attacks. Trade in the Remembrance of the Twin Moon Knight with Finger Reader Enia to get it.
whyItMatters: It starts at 103 physical attack with 66 magic and 66 fire on top and scales D in Strength, D in Dexterity, D in Intelligence, and D in Faith. Weapon skill: Moon-and-Fire Stance (1025 FP).
whenToUse: Rellana's Twin Blades needs 13 Strength, 16 Dexterity, 16 Intelligence, and 16 Faith, cannot be infused, and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Rellana's Twin Blades

desc:
A light greatsword; that is, a sword whose blade matches the length of a greatsword, while only possessing a very light weight due to its remarkable manufacture.

A signature weapon in the land of Idus. 

With cultivated form, one can wield this weapon as swiftly as one might a straight sword.
location: Starting Weapon: Idus Knight The Idus Sword is the starting weapon for the Idus Knight. Loot: Liurnia of the Lakes Found early into the Laskyar Ruins past the Nomadic Merchant in the Liurnia Lake Shore Site of Grace. Northwest of the merchant, following the rock wall which seats the Malefactor's...
whatItIs: Idus Sword is a light greatsword weighing 7 with standard and pierce attacks. Found in Liurnia of the Lakes.
whyItMatters: Before upgrades it has 124 physical attack, scaling D in Strength and D in Dexterity. Weapon skill: Impaling Thrust (9 FP).
whenToUse: Idus Sword needs 10 Strength and 15 Dexterity, can take Ashes of War and affinity changes, and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Idus Sword

desc:
Weapon in the form of a carnivorous beast's vicious claws. Used to perform bestial slashing attacks uncanny to humankind.
An imitation of the esoteric technique of the horned warriors. Those who carry this weapon wield it as though they have been possessed by a savage beast.
location: This weapon is dropped from Logur the Beast Claw, in the southern area of Gravesite Plains, on the way to the Church of Consolation from the Gravesite Plain site of grace. Comes equipped with the Ash of War: Savage Claws Shadow of the Erdtree by default.
whatItIs: Beast Claw belongs to the beast claw class at 3 weight, and its attack type is slash. It drops from Logur the Beast Claw in Gravesite Plain.
whyItMatters: It starts at 98 physical attack and scales D in Strength and D in Dexterity. Hits carry blood loss (45) buildup. Savage Claws is its weapon skill, costing 13 FP per use.
whenToUse: Beast Claw needs 13 Strength and 11 Dexterity; it can take Ashes of War and affinity changes and upgrades with regular Smithing Stones. Worth a try once your stats allow.
name: Beast Claw

desc:
Claw of a great red bear wielded without modification by Red Bear, whose name is lost to madness.

After killing the great red bear in a blood-soaked bout, he became fascinated by the untainted glory of its naked strength. "I wish to be a bear, no more, and no less."
location: Guaranteed Drop: Northern Nameless Mausoleum (accessed through Rauh Base) Acquired from defeating the Red Bear NPC bossfight in the Northern Nameless Mausoleum.
whatItIs: Red Bear's Claw belongs to the beast claw class at 4 weight, and its attack type is slash. Beat Red Bear NPC for it.
whyItMatters: It starts at 104 physical attack and scales C in Strength and E in Dexterity. Hits carry blood loss (45) buildup. Weapon skill: Red Bear Hunt (8 FP).
whenToUse: Red Bear's Claw needs 20 Strength and 10 Dexterity; it cannot be infused and upgrades with Somber Smithing Stones. Try it once the requirements are met.
name: Red Bear's Claw
